description:
We're a housing association, delivering homes and services across the Midlands that help people to live independently. 

This profile is monitored Mon-Fri 9am - 5pm. For emergencies call 0345 60 20 540.

records.title: If you think housing officers are useless and patronising,then you haven't met Becky Collins
records.text: This review is about Becky Collins,my housing officer.  Having dealt with other housing officers from midland heart in the past,I was expecting little or no support. However, I have been pleasantly surprised,in fact shocked by the amount of support, help, understanding and patience that Becky has shown me.  In the past with previous housing officers, I had been annoyed and frustrated by the lack of support given.  Becky is the only housing officer that has made me feel truly listened to and Ive not been made to feel a nuisance that she just had to go through the motions with because that's her job.  If there were more people like Becky in this world, it would be a nicer place to be!

records.title: I had a great experience having taiba…
records.text: I had a great experience having taiba deal with my situation, she was patient, understanding and very thorough. Thank you for your support.

records.title: Zoya The CSO ☺️
records.text: This review is not for midland heart but indeed for Zoya the Customer service officer. She has the softest and most sweetest voice. I’m neurodivergent and she took the time to be patient with me while putting in my repairs. MESSAGE TO HEAD OFFICE:Acknowledge your staff like Zoya. Praise them and shout them out. She’s working her arse off.

records.title: (Mohammed Junaid Miah) was our housing…
records.text: (Mohammed Junaid Miah) was our housing officer he went above and beyond to assist us with our mutual exchange process. Throughout it all he was consistently engaging and communicating with us to keep us in the loop and allow a smooth fast flowing proccess. All expectations from us were met by himself with real time frames. 5 ⭐️

records.title: Serious housing conditions
records.text: I was in a very bad situation due to housing conditions and ASB. But I had a brand new housing officer Olivia worth. She came out to visit me wish was reassuring after a year of hell. She listened and put a action plan in place. She worked closely with police and I was fortunate to move out of the flat that had severe damp and mould after living there for a year and half. I've moved to a temp flat in the same building which still has issues but it's bigger and cleaner while I wait for my house.Olivia has made it clear that she's a message or a call away which for someone who's suffered as much as me is very comforting. I'm now working with yousif from the decant team and he and Olivia keep undated on my progress.My nightmare is nearly over and yousif informed me I'm getting a 2 bed house which is right by my family.After 2 years of hell. I'll finally get my forever home and start living again after my DV and housing issues.Once again thank you to Olivia shes one that takes pride in doing things the right way for tenants

records.title: Amazing people!
records.text: Alastair Davis (isn't there anymore I don't think) Mark Sanders(my housing officer) and Kashka (housing team) are some of the most amazing people I've had the pleasure of speaking to, I can't thank them enough for what they've done for me and my children! They have supported me for months through one of the toughest times of my life and without them I don't know where I'd be now. I'm so grateful!  Thank you for giving me and my children the fresh start we need. You guys deserve a pay raise, holiday or something to celebrate how amazing you are!! Again, thank you so so much and I'll forever be grateful to you all!

records.title: Fiona godson
records.text: After a really tricky start with a broker I received absolutely outstanding service from Fiona godson.  Buying a home at short notice due to personal circumstances was such a stressful process but Fiona in Birmingham supported me thoroughly throughout even out of hours, she was helpful and there for me and my children making the process bearable even when it seemed impossible highly recommend midland heart but especially Fiona thankyou so so much

records.title: Midland heart is the best housing…
records.text: Midland heart is the best housing association in the midlands, with their rapid response with call outs and customer service. It makes them number one.

records.title: Abdul has been an amazing support for…
records.text: Abdul has been an amazing support for myself and my daughter during an extremely stressful time. He has worked with me fairly, clearly, and quickly to resolve issues to the best of his ability with nothing but equality and grace.Thank you Abdul

records.title: I would like like to point out
records.text: I would like like to point out how Mohammed Miah helped to resolve the issues I faced which were beyond my control Within midlandheart, he took all the stress of worry away from me as he went about sorting the issues internally Every company should have a "Mohammed Miah" very polite and very professional you are a asset to midlandheart

records.title: Good could do better
records.text: Everything I've asked for has been done the surveyor said they would look into it but didn't bother to get back to me including saying I would not get decorating vouchers and I'm supposed to paint a composite door which you should not do.Sometimes you are better talking to your neighbour for advice.the maintenance for the garden area are really good and helpful.

records.title: I must say everything I have asked…

records.title: Just One Complaint
records.text: The (My) place is actually nice. The only problem I have is getting renovative work carried out in the bathroom. Other housing associations have carried out work free of charge & quickly, Mid-Heart have a different protocol where everything has to be approved first & it becomes complex, this was the only reason for the complaint; everything else is fine.

records.title: Not sure what this review is for
records.text: Not sure what this review is for? The "painting" job? If so, yes they did a great job. Not certain is was needed as there are other areas that could have been maintained first. Other than bin cupboard gates and a few facia boards there was nothing else to actually paint as obviously the fences, which do need doing, weren't included!

records.title: Where do I start eh ….
records.text: Where do I start eh ….. firstly when you need help no one to contact and they are very to speak to plus other things . Someone at midland heart needs to give a damn about their job because once I spoke to someone one day he/she just said ring back Monday . Not good enough. I find that it’s not the way to protect tenants of a contract and if I want other work doing they just say no . I wanted to protect my car parking area with bollards but I got rejected.

records.title: WALWIN STEPHENS & TWO OTHER BUILDERS
records.text: •As a Midland heart tenant I sometimes have half-hearted repair men come to repair my home. •The elderly builders that repaired my house over the three days 24th, 25th & 27th JULY were very polite and mannersable. 😊•They repaired the my home to a very high standard. 👏🏽👏🏽•One was WALWIN STEPHENS and I don't know the name of the others. 😁•The old time builders have more respect and manners than some of the younger builders of today. 😒

records.title: I am leaving this review for two…
records.text: I am leaving this review for two reasons. The first one is for Trlok, a most tenacious officer, who is as good as his word. The second is for Fionnuala, who in her limited capacity, tried her hardest to help resolve our problem. My biggest problem with Midland Heart is that customer services is useless. If the complaint isn't straight forward I.e: plumbing or an electrical problem, then they don't know what to do with it! Therefore, for the most part, they ignore it. Training greatly lacking.Nearly four years it took to get to the right people, once Trlok got involved, the process evolved to where we are today. Problem (for the most part) solved.Big thumbs up to Trlok & Fionnuala. Big thumbs down to customer services.

records.title: Organisation could do with improving!!
records.text: Been with Midland Heart for 3 months.  Not had any issues with staff being rude or anything but a repair which should have been done before I moved in is still outstanding, I’ve spent a day waiting in for a company servicing emergency cords for the building who didn’t turn up and our small car park is a nightmare.  We don’t have allocated spaces and are not asked when we apply if we require a parking space so with 10 spaces for 24 flats plus visitors and carers it’s stressful wondering if you will get a space when you return!!

records.title: Emersion heater
records.text: Steve griffin came to attend the property regarding the boiler and was quick efficient and friendly! Sorted the problem, only issue is it’s a reoccurring issue and wish midland heart had provided a long term solution as it causes me a lot of costly issues when it breaks

records.title: Broken bathroom fan
records.text: Broken bathroom fan:  Josh Colman visited my home on Monday to repair broken bathroom fan. What an asset this young man is to Midland Heart. He was polite & he knew his craft & I felt confident that he would do a good job & I was not disappointed. Thank you Josh.

records.title: Communication from Simone Murrain in…
records.text: Communication from Simone Murrain in the tenancy team  is exceptional and she goes above and beyond her job role. Some others would benefit by taking a leaf out of her book. Showed a real caring and understanding interest.

records.title: Repairs are always done in a timely…
records.text: Repairs are always done in a timely manner, and the time slots are good too to fit around what you do. Four stars are given because there's always room for improvement, so there's no complacency haha.

records.text: Sometimes things go wrong and sometimes things get resolved being with midland heart for over 5 years , I've has my ups and downs , not going to day they're perfect , but they do try and resolve the issues , however on many occasions I've been let down , with repairs and workmen coming down without any notice . However I did put a complaint when an appointment was booked and they didn't turn up,  and no compensation was offered for time wasted .

records.title: Decent housing association, but room for improvements
records.text: I became a tenant on 1th August 2022, I had electric default at the property, couldn’t understand tried to explained it to housing team but was met with disappointment and constant questioning whether I was doing somehow wrong or the appliances was causing commotion. Eventually, it was sorted out and I will also say this whenever I phone them up if its enquiry or household repair related, they’re able to handle it quickly and efficiently. I can attest to it!

records.text: Great for ideas to improve things but unfortunately it rarely carries through the ranks!  Repairs booking on app is great but wrong jobs or no jobs get done most of the time and all residents of a scheme can report the same communal repair - not efficient!

records.text: The lack of support with repair we get told to YouTube our repairs the door inside the property is your responsibility as fire and safety check and they don't shut and I'm not the only tenant either we pay our rent and as landlords it's your job to do the repairs .it's shocking you put the rent up but tell us to YouTube our repairs we mess it up then you won't touch it so either way it's a no win situation.my kitchen was damaged by last tenant but I'm told I have to wait 25 years for a new kitchen shocking .the more tenants i speak to who need repairs done and you wont do them you tube is wrong

records.title: Ceiling Leak
records.text: I am over sixty with health issues. I have been waiting since 2nd January for the leak to be resolved. Last night which is now 13th February I was told by the engineer that it might be fix sometime this week. He would have to submit a report in the mean time when the shower is turned on I await in my downstairs hallway with plastic and bucket to catch water. This is not hygienic for my healthcare, please do something, it’s been over a month and this situation is stressing me out.

records.title: Great Landlord / Needs to improve repair service system
records.text: It has been great being a Midland heart tenant for years now almost 10+ my only sign of improvement that i would suggest is more early dates for repairs rather than waiting over 2 weeks, aswell as having an hrs time slot to wait for the repair person to arrive and lastly a call to advise the repair person is on the way if the hr slot isnt available. This ensures that someone is actually attending and we dont have to sit around all day to avoid missing the appointment. I have had appointments 3/4 weeks away and whereby the repair person doesnt turn up only to find there has been emergency and that is actually when i call in the next morning, there is nobody to ring you to advise no one is coming or attending or job has been cancelled, so it helps that we get on with our daily routine while midland heart team get on with theirs rather than having to wait around for the repair person to turn up as some appointments are 9-5pm so its pretty much a days work lost.

records.title: My heart sinks when I have to contact…
records.text: My heart sinks when I have to contact midlands heart housing association, because they are so pathetic and useless, early this year I received 4 electric shocks off my shower, not major shocks that Knock you off your feet but the idiot thet sent out told me you can't get shocks off the shower I asked him to turn it on but he wouldn't of course and then isolated the shower, on doing my home work I discovered the shower had been withdrawn from sale by Triton in 2018 because of the Risk of fire and electric shocks to customers it was a Triton safeguard Plus I guess the Plus is the extremely bad service from midland heart, it took them over a week to provide me with a new shower which was then fitted completely incorrectly and dangerously by a woman installer I felt a woman would probably do a great job how wrong was I ? She missed out one vital screw that allowed the back of the shower body to fall off the wall exposing all the electrics to the water I was showering in at the time, I'm not an expert but electric and water do not go well together it kills people, midlands heart tried not sending someone to my home that day but obviously I wasn't going to put up with them putting my life in danger, I have suggested they compensate me for the danger they placed me in, the low lifes offered £55.00 quid for a shower that was withdrawn in 2018 they risked my life every day until I actually received 4 electric shocks from it  in 2024, I haven't accepted it yet I may involve injuries to you, fast forward to today I've had 4 visit from ph Jones this month the last man was excellent he realised the water waste waste pipes from my sink were blocked he'd did a good job clearing those pipes I was happy with what he did, however I used my washing machine 11 pm at night, and when I went into the kitchen and hour after the washer had done it's job I discovered the washing machine had emptied all that water onto my kitchen floor, I need a knee replacement operation I suffer dislocations of both shoulders I can't fix this problem my self and on calling midland heart the operator has flagged the job as an emergency but can't guarantee the job will be completed today,  The only thing midland heart are good at is bull shit and taking  £97.98 each week in rent, the morons even sent the police to my home once because I asked other people if they were left feeling depressed by the actions of midland heart, I had to convince 5 well intentioned police officer that I wasn't going to harm myself, why the hell would I ? when midland heart housing association are experts at putting dangers and harm to tenants with faulty electric showers and bad working practices

description:
We’re Hyde - we're here for our customers, and we're here for good. The Hyde Group was established in 1967 to provide homes for those left behind by the market and since 1988, we have proudly been building quality homes.

Our mission is to provide homes and communities that people are proud of. We manage homes and services to over 95,000 customers and offer financial help and guidance, and support, for our customers and communities.

The quickest way to manage your home is through MyAccount, sign up on our website.

records.title: Hyde: Masters of shifting blame
records.text: We bought 25% of a new build in January this year as a family home. Hyde were all nods and smiles until they had our money. We were advised that we could raise any problems during the defect period, but they neglected to tell us that almost everything would fall either under the "perishable" or "cosmetic" umbrella.I'll highlight a few examples. During our house demo, the centre sink in our kitchen had a weird gouge all the way around the top rim of it, which I was assured was purely cosmetic. I could see daylight through a pinhole in this gouge, it was clearly a disaster waiting to happen, but they wanted nothing to do with it.  Even going as far as to say we should have raised it during our house demo, as I absolutely did.Eventually the cupboard under the sink was full of water, and they sent a plumber round to have a look, and by chance, he discovered there was a hole in my sink. I pretended to be surprised, and he reported it back, and eventually it was replaced.Also, during this house demo, I pointed out that there were a bunch of visible, loose cables sitting on top of one of the kitchen cupboards. I was informed that this was part of the LED underlighting, and I could just box it in if it bothered me.Another example. I drilled into the wall at one point to hang some curtains, and there was a very strong air current coming through. Apparently that was completely my fault for drilling into the wall, and therefore not their concern. I've been doing DIY for years, used a stud detector, etc. I'm not a complete amateur, the wind should not have been coming through my wall.Recently, all of the plumbing sealant in my house has very suddenly turned yellow, and lost adhesion. This is apparently classed as perishable, and so I have to deal with it myself. The shower, the bath, and all the sinks went within 2 weeks of each other. At the time of raising the issue, the house was about 9 months old. I would expect the sealant to have lasted at least the first year in my brand new house.Most recently, we were advised by our window cleaner that we have burn holes in our kitchen window. Likely from somebody using an angle grinder or similar tool in close proximity. For some context, when we moved into the house, it was the only one of a dozen or so that had been completed, and was situated in a ring of properties all facing a green in the centre (At the time, a dirt heap/construction site). This appeared to be because we were the only ones naive enough to be convinced to put a deposit down as quickly as possible.Naturally, having builders surrounding the house on a daily basis, it seemed silly to bother having the windows cleaned when they were constantly caked in dust and debris. We were aware this would be the case, and so we just left the windows closed and got on with it.After about 9 months, all the building work in our eye-line had finished, and we tidied up the front garden and sought out a professional window cleaner, who did a great job, and brought the burn marks to our attention.After reporting this to Hyde, I was basically told we can't prove the marks were there before we moved in, and that their team had "professionally cleaned" our windows before moving in, and didn't spot any flaws (These same cleaners also weren't concerned with the other scratches, blemishes, and masses of building debris that was embedded in literally all of our window seals) so they wouldn't do anything.I went into my photos and found a picture of the window from exactly 7 weeks after we moved into the house, where (by pure chance) the burn marks were clearly visible. I sent these off, with a current photo highlighting the exact same marks. I have not received an email back, so I assume this has just been dismissed internally. By this point, I didn't even have a shed on the property, much less any tools capable of burning holes in glass.I have historically sent numerous emails raising faults that were completely ignored, including there being visible daylight under my front door. One of their phrases is "The team are looking into this" before they never bother to contact you again.After getting this off my chest in the correct forum, I'm now going to raise a dispute with the NHBC.Why 2 stars and not an outright 1?In Hyde's defence, I have raised quite a few defects that were resolved, although probably only half of what I should have. I did my best to resolve issues myself where possible, only raising defects when I would risk invalidating any warranties. For example, I've had to replace loads of the white mastic around several of the windows and door frames, or fill in gaps that were somehow very obviously missed.The house as a whole is also lovely, if hugely overvalued. Unfortunately we could never afford to buy a house outright in this town.Hyde, if you see this, please don't tell me to contact you. I've tried.

They inform me that I now have the opportunity of going through the ombudsmen system, which I already know is long winded and a waste of time because the Ombudsman cannot make Metropolitan abide by his decisions. I have experienced all that before when awarded a Mismanagement and Service Failure decision. The use of the Ombudsman is just another delaying process.It was disappointing not to receive any Compensation when I had offered to return all of the award to Metropolitan for them to help pay for their own long outstanding maintenance works for the benefit of all their Residents.

records.title: Disabled parking
records.text: I’m happy to live in an AH flat, however some residents want the manager to strictly enforce residents only parking. That’s fine with me. I don’t have a car, and have great difficulty walking. Several residents have harassed my daughter when she comes to pick me up or deliver shopping, telling her she can’t park here. This was especially upsetting during lockdown. I’m classed as vulnerable. Now a resident tells me that AH Handbook lists priorities for parking, and disabled residents is bottom of the list. Most of my neighbours are excellent and help me in many ways. It’s unfair and may be discriminatory to exclude drop off/pick up or short term parking for disabled residents. I’d welcome any advice.

Also, the reviewer complaining about costs rising is correct, it's becoming very expensive to live in an Anchor property.

The manager has done as much as possible, having made numerous phone calls on our behalf.

records.title: A resident is desperate to have her…
records.text: A resident is desperate to have her bath removed and a shower fitted. The same contractor who they contacted has already fitted twelve showers in our rented scheme. He came to look and the resident was happy with the quote. However he was then asked about his public liability insurance which he advised that it provided cover up to two million pound. He was then informed it had to be five million pound as it had increased since the last time he had worked here. This means that once again residents are being penalised as only large companies and local authorities can handle such a large amount of cover. They have since had another quote by social services which was almost two thousand pound dearer.Please advise.

records.title: No Help When Help Needed.
records.text: I registered with this retirement housing company in 2012.I have lived in my current private rental home since 2009.In April of this year I was given a Section 21NO FAULTS eviction notice as the owner wanted to sell. I wrote to Anchor to ask if they had any homes they could offer me urgently. What has followed is a series of forms all asking the same thing. Where do you live? Address for your landlord? How long have you lived there? Meantime whilst I am being assessed  repeatedly my account is frozen. So when I need an offer more urgently than before I am banned from getting any. I called today again after receiving the same form from the same assessment team AGAIN. The highly trained person I had today seemed to think I was LIVING with my landlord and practically accused me of being in arrears with my rent hence the eviction. For a charity receiving charity tax breaks I did not find her very charitable. So for the record Anchor Housing. A Section 21 is a NO FAULTS eviction. NOT to be confused with a SECTION 8..rent arrears eviction. As my background is legal I would be happy to run a one day seminar to explain in more detail the difference to any one employed at Anchor who is deaf to the facts. The word defamation sprung to mind during our chat. Good luck to all who reside or hope to reside within their hallowed walls.

records.title: Given Conflicting Information
records.text: I am a resident with Anchor and have recently lost my husband.  The location manager has been great in helping me to go on the list for a transfer to be closer to my family.  However, on Friday I spoke with a very unhelpful advisor in the customer care team who told me, ' I was at the bottom of both lists, did not stand a chance of getting a one bedroomed flat as these were given to couples and I would not be prioritised and even if I was, couples would still be prioritised over me and I wouldn't be moving for a very long time, if at all.'  I am feeling isolated and vulnerable following the loss of my husband and being so far from my family and this advisor's comments did not help me at all.  No compassion or empathy whatsoever.

records.title: I had applied for housing in Pemberly
records.text: I had applied for housing in Pemberly, Bath.   No help whatsoever to resolve any issues to be able to move.One interview with Maxine and not explained to about BeWise.   Five different numbers this morning.I had spoken yo a friend yesterday and they told me they gave up on a part buy.  Customer service hopeless.

records.title: Unjustified price hikes.
records.text: I'm putting up this review on behalf of my 80 year old mother, she bought a two bed flat a few years ago which is managed by Anchor. This company may as well go out and mug the elderly for all the unnecessary price hikes, so much so my mums considering looking for a job!!. When work is done they quite often use contractors from miles away so that's costing more than using a local trades person, and Anchor I'm sure are putting their percentage on the price. Panorama or Watchdog next, this companies running a racket.

records.title: Query
records.text: My mum lives in Anchor Housing Complex.     Keep chasing for her outdoor light to be replaced as she's recently had a fall resulting in a fracture.    I also hear that when a tenant passes away/moves out, the family are asked to remove all fittings and decoration, ie ripping up carpets (even if new or good condition) and stripping of wallpaper?     Surely this cannot be acceptable?    Purely wasteful.    Is this an Anchor initiative?

records.title: Insufficient support
records.text: My mother has been having unresolved difficulties with the boiler /thermostat in her bungalow for a few months. The heating will only come on for half an hour before cutting out again until the temperature drops sufficiently ti trigger again. She has not had a satisfactory repair and the last engineer didnt seem to know what the problem was. She is 92 and today has 2 inches of snow on the ground to add to the problem. My husband rang Anchor today about it. My mother reports that Anchor have since told her that because she has hot water it will be up to 5 days before an engineer calls. Hot water won't keep her warm. What strange logic! Come on Anchor. Care for the vulnerable?

records.title: Disappointed resident…
records.text: Unfortunately my experiences with anchor do not match any of these reviews. The service I have received here, since I moved in over 4 years ago, has left a lot to be desired. The current manager is efficient, helpful and responsive to the residents. This has not been the case with the previous two managers. I’ve had a piercing alarm going off for three days, which was so bad that I had to leave the property for3 days. Flooding in front of my flat was ignored for over two years, and not addressed. Indeed I was told it was coming from my flat. Aside from having no communal Wi-Fi the hub for phones is appalling, the manger has to go outside the building in order to communicate. The last straw for me came when there was a power cut in my flat, everyone was blamed except anchor whose fault it was. I was left without power for 22hours, there is a guest room here, but I was not offered that by any of the call handlers. Imagine if I had mobility issues or dependent on powe for medical needs. It does not bear thinking about. As I said the manger now is very good, but the further up the line you go, the more disconnected the communication becomes. I would now want a lot of assurances from anchor before I would consider buying here again. No one listens up the chain and everything drags on before there is any resolution.

One thing though, I didn't find that the writer knew a lot around my profession in order to highlight better things around my work but that was sorted through our collaboration.

records.title: CV Upgrade

I was assigned a professional writer who explained each step to me.  I was consulted on all changes and sent drafts once amendments were made.  Any questions or points I had were dealt with swiftly.  The final result was an amazing CV that jumped off of the pages.  Great job TOPCV.

records.title: I AM STILL IN AWE!!!

records.title: Happy with my new CV
records.text: Alex did my CV and it was a very efficient service. We went back and forth a couple of times with drafts and I am happy with the outcome of the CV, cover letter and LinkedIn page. The reason it isn’t 5 stars is that there were some extra spaces between words and between paragraphs and one grammatical error. The whole thing was also written in American English which I changed myself. It’s not a big deal but just a couple of little things and the reason I didn’t give 5 stars.

records.title: Great results but watch out for US spelling, etc.
records.text: Ahmed was very quick at getting the initial documents to me. There was a lot of US spelling and date formats but apart from that he’d translated my responses to the questionnaire brilliantly. When I sent the documents back annotated with small changes to be made, again this came back to me really quickly, however there were some typos, formatting issues and a couple of my comments still within the documents that hadn’t been addressed or deleted.  They were just small things so I thought it was easier to amend it myself - by the time I’d commented to say ‘please delete this’ I could have done it myself and so I did. Despite this, I could never have made my cv, cover letter and LinkedIn look like this. Whether it’s worth the money, only time will tell.

records.title: Quick turnaround time and very fluid process
records.text: I was pleased with the quick response time of the writer.  It was easy to communicate with him and the questionnaire was helpful to share my detailed thoughts and concerns.  It was a rather quick and fluid process.  The reason I marked it as a 4 instead of a 5 was that there were some minor errors that should have been corrected in the early stages such as the email address link in the header was to another email that was not my own.  Luckily I did a test email first and saw that it was not my actual email address.  Other than that though I am very happy with the result and hoping for a positive outcome in my job search.

records.title: My personal letter and CV reach a higher level and still trustworthy!
records.text: i had a good experience of the feedback and changes in my personal letter and CV. There is a difference between the way of using the language between Sweden and US/England but I got a lot of sencentences and wording to use. Txs

records.title: good and fast service as well as…

records.title: Good effort but not cent percent!!
records.text: Good effort but not cent percent!!Not neutralThey just urge the candidates that they are the best and an candidates has no information regarding cv ...They have business policythey just want to make your mind to ask them for cv/resume

records.title: Terrible CV writing skills
records.text: I’m giving 3 stars only based on the customer service response times.  I would give NO stars on their CV writing abilities. The CV writing I found was appalling . They base their process on falsifying your CV credentials and experience purely to beat ATS.  A future employer would absolutely not appreciate a false representation of a persons work experience to beat ATS / AI screening to bypass a job application process. Literally unbelievable and I can’t believe there is a company like this that exits.  There are better ways of helping someone create CV using their actual work experience to tailor to the career position they want. There is no need to falsify an experience.

records.title: Bad experience
records.text: The resume was made professionally but once the resume is delivered, you guys do not keep to your words. I bought the package where it stated that I would get more interviews and the package stated that it is a guaranteed thing but when after a month - I wrote back to topcv that I have had absolutely no luck and have only been getting rejection email - I did not receive any response. I did send a follow up email but that also got ignored.

records.title: "Feel free to reach out" [but it will cost you if you expect a reply!]
records.text: Sent my CV off for a free review and received a fairly helpful response back within 24 hours.  This is why they got 3 stars.  At the bottom of the email, it said "Feel free to reach out to me with any questions or for more information on our professional CV-writing services." So I replied with my new CV, which I had updated following the reviewer's advice and asked him to expand on a couple of his suggestions e.g. asking him what he meant by "The size and type of bullets should also be taken into account." and what size and type exactly he would recommend.   He replied, saying he's limited to 1 review per client but I could pay €129 for a full review and re-write.  Yet again, he signed off with "Feel free to email me with any questions, or to simply share your thoughts on the matter." which is exactly what I'd done and he replied with the paywall! Now, I realise I may have been naive to think the service would remain free but I object to the language telling you to "feel free to reach out with questions" when they won't respond unless you pay for one of their packages.  They don't even guarantee results.  Some of the (more expensive) packages pledge a free 2nd rewrite (note this is NOT the same as a refund!) if you don't get 2x the number of interviews within 60 days!! SIXTY days!  They obviously don't have a lot of faith in their own services if they're not willing to refund you if you don't get results sooner than that and I would question if they're doing a great job the 1st time round if they think a "2nd rewrite" would help!When I re-read his original review, it also seemed generic in places like it came from a template e.g. he advised me to remove the start and end dates of my university years to avoid ageism but they weren't even on my CV, so this was obviously a copy / paste from somewhere else.Reading some of the reviews on here, I gather that results are mixed, so I don't think I'll be investing the €129 for a full rewrite just yet.   Even if their services are genuine and worth the money, they're great at making it sound like a scam.

records.title: I received my cv quite quickly and was…
records.text: I received my cv quite quickly and was generally happy with it and only wanted a few changes. I mentioned I needed it back for a certain date. I did not hear back for over a week, with multiple emails to the cv writer and the customer support. After a week I got a reply, they seemed to be very quick at reply once I had complained. Most of the replies we basically dodging what I had been saying and just giving me generic apologies and not taking responsibility. I would not use again as it is very expensive and I'd expect a more personalised service with better communication.

records.title: Good CV but costly experience
records.text: The CV is great albeit still to receive any job feedback from applications sent Cost wise though I do find it very very expensive for what you actually get , I'm no better off from my old CV but out of pocket which isn't great when out of work at the moment ....my own fault for falling weak and desperate I guess to tey help myself Personal opinion may I add

records.title: Fast turnaround but not seeing a benefit yet
records.text: I’m really happy with the speed of the process and the communication throughout.However it has been a couple weeks and has yet to yield me any results. I have been frantically applying for jobs since being made redundant and have not had any increase in return since the new CV went out. If anything my rejections are happening more frequently. It’s still early, but the early signs are not good

records.title: The review of my CV was helpful, but missed the point.
records.text: The review of my CV was helpful, but it failed to note that I am looking for an accountant position. It seems to think I'm looking for a hotel desk clerk job simply because it is listed in the work history. I thought I made that clear enough in the personal statement that I am a newly graduated accounting student looking for an accountant position. Maybe it is not clear enough? Maybe I'm doing something wrong, but I don't see how I can "bolster" my bullets;  One doesn't usually have any quantifiable achievements in these low-level, blue-collar jobs.

records.title: I paid £197 for an "Executive Priority…
records.text: I paid £197 for an "Executive Priority CV Writing Package" that turned out to be nothing like what was advertised. As a result, I had to rewrite the CV myself.Late to reply, however, a new writer has been assigned.

records.title: Average CV
records.text: The cv was well constructed however it did take three drafts. Also I think that the money I had paid for my CV the writer would have used the UK spell checker and not the US one which I then had to go back over the CV myself to correct which I did think was a bit poor. Having said that the CV is good. I also felt at some points hence the additional drafts the writer did not always take into consideration my asks and the writer pigeonholed me into one area.

records.title: New CV is good but
records.text: I’m happy with the CV they done for me except I have had multiple interview offers in the time it took for it to be written based on my original CV which they told me wasn’t very good. As good as the the new one is I wish I didn’t bother. I’d have given 4-5 stars based off the CV and the communication throughout etc but I don’t think my original CV is as bad as they said it was to get me to pay them to write it.

records.title: High Service Charges
records.text: I like the CV writer he did his job professionally. But I don't like the cost of the service its a bit expensive as compared to the market

records.title: Use it for inspiration, but never as-is
records.text: While there were some benefits to having TopCV creating an optimised CV (e.g. more focus on bullet points, more consistent use of 3rd person, etc) what you lose is your own voice and authenticity. And if you're in a highly technical field, you need to keep checking what they write as it may not make sense or it might have been re-interpreted in a why which mischaracterise it. In the end, I created my own version taking inspiration from the TopCV version, but retaining as much as possible of my own "voice" and narration style.To be a bit more objective, I asked one of my recruiter acquaintances to give me feedback and they said they've seen many like it, with the same font, same colours and styles, the same sort of phrases and could tell it was written by such a service. So while you might think you get a better CV from your point of view, it will not do what it's meant to do: once a human starts reading it you won't stand out, but you'll be lost in the crowd of similar CVs. Thus, recruiters and managers do not get to see "you".

records.title: Depends who they allocate to you
records.text: My first CV was a jumbled bunch of jargonistic nonsense, seemingly written by a CHATGP designed exclusively by David Brent from the Office. Had I had Sylvia, who started again for me after much insistence that I wasn't going to accept what they had provided, this would have been a five star review. The business seriously needs to vet their staff and their work, given that when you buy you are agreeing to no refunds regardless of what garbage they send to you (mine was in no way fit for purpose) If they were all as good and as thorough as Sylvia, they would be on to something. My top tip is do not accept a chat GP doc. You will know one as soon as you see it and this seems to be what they churn out in the first instance. Sylvia, for you personally however 5****** (She also kindly extended my revision period when I was taken ill but no further help needed. I could make any minor alterations myself using her style and layout She was that good!)

records.title: I was offered a 'free' review of my CV
records.text: I was offered a 'free' review of my CV, which I got.  It seemed very formulaic, to the point that it didn't appear relevant to my CV.  There were inconsistencies.Then I was encouraged to engage with them for more of their services.  It is clearly a sales ploy and I was not inclined to engage any further.

records.title: Benefit of the doubt here
records.text: Benefit of the doubt here, thus the 3* versus shooting for the typical 1* review.I believe the initial scan/review is done by an automated system which does not take into account detail required for executive positions.  Granted this is a free service so expected.  I suspect the focus of that automation is on achieving a high score for industry standard 'ATS' software.  Perhaps there is some value in pursuing this route, but my thoughts are that this would be for more junior positions.  I could be mistaken but this is my feeling on the output given, and my experience in also being the active recruiter (second stage, after sanity check by resourcing team) many positions in my current role.

records.title: You will have to proofread it yourself
records.text: It was quick but unfortunately there we so many typos and clash of tenses, it was not proofread and I even used it on one job application. I was disappointed when I took a close look to me CV. not work 115 euros!

records.title: Efficient service but too soon to say
records.text: Quick efficient service, my CV and LI look refreshed but until I started getting some traction i.e. interviews, it’s impossible to give a rating beyond satisfactory.

records.title: Driving car
records.text: My name Nawabzada 54 from Pakistan city Karachi

records.title: I was happy with the end result but I…
records.text: I was happy with the end result but I thought the process could be improved. I was sent a draft CV and 2 other draft documents (LinkedIn Profile & Cover Letter) all at the same time. I made comments/changes to the CV as part of the review process. These comments were incorporated into the CV but they were not incorporated into the other two documents (which are based on the CV). My suggestion would be that the CV is finalised before the other documents are produced (reducing the amount of checking and editing).Also in my case, an assumption made that I might want to apply for a different (additional) role and a portion of my CV catered to this other role. Unfortunately, the other role was never something that I would want to pursue and as a result, I feel that I will have to make some more adjustments to the final version of my CV to ensure the focus is in the correct place.

records.title: The process was really easy and the…
records.text: The process was really easy and the writer was so good. I had lots of contact with the writer and this helped to create a great product. The only negative was cross selling which I found tedious.

records.title: poor execution
records.text: While their method seems good in theory, the execution has been quite poor in my experience. Specifically, when I asked for visibility on key aspects of my career that they considered less relevant, they disregarded these points. Essentially, if they can't fit your experience into certain keywords, they shift focus elsewhere. I pointed this out to my writer, but she responded in an arrogant and patronizing manner.

records.title: Overall not worth the money
records.text: Bought the CV builder and initially had good contact with the writer. It's however more or less impossible to edit anything in your final document without whole formatting is affected (not looking professional). Also, you'd have some days together with your editor but be aware that it's typically 1-2 full days (in my case mostly 2 full days) before you get an answer. From there the writer needs to amend changes which again easily could take 1-2 full days. Not much when TopCV only gives you 5 days to edit with your writer.

records.title: Thanks to the reviews on here I won't be wasting my money.
records.text: Once again, I'm glad I took the time to read the reviews on here.I've used my CV in the same format for years, It's always generated the interest I wanted. TopCV's review slated it and told me the exact same thing they appear to be telling just about everyone else. Reading through the reviews on here, both positive and negative, I see the same responses from TopCV over and over again, almost as though they've been copied and pasted from a list. Over and over again people refer to AI having written a CV which does not align with their expectations. The internet seems to have become overrun by people providing sub standard goods and services at inflated prices. I've been stung before and am very sceptical about putting anything of any value in the hands of faceless 'service' providers.Like everything else in life, if I do decide to have my CV professionally rewritten I will find an actual person who I can interact with face to face.

records.title: Price doesn't justify the average results.
records.text: There were some good aspects. But some parts of the CV writing were lazy - spelling mistakes, reusing things from my old CVs, repetitive language and not enough knowledge in my field. I will use some of the copy and structure but not what I expected for the price tag when I opted for the more premium option.

records.title: I found the service was not very…

Silly mistakes likes using dollars Instead of using pounds when mentioning money even though in the U.K. Even after stating this the same mistake was make for my LinkedIn profile.final draft had a comment left in and I had to remove this, I complained about this but no response. I did not feel I got value for money or a personal service.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: They advertise on their website that they will make your CV pass the ATS but when you scan the CV they have done for you through their CV critique you will hear that your CV is poor and needs to be redone... it actually received the same score as my own original CV. None of the emails asking for clarification have been answered. The CV is a very simple format and 'smell like' GPT and unfortunately, when you upload it to Indeed or the like, it will not be read correctly and you will have to update the fields manually anyway.

records.title: A waste of time and money, all AI generated.
records.text: I chose the CV and Cover letter package. The service was really slow, I had to wait over a week for my first draft which turned out to be really weak and needed so much tweaking. I'm pretty sure it was AI generated as every change I asked for was taken literally and I had to specifically guide the changes. It didn't feel like the 'person' I was speaking to had any valuable experience in writing CVs. After doing a free webinar elsewhere I found out that my new CV wouldn't pass ATS as it had columns and different font styles and sizes. I pretty much re-wrote and re-formatted the documents I was given as I got tired of going back and forth and doing most of the hard work. A waste of money.

records.title: Pretty sure my re-write was chat gpt job
records.text: I was lured to this company because of their analysis of my CV. I was really impressed by their write-up and thought I'd give this a shot, since it's been a while since I last looked for a job. A first draft of my CV came back days after I filled in the survey. My CV is now full of a keyword that just scream chat gpt: 'orchestrated', 'diverse markets', 'lead dynamic team'. It's also fully in En US and every other word is capitalised. Sincerely disappointed as I was really hoping it was worth the price - but I guess it depends on the people that they give your CV out to.

records.title: Save your money.
records.text: MY CV looks like it has been put into an AI bot. It MAY get through an ATS checker but I seriously doubt any human would subsequently find it very readable or relatable to me. After having my doubts, I took it to a professional (human) CV writer who I discussed it with over the phone and he absolutely tore it to shreds. I feel like I have been ripped off.
