The humans are excellent even if the website is very cryptic! Meanwhile good rates of interest offered across a range of different accounts.

records.title: Cardiff City Centre branch Kiwi…
records.text: I visited the Cardiff City Centre Branch yesterday to get a 3 year bond that had matured transferred to a 2 year bond.The assistant Michelle made the whole experience a joy when compared to my "online" attempt. Please keep branches open and employ nice people, Michelle is from Christchurch New Zealand and a pleasure to deal with.

records.title: A very difficult website.
records.text: After difficulty using the Leeds Building Society website on 2 separate occasions I finally resorted to ringing.Costa was unfailingly friendly and helpful. He resolved my instructions for a maturing account and identified the problem I was having. It was not my fault.Therefore 5 stars for Costa and 2 stars for the LBS!

records.title: How about offering interest monthly ?
records.text: We use Leeds Building Society because they used to offer excellent savings rates & they have a Branch local to us. Our one complaint is that savings interest is only paid annually. For the past few years, we have 'leaned' towards the likes of Coventry B.S. & Kent & Reliance, as they both offer monthly interest payments.Excellent ,polite service from your Harrison in your Banbury Branch today.

records.title: Recently changed mortgage product as…
records.text: Recently changed mortgage product as about to go onto variable rate. Informed well in advance by LBS and options explained. Chose to stay with LBS and easy to access available products as an existing customer. Had one query which we used telephone support to seek answer and it was answered very professionally and friendly. Easy to understand. Product completed quickly with follow up letter received and email. Third time we have used and would recommend.

records.title: Good Telephone answering services
records.text: Leeds Building Society offered a better customers services than many big banks . I had email them about a  problem using online . The reply was within 48 hours . Then a member of staff ( Alan ) called . He was exceptionally courteous and did his best to address the problem . I have also used the telephone services and one can get through within a reasonable time .From Su

records.title: Customer Service
records.text: After a very difficult start with an online account and the intervention of Leanne, customer services, I finally managed to open and deposit monies into the account. It took me 4 times to open the online account, logged out each time with a technical error.  Rang customer services, who were very helpful.  This has taken several hours this morning, for something that should have taken 15 minutes. Please keep branches open and have these accounts available in branch.  Branch staff are fantastic.

records.title: Good service
records.text: Branch manager was friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. Only downside was she was tied up with another customer when I went in, and the cashier suggested coming back "later in the day". When I asked when, the cashier said they didn't have appointments. Fortunately, the manager became free at that moment, but it seems pretty daft telling people to come back on the off-chance and being unable to make an appointment. That could go on forever, and I doubt many customers would bother to come back a third time.

records.title: I recently closed an Easy Access…
records.text: I recently closed an Easy Access Account and cannot believe that they send out my monies by cheque.Normally this would be paid back to a nominated account.I wonder if I was opening an account in this day and age if they would accept a cheque for the deposits??

records.title: No App
records.text: I recently joined Leeds building society as I try to only use mutuals for my savings. I'm sure we will get on well.  My only reason for giving a low star rating is that they do not have a banking app yet.  I have a dedicated older phone that stays at home that I use like a tablet and only use for banking apps, so I'm able to use biometrics to access all my accounts using apps.  This is 10 times faster than having to type in pin numbers or work out random letters from passwords etc.   I try not to use institutions who don't have banking apps for my own convenience.  As a mutual I'll put up with the inconvenience of no app for a while, but please launch your app soon to join the 21 century.  I fully appreciate that Leeds is a smaller institution and will take longer to get around to this, because app security is of paramount importance and financial institutions need to get it  absolutely right, so delays are fair enough. Try to work on this please Leeds.  I'll obviously upgrade this review when appropriate.

records.title: Not quite the experience I am used to
records.text: Not quite the experience I am used to as I was given incomplete/incorrect information by one adviser and when I called back to speak to a second adviser to get the correct information, the adviser was a bit lacklustre and seemed reluctant to give her name. I was not filled with confidence at all.

records.title: A positive experience
records.text: I went into your Southampton store intending to close ny account but without any hard pressure sales talk on the part of Kam, your representative,  I left with a 2-year ISA and am more than happy with the decision.Thank you very much

records.title: Good interest rates but clumsy and outdated systems.
records.text: My wife & I were wanting to set up a joint savings account for the first time with the Leeds Building Society but found the process of adding the second person to be clumsy, confusing and inconvenient.  This could not be done as part of opening the account on line (as has been possible with other savings providers for a good number of years now) but required paper forms to be printed and submitted by post, along with certified copies of identity documents.  In order to obtain such copies without incurring costs, we had to make a special journey to our nearest branch office.  Furthermore, the downloaded and printed forms were ambiguous and largely inappropriate for the purpose, with confusing instructions for completion.It was good to find the branch office empty of other customers and we were attended to immediately on arrival.  However, the member of staff who dealt with us could have been friendlier and gave us different instructions to those we had printed from the web-site and which we fortunately had with us, so it was us who had to provide the information as per the website.  We were provided with a pre-paid envelope to send our paperwork to head office but this showed a different post code to that given on the web-site and so further double-checking was required.  It was apparently the case that only Head Office could carry out the required identity confirmation, this not being possible in branch.Having posted the paperwork, the approval and means to activate the second person's on-line access arrived by post within the week.  The activation on-line was straightforward and successful, though there were further inconsistencies in information between the web-site and the letter received (ie 'Activation Code' on-line was 'PIN' by letter and it was not under a 'scratch-off red panel' as stated on-line.So we got there in the end but the building society needs to put considerably greater care and effort into ensuring its information, forms and instructions are correct, clear and matched to the task and it sorely needs to update its on-line systems to modern and more convenient standards, which are less frustrating and time-consuming for its customers.

records.title: Nice staff, slow and archaic systems
records.text: I needed to move the savings I had in a cash ISA with another building society, as the interest rate had fallen to a paltry amount. Leeds were offering a competitive rate so I opened an account with the minimum amount (£1,000) to try it out.For an online ISA the technology (or lack of) is astounding. I had to wait for them to post an activation code before I could use the account online! I've read somebody saying you need to go into a branch to reset your password. Everything is so slow. I decided to move my money into a more modern ISA, but even that took two phone calls and three weeks before they'd let the money go.It's also worth bearing in mind that Leeds don't offer a flexible ISA. If you take money out and put it back it counts towards your annual £20k allowance twice. Another annoyance is that interest is paid annually - it's much nicer to see your savings grow every day. In fact you can't see much at all without logging on as they don't have a working Open Banking API.The staff I dealt with were all polite and helpful, but their systems need to be brought into the 21st century. I hate it when my money disappears for days on end.

records.title: Frustrated
records.text: Savings interest rates competitive and never had any issues in Leeds branch,which has been very quiet when i've visited. My big problem has been getting through on the phone which is very very difficult,frustratingly so and customer service nearly as bad,call back is also very poor.I live about 40 miles away so can't just pop in. Branch is very quiet with numerous staff, why can't they pick up the phone,it's very disappointing.

records.title: Old School Cheque Deposits!
records.text: Firstly - I am grateful that LBS accepted my mortgage application. I bought a new build home in a completely new large development on ex farmland. They were the only lender not so “fussy.” Everything went smoothly online. Communication, account opening, payments etc - all brilliant. So good that I opened a savings account with them online. Plus their interest rate is really good. Again opening an account, depositing monies, communication brilliant. But for a 21st century modern banking institution - to transfer your savings to another bank without charges can only be done via cheque?!? This is extraordinary (& not in a good way I hasten to add!) for a modern financial institution. I have to submit my request online, then wait for old school cheque to be sent to my home. Then have to trek with said cheque to my other bank to deposit. In total around a week to get it credited to my other account. Why can’t we do all this online like all the other financial institutions do?Why not have a banking app?! So backward.That’s my gripes. Over and out.

records.title: Attitude problem.
records.text: I have a savings account and only deal with Leeds BS online or by 'phone. Their online account access and functionality is a little clunky and laborious but still satisfactory. Sadly, my experience of speaking to staff members on the 'phone is less than satisfactory. The male staff members in particular (who all seem to be from the North East) have a real attitude problem. I don't know why and have concluded that maybe it's because I have a southern accent (although born in Yorkshire) or perhaps they resent that I have savings! Either way, it's unwelcome.I'd like to move accounts for the above reason alone but their rate is competitive, so I'm stuck, unless I'm prepared to take a hit. I'll keep a look out for a viable alternative provider.

records.title: On-line interest rates
records.text: My wife and I have separate Online access ISA's.Leeds does NOT advise us when interest rates rise.This is left to us visiting Leeds BS website or The Times  money section, to keep our accounts earning best interest..When we request Leeds on-line to change interest rate on our accounts in line with current interest rates this usually occurs within a week. HOWEVER  on this last occassion my wifes account has still not been updated after 14 days.   Admittedly change of interest rate is backdated to date of request.I guess more INFORMATION to clients on-line would be very helpful.   Peter Broster

records.title: On line savings
records.text: On line savings - it works. Just. It's clunky and always reminds me of Postman Pat and classic Emmerdale with hints of Heartbeat. I imagine their IT guy as a skinny 65 year old with a grey pony tail a black shirt and leather waistcoat. I bet their toilet still has a pull chain.I swear, if you go to their contacts: under 'mail' they give a postal address 😂 and the ethos is still one of ring us or call into a branch! It's 2024 fgs

records.title: the bank lacks an ios app
records.text: the bank lacks an ios app and the website is not very easy to navigate on a phone browser. Something as simple as checking your balance and transferring money to your linked account is quite cumbersome via your phone, so much so I am thinking of closing my account in the near future and transferring my money to marcus, who have an easily usable app.

records.title: Poorly designed user interface
records.text: Possibly the most poorly designed user Interface of any bank I have come across. Website seriously needs updating and a complete redesign.The don't have an App! this would have been acceptable 5 years ago, but its 2023, come on LBS.Had some issues logging in last night and had to wait until the call centres were open in the morning.  24/7 support would be nice, but not expected with all banks / building societies.  In fairness, customer support over the phone was friendly.

records.title: Paltry interest rates
records.text: Have always found our local branch and the staff to be most helpful, but why do easy access interest rates continue to be deplorable?  Compared with other saving institutions I like the branch Im pleased with staff but someone in a grey suit in a swanky office dictates the miniscule interest Rates

records.title: Not great information flow
records.text: Leeds BS did not inform me that a better instant ISA rate was available, on "New Issue" of essentially the same product. So I had to read it in a newspaper. Then open new ISA and secure message Leeds to get my balance transferred over. I would prefer that LBS did this proactively by advising me by secure message. Once messaged it happened OK.

records.title: Needs to be clearer about ISA transfer restrictions
records.text: I am fortunate enough to have some assets in a Stocks and Shares ISA which I wanted to transfer to a Leeds Cash ISA.  I went all the way through the on-line application process, only to find at the very last stage that Leeds will not allow only PART of the Stocks and Shares ISA to be transferred, which is what I wanted.  Therefore I abandoned application.  This restriction is not clear enough from reading terms and conditions.  Now Leeds is badgering me to activate an on-line account which it thinks I have set despite not having a user name or password, so I can't access the account to close it!

records.title: We had multiple letters and messages…
records.text: We had multiple letters and messages telling us we had not completed necessary documents or paid the fee, after all had been completed, and after cheque had been cashed. Each time I called to check I was told all was ok. Then I receive another letter. Very very distressing and disappointing.

records.title: Withdrawal by cheque is not acceptable.
records.text: While I have had no problems in the past with depositing money online, this is the first time I have wanted to make a withdrawal. I had the option of transferring to another Leeds B. S. account or accepting a cheque. They do not appear to be able to use the "Faster Payments" system which most financial institutions which I have dealt with do, but offer a CHAPS payment after you fill in a form and make a payment of £20. In this day and age executing a withdrawal by way of a cheque is just not acceptable and i will not be placing any more money with the Leeds B.S.

records.title: Good but could be better …
records.text: Called Leeds for a Certificate of Loan interest for BTL mortgage as this is required for our tax returns. Waited 2 days and they sent a mortgage statement only. Had called 4 other lender the same day, they emailed the docs and gave me the figure over the phone also. Leeds said “because of their new system, they were unable to email”

records.title: Not overly impressed
records.text: Spoke to a lady on the phone yesterday (I think in Newcastle) and she lost her patience with me when I was asking for a transfer. And also telling me incorrect username information then blaming me for getting it wrong online when in fact she’d told me it wrong in the first place. I found her manner to be quite rude. In the end I got the result I wanted which was to have some money transferred back to my account so there was no need for any of it!

records.title: Pointless
records.text: Responded quickly - unfortunately, they ignored my actual question. They then ignored my reply. I only wanted to know what interest rate applied to a specific account, so it shouldn't have been that difficult.

records.title: Better online accounts out there
records.text: The online account I have is very un user friendly. The Lloyds and tsb are far easier to to use . Taken days to find out how to transfer some of my money out,  the site doesn’t support safari , had to use Crome . Pop up boxes appear on safari and then you can’t access the bits you want . Had to keep ringing help line .

records.title: I was disappointed that my secure log…
records.text: I was disappointed that my secure log in details were so easily changed by a hacker. I had thought that having provided obscure security answers my account was protected.However I did find the people who dealt with my problem were very professional.

records.title: Unable to apply for product as existing customer
records.text: I am a mortgage customer, and tried to take out a savings account. The process asks you to login, at which point it takes you on a circular journey which never actually enables you to apply for an account.

records.title: Online access very slow to setup and…
records.text: Online access very slow to setup and clunky generally.Opened a savings account online. The security side of it is horrible to navigate and a bit like going back in time 5-10 years. (You have to enter lots of memorable info and put in selected characters from your password. Pretty near impossible to get right if you have long random passwords!) You can pay in money immediately but it takes up to 10 days (post) to get access to your account online. Wish I'd not done it now.

records.title: All I wished to do was remove my ex…
records.text: All I wished to do was remove my ex husband from our joint mortgage - he no longer has any financial claim on the property. I have the security to repay the current fixed rate agreement, and even though I intend to retire at the end of this term, can pay off the balance with my lump sum. Your advisor, although I know she has to give all options, would not entertain this solution, insisting I could not afford it on my retirement income. I felt forced to continue with the existing deal, with the risk that my ex could change his mind and demand assets from the property.I felt as though I was not being listened to and all that was wanted was to make me review or replace my mortgage, which would result in it being unaffordable for me. I did not need extra stress as going through a divorce is enough.

records.title: Customer Service not helpful
records.text: I could not remember the security questions for my account and was told I have to go into a Leeds Building Society office with identification before I can reset.  There is not an office on the Isle of Wight and so I have to send to an office on the mainland.  Surely there is another way of resetting password rather than go through the bother of sending something through the post?  All this for a £1k investment which I will be taking out.

records.title: No App!! Poor access
records.text: Ridiculously complicated log in procedure and even worse experience trying to withdraw monies. Can’t get instant access, have to wait for someone to decide to get round to doing it for me. No online app either, unlike all other banks and building societies so can’t withdraw money via an app nor keep easy track on my accounts. Have closed my accounts and gone elsewhere

records.title: Great to talk to real people!
records.text: Great to talk to real people!I chose the LSB Peterborough Branch to take out a new ISA. I received excellent service from Louise who was so professional, friendly and helpful in explaining everything clearly to me, she went above and beyond her customer service skills and is a credit to your Company. A special thank you also to Chelsey who dealt with my husband on a previous occasion, she was also all of the above! Thanks to all your friendly staff.

records.title: Time to Transfer Money
records.text: Went in just after opening time to ask for a large money transfer from my cash Isa. This was to be sent to a bank account in my name, disappointed to lose £68 interest but thats the T&C's. I was told it would be a speedy transfer which could take upto the end of the working day tomorrow, but could well be in by the end of this working day. So it hasn't arrived yet so don't know why they would class it as a speedy transfer! I can't understand how if I transfer / pay someone it can be done straight away, but a big company can't manage this. The building society replied but didn't explain why it takes the length of time or why it can only happen during business hours?

description: Lodge Brothers are an independent, employee owned funeral service. 7 generations of our family have been helping local families in their time of need. For 240 years we have provided funerals, both modern & traditional, with reverence and compassion, for all faiths and the non-religious. We can facilitate cremations, burials, direct cremations and remembrance services. We bring our Lodge difference to every service offered including our own legal team (providing wills, probate and lasting POAs) and our highly skilled masons providing unique memorials, inscriptions and design work. We have a dedicated Funeral Plan Team who can help with planning for the future with a funeral plan or funeral wishes. We also supply floral tributes, Orders of Service, cremation urns and keepsake jewellery.

records.title: Compassionate & professional
records.text: From the first phone call on the day my Mum died Lodge Brothers were amazing.Very compassionate & professional, which is exactly what’s needed when the worst should happen.From the collection of my deceased mum, the organisation of the funeral service & the aftercare I can’t fault in any way.Thank you to the whole team for looking after us at such a sad time.

records.title: My Dad had a pre paid funeral plan…
records.text: My Dad had a pre paid funeral plan which I think probably made things a lot easier for us.  Susi at your Feltham office was really helpful and understanding to our needs. I also personally found the hugs she gave me were very comforting.                                                      The only thing we were disappointed with was the fact that Chapel of Rest viewing was only for one day.

records.title: Excellant Service
records.text: The funeral arranger was wonderful very supportive and kind took me though step by step what was required. Excellent service. I was very happy with funeral and service all the members of Lodge Brothers that I dealt with were lovely. Would recommend to friends and other family members.

records.title: An excellent service from a friendly and professional team
records.text: Elaine and the team at Lodge Brothers Sunningdale looked after our Mum's funeral recently, and were absolutely top-notch. Elaine was thoughtful, kind and friendly from start to finish, thinking of all sorts of details that made the funeral personal and professional. The brochure made choosing all the details very straightforward too, everything was clearly laid out and accurate.Daniel and his team were spot-on on the day as well. Everyone made a tough and emotional task as simple and painfree as possible. A huge thank you to you all (and Hazel, the excellent celebrant that Elaine chose for us) for all your help.

records.title: Dad's funeral
records.text: From my initial enquiry through to the funeral, Lodge Brothers were very professional, sympathetic and treated what is a very sensitive and difficult time with a great deal of care and respect. Jo was very helpful in planning the details of the funeral and organising the day. I was particularly touched by the little extras, such as the coffin bearers wearing claret and blue ties in memory of my father's football team WHU.

records.title: This family run business really cares…
records.text: This family run business really cares about your welfare, they are professional, considerate and kind in what are some of the darkest times. From start to finish, they guided and supported us through the process of my Mum's passing and handled our celebration of life ceremony with grace, calm and great consideration. We would highly recommend them

records.title: Everything was taken care of expertly
records.text: Everything was taken care of expertly. Jo in the Walton office took us through all of the key decisions we needed to make in a very caring and thoughtful way. All the arrangements were carried out as we requested to perfection.

records.title: As funerals go this was perfect
records.text: As funerals go this was perfect. Jo Sutton, at West Byfleet office arranged everything to our family’s complete satisfaction.Although it was a very sad and stressful time for us she was there for us understanding our sadness and arranged everything to our agreed plan. Well done Jo.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Sadly we’ve had to use the services of Lodge Brothers twice within 12 months and Chris could not have been kinder. She organised everything and we didn’t have to worry about a thing.Would recommend to anyone who needs their services.

records.title: Absolutely brilliant
records.text: Absolutely brilliant , professional from the first phone call , respectful , helpful , knowledgeable, kind , organised everything , just perfect . We have used for lots of family funerals so I wouldn’t have gone anywhere else when my husband passed away . Just a massive thank you for making such an emotional day be so effortless for us . The drivers the cars the care the professionalism just everything was brilliant

records.title: Everything was soundly handled, save for transport.
records.text: Everything was soundly handled, but on the day of the funeral, no account had been taken of traffic and the mourners were denied the opportunity to travel in convoy with the hearse. Both "senior" mourner having to travel separately, only arriving a minute prior to the commencement of the service and unable to calmly greet other mourners and the like.

records.title: Practically Perfect
records.text: I would. Have awarded you five stars except for a little confusion on the morning of the funeral over where the hearse should be and the location of the photograph that was to be placed on the coffin.

records.title: Lodge Brothers did an excellent send off.
records.text: Lodge Brothers gave my mum a great send off, I couldn’t fault them on the day of the service.I had a few challenges with them, and they went above what was required to sort the situation. My challenges were nothing serious, just a few misunderstandings in communication.  They have taken note and will take this into consideration in the future.I would definitely use them again, when the need arose.

records.title: Thank you Gina
records.text: Gina was absolutely fabulous, really helpful, kind, and very thoughtful. It was unfortunate about the lovely coffin Gina organised but nothing anyone could do about that really also  the people watching from overseas could not see the photos that were revolving on the screen during the service because there is a beam blocking the view of the camera, not sure if that can be altered , and the flowers didn’t get put in the places I had asked, not too much of a problem. The conductor and his crew looked fabulous in their pink ties Mrs h’s favourite colour. In the great scheme of things it was a lovely funeral and we thank you all. Kind regards, yours eventually Jan 🌻

records.title: So pleased we chose Lodge Brothers to take care of Dad’s funeral.
records.text: Lodge Brothers Customer Service was second to none. Alison looked after us and did a stirling job of guiding us through our options and prompting us during the process when we had Dad on our mind. The team was extremely professional and made us feel that things would be taken care of if we weren’t on the ball. There was an oversight made by Lodge Brothers in Guildford which was fully resolved. Otherwise our rating would have been five stars.

records.title: A Pleasant Experience
records.text: Both of the ladies were extremely helpful and caring. They went through the process efficiently and gave valuable assistance and advice. Good communication and provided regular feedback. Any errors were rectified immediately. Would like to see moreflexible packages. Used Lodge Bros as they advertise and support my bowling club (Burpham Bowling Club.)

records.title: Angela in the office was super helpful…
records.text: Angela in the office was super helpful in setting things up and in communicating with me.I was disappointed that the website header insisted on the wording. Although the family celebrated my dad's life it was impossible to edit the words which said it was with sadness.... - I don't know why this was impossible to change hence the 4 stars

records.title: Have used twice and would use again
records.text: From the ladies in the office to the gents on the day, everyone was wonderful and almost everything was seamless. One small issue was some of the agreed flowers were not available and I was only made aware of this the day before the funeral, however, alternatives were arranged and it still looked lovely.

records.title: The people were very kind and helpful
records.text: The people were very kind and helpful. Particularly the men who came to collect my aunt's body from our home in the early hours of the morning and those transporting us to the crematorium. The office staff were very supportive taking us through the various aspects of the funeral which made the funeral itself to smoothly at such a sad time.

records.title: Overconfident, not enough attention to detail
records.text: The first contact was very good, friendly and efficient. Very clear information and good list of options. Transparent service. A couple of things upset me a bit. When the funeral director rang me the afternoon before the funeral, he thought we were going to carry the coffin, mix up with another funeral probably because that was never discussed. Secondly, the hearse and cars went to the wrong address with the same postcode. I had made a particular point of explaining the problem with the postcode when I booked the funeral so I was angry about that. Lastly, instructions had been given to the stone mason, never discussed with me.

records.title: Funeral Jean Hewitt 21 July 2023
records.text: Funeral Jean Hewitt 21 July 2023As I live in Australia I was not able to be at Jean's funeral, so I cannot comment on the service. Everything appears to have gone smoothly. Jackie was very helpful, keeping me informed of proceedings.John Peterson

records.title: The staff in the Ashford Branch were both helpful and professional.
records.text: The staff in the Ashford branch were very helpful and professional. Two very minor points, it would have helped if we had a latest date for the order of service print run. This was because we were contacted very late into the time frame by the minister conducting the funeral service. I saw the minister the evening before the order of service print deadline, to discuss a number of isssues that there was little time to mull over. Also the minister did not see the family words of rememberence. I had to give a hard copy, printed off on the morning of the funeral. That said, the funeral went very well.

records.title: Good Service
records.text: Overall, Lodge Brothers provided a very good service: well-organised and sensitive to my needs.I did object to one aspect of the organisation (setting up a page for charitable donations without asking me), but this was resolved quite speedily.They're not the cheapest, but can certainly be relied upon to do a good job.

records.title: Staff were sympathetic and professional…
records.text: Staff were sympathetic and professional and everything went well without a problem. I only have one constructive criticism and that is that we ended up dealing with three different staff and this made things slightly repetitive otherwise all good. Very good MC on the day

records.title: Lodge Brothersi were so supportive and…
records.text: Lodge Brothersi were so supportive and compassionate to me on the death of my Sister.I was very grateful for all the help and advice regarding all aspects of the funeral.I really appreciated  the phone call on the evening before to reassure me that all was ready Also I loved the touch  of putting a single rose from her floral basket onto the coffin.

records.title: My Dad's funeral
records.text: Quite honestly the service was superb. I would have given you 5 stars had it not been for the fact that the wrong music was played as we exited (I had very specifically asked for the song Oklahoma but instead they played the overture - probably no one else attending would have realised but I'm afraid it had meant a lot to me to have that particular song played for my Dad and the opportunity has now gone). Apart from that everything else went fine and Annie was incredibly helpful.

records.title: They helped with local cemetery in…
records.text: They helped with local cemetery in exuming a three plot grave for a family burial which saved on costs , the service went well

records.title: As soon as  Mum/Nan/Wife passed Lodge…
records.text: As soon as  Mum/Nan/Wife passed Lodge took her into their care and treated her with much love and care and made everything easy and comfortable for us and they done all we asked for Thank you   I would have given 5 if the donation link was better more donations would have been made

records.title: I have some history of the company
records.text: I have some history of the company.  (I was born in Feltham where it started) We have had several funerals with Lodge Bros.

records.title: A very difficult time for me made a lot…
records.text: A very difficult time for me made a lot easier with your help and support

records.title: Mostly positive but
records.text: Initial office introduction friendly and supportive.Collecting the body from home efficient and dignified.Long wait to funeral date primarily due to vicar availability.Disappointment was being 2 pallbearers short at the start of the funeral, the reason for which seemed to vary as the day went on. Music at the church wasn’t working either. Not your fault but having my aunt wheeled in on a trolley to a buffering sound track was not what I wanted for her.

records.title: Mostly was done well except the…
records.text: Mostly was done well except the presentationof my mother in the chapel, i found it should have been better, i even asked the assistant for tissuesto wipe excess wax from eye and mouth, and i triedto apply lipstick which would not work because of the wax, it looked like mums hair was not washed or combed, i washed my mums hair in hospital and it came out better than that. there was a hiccupwith my music choice when i already stated what i wanted and was confirmed and was contacted again with days to go to the funeral to clarify the music which movement?  which caused me unnecessary distress, as this should have been sorted out, without my intervention.

records.title: Flowers wrongly placed.

records.title: Lodge Bros funeral experience.
records.text: I appreciate that having a funeral in the Covid 19 lockdown has been a very traumatic time for all families and for the staff of Lodge Bros in trying to manage expectations of the families and this the Sunbury branch did very well. On the day of the funeral the staff were very curtious with their help and guided us during the funeral process.I only have one issue with the whole experience and that was the payment. My mother had already arranged a funeral plan 2 years prior and the cost of the plan had almost been paid, however there was a demand that the remaining sum was to be paid long before the funeral was to take place and there was much communication and discussions I had for us to pay the remainder of the invoice 4 weeks after the funeral as shown in the small print on the invoice. Lodge Bros arguement was that as a funeral plan was used it was company policy that the remainder is paid before the funeral which proves difficult as all my late mothers accounts are frozen.As Lodge Bros had access to 80% of the cost this should place the customer in a far more convenient position rather than someone who had not taken out a plan. This therefore needs to be clear in the small print at the time of taking a plan out and also in the documention at the time of first contact and arranging the funeral.

Contact Us
Get Help and Support
Visit Our Website

Orbit is one of the UK’s foremost housing groups, managing a portfolio of quality, safe and affordable homes for over 100,000 customers. Socially driven and commercially minded, we are a not-for-profit committed to creating a better society, building affordable homes and communities, and to do so in more socially responsible and sustainable ways. 
For over 50 years, Orbit has been a force for positive change. We have a growing property portfolio of over 47,000 affordable and social rent homes across Midlands, East and South of England.
We support over 100,000 customers in differing stages of life, from those seeking their first home to customers looking for enhanced supported living and are one of the UK’s largest developers of affordable housing, building over 5,300 new homes by 2025. 
Learn More
Supporting Our Customers
Our Better Days programme offers support to help our customers maintain their tenancies, develop the skills to get back into work, access grants, apply for the benefits that they’re eligible for, and manage personal finances. 
As part of Better Days, we run Breathing Space, a mental health support service commissioned with Mind and Aspire4u, to support customers who are experiencing difficulties with mental health issues. This service aims to prevent problems occurring or worsening, tackling the causes rather than dealing with the consequences, with the ultimate goal of enabling our customers to be in control of their lives. 
Visit Better Days

records.title: Incompetence has cost us a dog rehoming
records.text: We have a roof that is crumbling and possibly leaking for almost 3 years, and nothing has been done about it.But this is not the worst part.Rehoming a dog is made deliberately difficult.First we contacted the online chat. We were told to write a letter stating we would like a dog, with details and signatures, and it would be dealt within 48 hours.3 days later we received a form to fill in.To re-home a dog with dogs trust requires prior permission from a landlord for obvious reasons. Orbit refuse to accept this and will not accept a pet permission form without a definite breed defined on it, despite being told - directly in an email from the relevant department directly - that this was not necessary, and to just leave this part blank.After asking a member of staff over the phone about this, she contradicted what dogs trust themselves told me and refused to accept it, and hung up on me.Speaking to another member of staff, I was told (more politely) that they do indeed require the breed to be listed, but she still did not believe dogs trust's restriction, however she did say that if we marked it as urgent it would be dealt with quickly.We have most likely now lost the opportunity to re-home the dog we had hoped to get as a result of these ridiculous policies.If the form was provided immediately and it was made clear that the breed was a required part of the form, this would not have happened.EDIT: now 7 hours following their response, I have not received a private message on trust pilot from them regarding this matter.UPDATE 28th August: further phone calls regarding the pet request were still met with resistance, until I demanded to speak with a manager.This proved to be spectacular. He seemed genuinely concerned at the conflicting information and inconsistent times we were given. He also put us through to a lovely manager who kept working past hours to get this sorted for us, and we even have a letter stating any dog is fine.If I receive any information about this process being improved I will increase the score of this review again, but unfortunately I cannot increase it more because these obstacles are still in place as far as I am aware.

About AlphaSights 

Founded in 2008, AlphaSights is the global leader in knowledge on-demand.  We connect investors and business leaders with experts who have subject-matter experience in a specific industry.  With 1500+ employees working across nine offices across the US, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, AlphaSights is powered by our people and is consistently rated “Excellent” here on Trustpilot.

 Our Client Service team members identify and engage subject-matter experts who can assist our clients in their market research. Interactions can take the form of calls, surveys, meetings, or longer-term advisories. AlphaSights experts range from C-suite executives to functional professionals to customers deeply familiar with the products or services of companies that our clients care about.

 When we believe your professional experience is of interest to one of our clients, you’ll receive a direct call or message from an Associate at AlphaSights. Whether you’re an executive, doctor, buyer, academic, engineer, or anything in between, your knowledge is unique and may be particularly helpful for our clients.

  If you are interested, please get back to the AlphaSights team member who contacted you  and they will gladly share more details and answer any remaining questions.

description:
There are lots of reasons why you might need a little help when buying a home and that’s where we come in.

Co-Ownership is a not-for-profit organisation that helps people become homeowners. We have three ways to help people: Co-Own, Co-Own for Over 55s and Rent to Own and Co-Own for Over 55s. Since 1978 we have helped over 32,000 people buy a home in Northern Ireland, and currently have over 10,000 co-owners.

We are a registered charity and are regulated and part funded by the Department for Communities.

records.title: Customer service could be improved
records.text: Although the filling of the application form and initial applying process was straightforward enough but after this there was no support in the process. The first property I had go sale agreed was uploaded onto the system and there was a few issues with the property and trying to find out what was happening involved me having to contact co ownership four times because I didn’t receive any kind of update but instead I received a type of automated response which didn’t answer my question and then told another three attempts from me to speak to somebody then nothing would happen for another two weeks and then I would contact co ownership myself again and had to start the whole process of explaining my query all over again. I had one update and I don’t think the process wouldn’t have moved in any direction had I not had myself to asked for updates. This property in the end wasn’t accepted but guess what no contact from co ownership about about what I needed to do next if I needed to start the whole process again. I ended up purchasing a new build property which although started wouldn’t be completed for five months again no support or customer service from co ownership after receiving the letter that the property had been accepted which stated an expiry date which was two weeks before the house was due to be completed when I received my final completion date I contacted co ownership myself again just to check that this would be ok and just to get clarity on some of the wording on the letter and who ever took the call gave a short brunt response and then said I could ask whatever questions I wanted after giving me the opinion that the question I had asked had a really obvious answer ????? It’s frustrating I think I was contacted by co ownership once by email in this whole process while I have just looked at my emails and i emailed twelve times and made four phone calls ?

records.title: And now for a seller's perspective.
records.text: Plenty of positive feedback from buyers but as a seller of houses I actively avoid co-ownership sales.  The process is too time-consuming and frustrating.  Weeks can evaporate waiting on a simple decision or response and the additional bureaucracy means completion takes at least twice as long as it normally should.  If it even happens at all.

records.title: Waste of time, don’t even bother
records.text: Seeing as I was buying first time I decided to give this a go. Phone call to be told my application would ‘likely’ be rejected due to a late payment, £100 application fee, but my luck it got accepted, give you 5 months to look for a house? Found my dream house, sale agreed,  found issues in the inspection,  give them a 3 week to fix it, rejected. So we’re already 10 weeks away from the deadline, so how am I meant to find another property in the next 10 weeks before meeting the deadline???? The issue in the house could’ve been resolved as I had planned for someone to look at it, but Co ownership does not allow this, £550 property assessment and £440 returned (which took a week to get refunded), who can actually be bothered with this type of stress?? Does this ‘charity’ think people have all the money in the world to waste on property assessments when trying to buy a house?? This is meant to be something to help people to get into the property ladder, but make it impossible to do so. So save your money kids and go for a mortgage, also a lot of vendors purposely avoid Co ownership applications because of the length of time ‘waste of time’ it takes to do applications. Btw, 1.8 million people in Northern Ireland and this only owns 10,000, meaning it’s not even 1% of them in NI. Do not be fooled . Edit: from the response, so in 10 weeks I’m meant to find a house, get sale agreed (most vendors avoid Co own) pay another £550 for an assessment, and then have to wait another 3 weeks for it to fall through? Is ir meant to be ping pong until the deadline to the point I don’t have a house in the end? Instead I’m wasting £200+ ? This is not worth the stress and the horror stories are to be believed.

I live in the flat above, so I know they didnt come.  After tenants moved out, only 3 big pieces of furniture due to their large size were left behind as they were too big to be stolen and it would be obvious.  My flat is still empty and bare, I have developed depression. No agency can help because of the state of the flat damaged by their sub-tenans. To add salt to injury, FCH who realised they couldn't let the flat anymore, unilaterally, terminated a 2 years contract (17 months left) which was without break-clause and without bringing my flat back to how it was initially and never brought my Designers' Guild curtains, lithographs, blinds, bed frames, dining table and chairs, rugs, etc, etc back. They didn't even give me a reasonable statutory notice.  They immediately stopped the rent. The most lousy agency I have ever come across. Please DON'T use them.

records.title: Landlords beware of this dishonest/scam business!
records.text: A Rogue, Deceitful and Unscrupulous Agency - Landlords please don't use this scam company -This company lies through their teeth to get control of your property. At first, I was hesitant dealing with FCH. They promised rent guarantee and to provide accommodation for families awaiting rehousing with the Local Authority. Their contract stipulates that they would not do anything without the landlords consent! This is all untrue. They claim they only make small adjustments and at the end reinstate the flat, also untrue.The next day after we signed the agreement, no inventory occured despite promises to the contrary.  Fortunately, I took many photos of items to FCH's disappointment. FCH then sent two stocky, rude and rough workers to throw away my fire resistant doors with porcelain knobs attached. Luckily, I live in the same building. I called F (FCH's director) and he said he would stop the disposal of the doors. I asked why they were taking the doors and F answered fire doors were needed.  I said mine were fire doors. He strangely, replied they were too fancy!  I thought it contradictory as the 5 remaining doors were the same type. He realised his mistake in removing my doors and said FCH would store them.They brought a tenant first with 3 children and an untrained noisy dog, which due to the owner not taking constantly barking dog out at all, fouled daily on my balcony and in my garden. So, I couldn't enjoy my outdoor space.I wrote a bad review at that point. F asked me to remove it and I said I wouldn't until the tenant was evicted. I had told them before that I was not allowed to let to tenants with pets, but this company simply doesn't care. They evicted her, so I removed my review.After a few days an Afghani couple moved in with their kids. I could hear the sound of breaking of beds in the morning and saw them in the patio cutting wood! In the afternoon, I watched in horror and took photos as evidence, when these tenants, undoubtedly unvetted, dumped all my flat's contents including Designer Guild curtains, silk and velvet curtains, lithographs, vintage nets, 3 rugs and every other fixture and fitting, all outside with the curtain poles too with the rest of my decorative furnishings!I was initially going to live in the flat but changed my plans, hence I used good quality furniture throughout.  The police were called and with threat of arrest only then through the agency did their sub-tenant removed from the outside patio all the items. The agency FCH did not seem to care besides failing in their duties to carry out an inventory or regular inspections fortnightly as had promised they would. Only because I happen to live in the flat above did they get caught out as lying.  All they are interested in is gaining your property to let to unvetted sub-tenants. They cannot be trusted and I certainly would not recommend FCH.  My flat's doors were re-installed but without the knobs and escutcheons.  I complained and FCH installed a few brass non-turning fixed and cheap quality knobs.  All that remains are three mattresses they put, after everything else disappeared, though FCH claimed falsely the flat was no longer 'compliant'!All I got was a half-hearted and insincere email demanding unilaterally FCH's wish to terminate the contract prematurely, stately the flat to be in the condition by which they found it in!FCH called me on the 7th of September 2024 and the Director F, said as previously, when the 1st tenant lived there, I wanted to terminate, because FCH was in breach, they were ready now to terminate (only when it suited them and the flat was bare). I replied by voicemail and said on the phone, I would agree to termination providing the last month's rent was paid, doors returned, but I also emphasised the flat had to be reinstated as before including furniture, beds, dining table, curtains and lithographs etc brought back. FCH reassured me they would continue to pay rent and put the flat back as before, I said a month's notice to terminate would be needed.  The rent was paid the next day, but 2 weeks later, on the 24th of September, to my shock, although, the flat was still empty and FCH had housed the culprits into a new property, FCH did not trace my stolen goods from their tenants!The flat was returned neither cleaned nor reinstated with the original fixtures and fittings.  FCH think by forfeiting their deposit of £3,500, they can distance themselves from liability, they deny any theft. However, their notice to terminate was 2 weeks short and, the cost of like for like curtains alone exceeds double the deposit, including all the other items taken, my total loss is over £15,000.I will be contacting the Property Redress Scheme, FCH's regulatory body, to report them.
