description:
Your financial needs and personal circumstances are ever-evolving. Your money goals are one of a kind. You're saving for different things and earning money in different ways. Work might not be 9–5 anymore.  

You may be a millennial dreaming of your first home. A foreign national facing restricted access to credit or unfamiliar rules. Or a silver fox planning to retire in style. No matter your situation or credit score, you’ll find mortgages and savings that fit.  

Unlike banks, a mutual building society means shareholders don't cash in. No bumping up strangers' bank balances. No hidden agendas. Just a focus on giving you a fair shot at stability and success. 

You can find out more on our website – here are some quick links:

MORTGAGES

SAVINGS

BRANCHES

CONTACT US

records.title: New account
records.text: Tracey set up a new account for me.Very friendly, helpful and hassle free unlike a recent experience with Lloyds bank.I will certainly recommend this branchat the Forum Lincoln.

records.title: Successful first appointment
records.text: We had our first appointment at the Eastwood branch yesterday. We were seen by Helen who was extremely helpful and explained everything fully to us. We were satisfied with the decisions we made and look forward to visiting again.

records.title: Mary & Michael
records.text: We had an appointment with Bella at the Mansfield Branch of Nottingham Building Society to decide which scheme to take out after our previous schemes had expired. We were met by Bella, who immediately offered us a drink of tea or coffee before we began our discussion. Bella then took us through our options. At all times she was courteous and accommodating. This has been the case every time we have needed to visit Nottingham Building Society.

records.title: Very knowledgable and helpful staff
records.text: I went into the Belper branch today to deposit money into my ISA and joked that I was terrible at regularly putting money into this account because I’d spend it before I thought about it. Josh could have just smiled and nodded but he gave me a few really helpful tips on how to save without really thinking about it too much, and its made a massive difference to how I think about saving. Hopefully I’ll use these in the future!!! The staff at this branch are always incredibly helpful though and Tom gave me great advice to help set this account up in the first place. Would highly recommend as the staff will always go over and above to help you choose the right account for you and make sure that you fully understand all of your options.

records.title: Nottingham Building Society Hucknall
records.text: Nottingham Building Society Hucknall. Thank you to Joanne Miles for sorting myself and my neice today.  Joanne was extremely helpful and explained everything so well, working out everything so we got the best interest for our savings.  Absolutely lovely lady. We came away feeling like we understood.  And interest rates are so confusing.   Highly recommend Joanne and Hucknall Nottingham.

records.title: Amazing service for urgent withdrawal
records.text: I spoke to Anthony Huckstep today about an urgent LISA withdrawal so that I could complete on my house purchase. He understood how stressful the situation was and copied me into all correspondence with my conveyancer to put my mind at ease. We made the deadline only because he was so helpful. Thank you!

records.title: Getting a LISA was a great decision
records.text: Getting a LISA was a great decision. Anthony H was very helpful on the phone and acted quickly to help with the withdrawal of my funds for my property purchase

records.title: Sue at the Mansfield branch transfered…
records.text: Sue at the Mansfield branch transfered my isa from Halifax.Sue was so lovely and helpful, she made the task so easy.This experience has prompted me to recomend Nottingham Building society to family and friends. Many thanks. Jim Peck.

records.title: Just Ask For Lucy. Nottingham Building Society
records.text: Today I opened an additional account at the Nottingham Building Society, Loughborough Branch where I am a member.Lucy was working counter duties and although going for lunch delayed this to open me a new account.Really a credit too the society and proponent of the products offered by the Nottingham.So full marks to the Nottingham BS.

records.title: Friendly Eastwood
records.text: Dropped into Eastwood Branch this morning and was dealt with promptly.     Also learnt about your online accounts.      Staff very friendly and relaxed.     Enjoyable experience.

records.title: I recently visited Nottingham Building…
records.text: I recently visited Nottingham Building Society and had a positive experience. Jo helped open my account in just 10 minutes, demonstrating top-class customer service at the Nottingham Brigg branch. The staff at Sheffield city centre and Mansfield were also friendly and professional, handling my savings and investment needs efficiently - a special mention to Lauren for the helpful advice and delicious coffee. Lucy at the Loughborough Branch was equally competent in dealing with our Fixed Rate Bond application. Kim made my appointment smooth by thoroughly explaining the required documents and products. Overall, great service from The Nottingham. Would highly recommend!

records.title: Friendly helpful staff and competitive products
records.text: On a busy afternoon staff made time to set up a new ac to ensure I rec'd the best rate. Staff are always courteous, helpful and friendly. Your rates are competitive.On the downside I left 2 messages asking for confirmation that funds had been recieved into the ac but had no response in 48 hours, so had to visit the branch personally.

records.title: No reason to complain other than that…
records.text: No reason to complain other than that sometimes there is a long wait to be served in branch (when not all staff are available to serve and can be seen in the back). Furthermore, my local branch has closed.

records.title: Reaction of staff in local…Fine andhelpful
records.text: Reaction of staff in local office(belper)was fine.If I have a grouse it is a sense that actions are becoming more centralised.Please don't have every action having to be  referred back through Nottingham. One of  The Nottingham's attractions is the sense that its local branches continue to be useful. Certainly if you close any more local branches you will lose all my accounts.

records.title: Easy access to helpful staff…
records.text: Easy access to knowledgeable and helpful staff. Some very competitive fixed term products available when I invested. The only drawback was that the new more flexible ISA rules had not been implemented.

records.title: Good
records.text: Made appointment to open account which was done pleasantly and without much fuss. Only downside was that I was referred immediately for a quote for home insurance which I didn't really want.

records.title: Easy to open an account
records.text: Easy to open an account. Nice staff, very pleasant and when calling, very courteous on the phone. I understand that you have two sections, the in-house banking system and the online Beehive banking system, which I was a bit bemused by. It seems to be a little old fashioned, as Beehive is part of Nottingham BS, but I can't use Beehive to check balances on branch opened accounts online and probably vice versa? And you don't actually have an online presence for your branch based accounts? So to move money about, I have to come in branch to get the transfer done or you write a cheque? But, I'm happy for now with the account I've opened.

records.title: i found the staff polite and helpful
records.text: i found the staff polite and helpful , punctual and friendly, answering any questions we asked!  gave us  extra help and support when needed ! I would recommend family and friends .

records.title: Overall experience
records.text: Friendly and welcoming service.  No pressure was felt and I liked the idea of reaching the people involved rather than a call centre.  Only negative was being 10 minutes late for our meeting and not being told she was suddenly involved in another person's problem.

records.title: The lady I saw at long Eaton was very…
records.text: The lady I saw at long Eaton was very friendly and helpful. She efficiently helped me open my new account. The reason I haven't given 5 stars is because I couldn't get an appointment at my nearest branch and had to go to adjacent town.

records.title: I was seen promptly
records.text: I was seen promptly, my request was listened to ,actioned and my queries were answered with clarifications.I had to drive 10 miles to do this because so many branches have closed. If I had been told I needed to make an appointment I would have transferred all my accounts

records.title: Staff were very helpful and…
records.text: Staff were very helpful and informative. Only downside was I wasnt given enough information before my appointment to be able to do my transaction in one go. However following my comments I was told that a message had been sent to staff to let them know

records.title: I was served promptly and the staff…
records.text: I was served promptly and the staff knew what they were doing.I also prefer a system where I have a passbook so that I have a hard copy of any transactions

records.title: Helpful staff
records.text: Staff at Nottingham Building Society in Shepshed and Loughborough are always helpful and friendly Would like to be notified of new accounts when they become available and have facility to check online

records.title: Friendly and helpful
records.text: The staff was very friendly and helpful. She explained to me a few of the investment options available to me should I wish to save more later on. It was good to be able to see and speak to a person than a robot!

records.title: ISA transfer
records.text: ISA was transferred and provider transferring in state partial and not full transfer was requestedVery happy with staff that I saw involved with the transfer

records.title: Would have been five stars but your…
records.text: Would have been five stars but your website wasgiving incorrect rates for 3 year ISA's otherwise itwould have been another five star performance - so you lost a star!Someone was NOT"on the ball "

records.title: Nice to be able to talk to a member of…
records.text: Nice to be able to talk to a member of staff who serves you promptly and all are very friendly, it`s a pleasure to use the Nottingham building society.

records.title: Better interest rate ISA
records.text: The advisor tried her best to make sense of the entries in the passbooks but had to ring head office in the end...ref...compensation from the errors in transferring a stocks and shares isa to a cash isa a year ago.

records.title: Invested in a 2year fixed rate ISA..
records.text: Invested in a 2year fixed rate ISA... Market leading rate of interest and 'service with a smile' made it doubly good!

records.title: Visited to open a new account
records.text: Visited to open a new account, which went very smoothly with all details clearly explained. Since there is no online service (which wasn’t a problem as such) I needed to make an initial deposit followed by a second one for the majority of the account funding. This is where there was a weakness: it took 6 phone calls in total (including 2 promised return calls that did not happen) to confirm that the funds had transferred correctly.

records.title: Packages to suit all needs
records.text: There was nothing that we disliked. Everything was fine and straightforward. We knew exactly what we wanted before we arrived. We were offered all information on all packages available. Lady who served us was polite, helpful and informative.  There was a package to suit all needs.

records.title: Went in to discuss maturing accounts to…
records.text: Went in to discuss maturing accounts to be disappointed to find out that interest I was led to believe at the opening of fixing these accounts was much less.. Feel I was misled as the interest expected is less than half I was expecting. Disappointed tied £100,000 for a year in fixed ISA.. and getting less than £4,000 while Nottingham gained interest on my money and had the use of investing it for their business purposes.

records.title: Follow up to the one i did 4 days ago
records.text: This is a follow up to the one i did 3 or 4 days ago My name is Phil and it was about a photo copy I asked for but was refused, this was at the long Eaton branch. I did go into the branch today and must say the lady who served me was very helpful In fact I'm possibly going to look into staying with them Her name is Julie, and She went a long way to restore my faith in the Nottingham Building Society.

records.title: I recently transferred my ISA savings…
records.text: I recently transferred my ISA savings into a new higher interest ISA. The process was done efficiently & quickly with no complaints. However, I was led to believe that I couldn't transfer more than my yearly allowance from one ISA to another. A cheque was offered for the remainder. I've since discovered this is not the case and a transfer does not effect this allowance. As such, I'm not currently getting the interest i'd hoped for on the full amount of my savings.

records.title: Lack of communication
records.text: I set up a LISA account a while back because The Nottingham had the best interest rates... Which of course have been decreased now because of the pandemic.I find it worrying that you receive zero written verification that your account has been set up and that you've deposited money in. Also the fact that there isn't an app you can use to check on your funds. Logging in through a Web browser doesn't seem legitimate enough for me. !!! Please create an app for us melenials and gen z's, we don't trust your app less ways 😅 !!!

records.title: I was not told that an ISA became…
records.text: I was not told that an ISA became inactive after a time. I was not told that your bot had rejected a payment sent by NS&I thereby causing a lot of problems. I was told when I did manage to pay a cheque in that it went in immediately. Again wrong. It took five days to clear. I am always reluctant to fill these things in because I have found in the past that it makes no difference what I think.The date below will be approximate because all in all it took one month and endless calls to make one payment.

records.title: Excellent branch staff questionable central transfer process
records.text: The branch staff were excellent and very helpful. It took a month to get the funds from my bank to NBS. Which was disappointing. Initially NBS sent my bank Handlesbanken a photocopy of the transfer form without my original signature which they needed to make the transfer. Then a cheque had to be used to make the transfer rather than an electronic transfer.

records.title: Hours of business.
records.text: When in the Nottingham Building Society branch offices staff are very pleasant. However I work so at present it is extremely difficult to get to a branch before 2.30pm which is still the set closing time.If this does not change soon I shall have to close my account and put it with  another Society/Company which is open until at least 3.30pm or has online access...Rather frustrating for me and basically no good for my needs.

records.title: Why don't you use card readers?
records.text: We called at your Bulwell branch first but were not able to buy two cash ISAs as they do not have a card reader and insisted on either cash or cheque. I pointed out that many of the market traders outside had a card reader and would accept a debit card.We then went to your Arnold branch who had a BROKEN card reader but I had thought to bring a cheque book. I have to say that it was hard work doing business with you.All your staff were pleasant but were restricted by your inability to live with the times and use card readers.

records.title: A Little Frosty to Start
records.text: The lady I spoke at the Nottingham Arnold branch was a little frosty to begin with but did warm up as the conversation went on. She did all I asked transferring my savings from one account to another with higher interest rates, so all in all an Ok experience.

records.title: Too Salesy, not customer focused.
records.text: Service is good, the only thing I loathe is that when resetting a password, you have to call the head office to do so to which they'll try and sell you the world when ultimately all I want to do is reset a password! Stop trying to sell to me on every call!

records.title: Had to make two appointments to open an…
records.text: Had to make two appointments to open an account due to wrong information given to us regarding identity

records.title: A very similar story to the review…
records.text: A very similar story to the review below - I've just moved house and ported my mortgage. Thankfully it has concluded successfully now but the process itself was dreadful and I had to behave unreasonably on a number of occasions to make any progress with them.The mortgage service is outsourced and is mainly staffed by juniors without any skin in the game. They constantly pushed back and reneged on their own timelines and didn't answers calls or reply to emails in good time (they expect you to give them 48 hours turnaround time to any question whilst in the middle of property transaction!).They also mucked my conveyancing solicitors around with redemption statements and such like.Of course, the excuse is Covid and that they've never had a busier time. If that's the case then they should do the decent thing and stop writing new business because they clearly can't manage with what they have. They deal with peoples lives and security everyday and should take that responsibility seriously.If you are in a process with the Nottingham I would recommend you really take the bull by the horns and push it through as much as you can.

records.title: There is always a friendly welcome at…
records.text: There is always a friendly welcome at the Nottingham. However, having mobility issues I would appreciate being able to open and manage an account on line.

records.title: An error was made on my ISA
records.text: An error was made on my ISA. application  (not the fault of Amy) which was an inconvenience.

records.title: Less than best advice
records.text: Because the advice I had previously received from the society was not as good as it should have been.

records.title: Experience
records.text: Thought the cashier a bit cool/ abrupt/ not TOO helpful / informative

records.title: Don't take bank cards
records.text: Date of experience: 06 June 2024

records.title: Waited 22 minutes for a simple transaction.
records.text: Whoever decided to end the appointment system for more complex actions or issues needs to rethink. A gentleman in front of me had a complex query involving stopping a cheque and his father’s LPA. There was one trained staff member on the counter. The customer had been there so long when I arrived that he’d been given a coffee, yet I still had to wait 22 minutes for a simple transaction. And a queue behind me. Staff were apologetic; not their fault; clearly a bad management decision.

records.title: Their back office system is in the dark ages
records.text: Their email system is very old fashioned and difficult to use and extremely slow to respond. We tried to open an ISA online, but the only way was to actually go into a branch and spend an hour setting it up with a helpful assistant. They seem to operate using passbooks for goodness sake. I thought that they went out  in 2000 or so. There didn't seem to be any way to give us a receipt of the actions we have carried out, namely opening a new ISA, so we have no idea if it has been opened or if the money is going to be taken out of the correct ISA to transfer to the Nottingham. If it weren't for the better than average interest rate I wouldn't have touched them with a bargepole. I do hope they don't lose all our money

records.title: Thanks for sending your undated underpaid postage
records.text: Thanks for sending your undated paperwork through to close the account. It's a pity it took so long, not helped by underpaying the postage, which we had to pay double before it was delivered. Due to the onerous documentation requirements of Nottingham BS, we ended up having to drive nearly 110 miles to your nearest branch to close the account nearly two weeks ago on the 13th September. Further to my rating yesterday, I can confirm I have today returned the envelope, with all it's contents, to where it came from, namely Nottingham BS, 1 Market Place, Retford, Nottinghamshire, DN22 6DR. This afternoon 25 Sept 2024. Just had a very constructive telephone call with Kerry

records.title: We asked for monthly interest to be…
records.text: We asked for monthly interest to be paid into another account We have found out the interest won’t be paid until end of 2 yr term So we didn’t get what we asked for

records.title: Wasn't aware that no more funds could…
records.text: Wasn't aware that no more funds could be added to the ISA after 14th August which was only mentioned on my last visit when making a deposit.

records.title: Poor slow unresponsive organisation
records.text: Took too long to effect an ISA transfer so I lost out on interest.  I had followed advice of branch staff with regards to timing.  They advised  I had followed correct procedure. Tried phoning head office but no response by phone.  Filled in an online complaint over week ago but no response.  Branch staff nice but ineffectual.  Would not recommend using Nottingham BS

records.title: Had the unfortunate experience of…
records.text: Had the unfortunate experience of dealing with your market research partner Informed Opinions, who used Fine line Manchester to do a market research discussion last week...had to email 3 companies twice each to chase up my incentive monies...only when I threatened to goto Nottingham direct did the emails come thick and fast like yapping puppies with excuses...a word of caution to the Nottingham Building society, choose who you work with more carefully next time

records.title: Rate cut, what rate cut?
records.text: Called in to the check in what the current standard variable rate was today after the two recent BoE Base rate reductions. Was told that they haven’t done it yet and that they weren’t sure when it was going to be discussed as it “is a very busy time with lots going on”.I’m not quite sure what would take precedence over rate setting and responding to monetary policy at a UK building society....particularly when our new BoE Governor is on record as saying he expects the rate cuts to be passed on. Perhaps they will do the right thing and pass on the backdated cut by the end of the week?

records.title: Having a bad experience so far
records.text: Having a bad experience so far, trying to access my LISA savings and I incorrectly added my password once and it's blocked my account so I can't access MY funds. Emailed numerous times to get my account unblocked and still no response, and tried to call with no response. How am I meant to check my own money in my LISA account?!

records.title: Mother died
records.text: Mother died, so had to close her account. went to nearest branch to obtain final account figure for probate. Staff said they were not allowed to provide such information, despite being provided with agreed paperwork/identification, stating that only the head office could do this.Took 15 days for the figure to come, delaying our probate application.Same thing happened when probate had been granted-another 15 day wait for the cheque. Every other organisation we dealt with, was helpful and fast,(average 5 days). The Nottingham's poor service lost them the sale of my mother's property--dare not risk the hassle!

description: At Affordable Waste Management we believe in saving you as a business as much money as possible, that’s why with our collective buying power we can negotiate the best prices for you. We have a proven track record with thousands of customers returning each year. We take care of everything for you so you can sit back and focus on your real business needs. “We take the worry out of waste” by using tried and tested suppliers across the UK.

records.title: I have had an excellent experience with…
records.text: I have had an excellent experience with this company for the past 2 years, after nothing but issues with my previous waste collector. I have recommended this company to a number of my neighbours. The communication is first class, most recently when my Christmas collection fell on a bank holiday they reached out via email to confirm the rescheduled date without me needing to contact them to find out. Collections go ahead as planned, and the team are very friendly to deal with.

records.title: I've had an excellent experience with…
records.text: I've had an excellent experience with this company for the past 2 years, especially after dealing with numerous issues with my previous waste collector. I've recommended this company to several of my neighbours. Their communication is first class; most recently, when my Christmas collection fell on a bank holiday, they reached out via email to confirm the rescheduled date without me needing to contact them. Collections go ahead as planned, and the team is very friendly to deal with. Highly recommend!

records.title: Waste removal
records.text: Affordable Waste Management provides excellent service at a great price. Their team is professional, reliable, and always on time. The process was smooth from start to finish, with clear communication and no hidden costs. Highly recommended for anyone looking for affordable and hassle-free waste disposal!

records.title: Affordable Waste Management provides…
records.text: Affordable Waste Management provides excellent, reliable, and budget-friendly waste disposal services. Their team is professional, responsive, and always on time. They offer competitive pricing without compromising on quality, making waste management hassle-free. Highly recommended for anyone looking for efficient and trustworthy service!

records.title: Overall great service and persistence without the pushiness! Thank-you Kieran.
records.text: Kieran has been great, very easy to talk to and knowledgeable. Fixed the tariff for 1 year on clinical waste. Was patient enough to wait for us to engage in further communications whilst we entered into our new lease with our business and gave great advice when it comes to whats the best and most efficient package for our business needs. Overall great service and persistence without the pushiness! Thank-you Kieran.

records.title: till now all is perfect let's see when…
records.text: till now all is perfect let's see when starting the collections

records.title: Helpful, thorough and highly accomodating.
records.text: Jake made a couple of attempts to contact me, but in a helpful, thorough and patient way, not in any sort of problematic way. When he got though he was very patient and accommodating. The call is recorded so there is evidence of what both parties say and agree to, and Jake made several accommodations for me as a new business owner. When I emailed to confirm these details, he was prompt and thorough in his reply.I am very happy with their service and Jake in particular.

records.title: Very Happy
records.text: Great customer service. When we close the business, they help us out by not charing termination fee as a gesture of goodwill. We are very happy with their service.

records.title: Keiron Young was very professional and…
records.text: Keiron Young was very professional and courteous.  He was able to help me easily and make the transaction run very smoothly.

records.title: Always get a great level of service
records.text: Always get a great level of service, customer service team are always very helpful and friendly. Great company would highly recommend.

records.title: very helpful service
records.text: can not stress how helpful kieran was setting up my contract, so patient with me even tho i chewed his ear off with all my questions! bin was delivered on time but unfortunetely my first service was delayed so meant that i had a buidl up of waste, the service team sorted it out for me and im currently waiting the rocovery! fingers crossed they turn up x

records.title: Excellent service so far
records.text: Excellent service so far, simple process ordering the bin, very fair price compared to other quotes received. Sales agent went above and beyond to ensure my bin was delivered on an urgent delivery! I hope the collections continue this way

records.title: The man I spoke with was very helpful
records.text: The man I spoke with was very helpful, he really took his time and was patient as I had so many questions.I received my bins quite quickly too as I had asked for urgent delivery I was opening in 5 days.I’ve been a customer for 2 years now and I’m very satisfied with the service.

records.title: I’ve been a customer of affordable…
records.text: I’ve been a customer of affordable waste for a while now. Never had any issues with them until fairly recently when we had a missed bin collection. To be fair to them, although it was a slight pain for us it was resolved really fast by their team. One call was all it took and at the same time they answered some questions I had about their invoicing process which I had been meaning to ask. Will continue to be a loyal customer to them, their customer service team (I apologise I can’t remember the name of the lady who dealt with my query) are a credit to the business. Great company 👍🏻

records.title: AVOID this company!!
records.text: Wouldn't even rate 1 star, terrible service. Hidden costs, ignored emails. Tried to cancel before bin was actually delivered but no response. Bin was just left on my driveway whilst I was out, no signature to prove acceptance of contract, taken months of emails and phone calls to get them to actually collect the un-wanted bin. This was a service I had cancelled but they brought it anyway and then trued to charge me for it. Has no resolution going forwards till a court bailiff knocked on my door for an amount of almost £2000!!! Shocking company still no resolution other than to pay bailiff. Disgusting service, all thus in the space of a few months. No warning letter. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!

records.title: Extra Hidden charges
records.text: Extra Hidden charges, bad customer services and collection service not good. We had three times bad experience within 3to 4 months after our contract .I am waiting to finish my contract.I strongly requesting not to use this company services.

records.title: Useless, avoid.
records.text: I've been using this company to collect my recycling via Biffa for 5 weeks, and not 1 single collection has been made on time. I had booked it in for Friday's but they never happen, I have to email Affordable waste management and have them chase Biffa for an immediate collection. This whole set up is exhausting and a total waste of time. I've asked countless times to speak to someone more senior who can elevate it, and have been told there is no one else to speak to other than the customer service person who deals with this account. Overall, this is a completely useless service and I would not recommend at all.

records.title: Have had nothing but bad experiences…
records.text: Have had nothing but bad experiences with this company since we started using them. Bin delivery was changed and never turned up on time. Then multiple collections missed, including extra collections which were arranged because of missed scheduled collections. We got this service to make our lives easier but has only made it harder instead!

records.title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!
records.text: Unfortunately we have to give a star, I wish I could give a 0! This company isn't worth approaching with a bargepoal. We have had uncountable missed waste collections, leaving us in terrible conditions. Absolute appalling customer service and service in general, I wish we never crossed paths with this company. They have promised us 2 days ago that we would get our bins collected free of charge to make up for the missed collection, yet, nothing has happened. We are still waiting for our bins to be picked up.AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!

records.title: I would give 0 star if I could
records.text: I would give 0 star if I could. Avoid this company at all costs. Terrible company and unreliable Auto renewed contract despite I emailed and phoned them that I cannot wait to end my contract their reason is my email is not a proper contract terminationMissed multiple collection.

records.title: Scammers
records.text: Big time scammers, when i gave notice to end the contract they picked up the bins without notice, then said they must have been stolen and charged me £250 for them,I live in the country down a long track where the bins cant be seen .I had to pay over £800 to get out of contract as they started court proceedings against me,I had no bins to put the refuse in so i stopped payments which went against me.very unprofessional on the phone to me if fact laughed at me which made me more confident that they are scammers. Changed there name from cheeperwaste due to such bad reviews. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

records.title: Avoid avoid avoid
records.text: Avoid avoid avoid This company is ripping me off  I used to pay £170 a month now I pay £410 a month it’s a joke

records.title: AVOID!!!
records.text: AVOID!!!! Last month I terminated my contract with Affordable Waste Management as they were absolutely useless. The “excess weight charges” are an absolute joke. On the phone when you sign up they ensure you “everybody has a 70kg limit you won’t get more anywhere else that’s standard”. Why on earth would someone need a 1100L bin when 70kg would fit in a wheelie bin? Sadly I didn’t realise this until after I signed their death warrants they call a contract. So after months of being so over charged my direct debits actually bounced because the additional charges were so high, I terminated my contract to go with a normal waste company. A waste company that won’t charge me so much in excess charges I may as well go and buy my own landfill because it would be cheaper.Now I need to pay almost £2500 in termination fees, which I agreed to set up a payment plan for because sadly, it is my stupid fault for signing a contract with them. I offered to spread this cost over 12 months to ensure it was all paid back but no. I had the option of 3 months to pay or it’s a CCJ for you. So apparently bailiffs are coming to my door at 10am Thursday to retrieve payment in full. Affordable Waste Managments fabulous legal team have failed to send me ANY of the required paperwork to actually get a CCJ so I’m unsure how they have actually obtained this. They have also failed to send me the CCJ claim number and everything else I need to apply for a redetermination from the court! Also whoever writes the emails for the legal department needs to brush up on their grammar and spelling.This company is an absolute sham and I would urge everybody to go with literally any other company but this one.Avoid, avoid, avoid. Oh and to make it even better, they stuck an extra months invoice on before taking it to court! My initial final amount on the day I terminated my contracts has magically jumped up an extra £400! records.title: In the round a bad landlord
records.text: I rented a flat in a block from these guys for more than a decade, because poverty meant I couldn't get out to live elsewhere. Some of the stories:- The communal door got kicked in and it took over 2 years to get it fixed during which time anyone who leant firmly against the door could get into the property. - When they did sort that, they fitted a new lock... and posted the keys through the doors of each flat. There's a basic logic problem there about how you get to your key. I had to get a hotel for the night as I couldn't get in: "not our problem".- Speaking of keys, when part of the building the had caught fire and a few days later they needed access they rang me up to ask if I had a door key they could borrow as they didn't have one. Professional landlording that. - While the fire meant we did not have access to our homes for a couple of weeks, we were still charged full rent.- One tenant decided to steal electricity from the communal supply, running a cable from a socket on the landing into their flat. "Not our problem" say Great Places, who will then put the additional cost for lighting communal areas onto the bills of all the tenants not just the thief.- There was extensive drug use and dealing from a couple of the flats, making the whole building stink. Cannabis use Great Places explained is "fine and we don't do anything about it"- Antisocial noise levels all night are also "not a problem", ditto urinating in communal areas or disabling door locks making burglaries easier.- One day I came home and found one of the flats had had its door kicked in, made simpler for whoever did it by the locks being disabled on the communal door. Checked and no one home. Rang Great Places who told me to report it to the police and call them back with the incident number because 'we cant do anything about that til next week'. - An electrician noted the supply to some of my light fittings was never actually off. "On" it was 240v, "off" it was more like 40v. This did not need action, GPH said, and the way it made bulbs flicker on and off every few minutes through the night is within what tenants should expect to live with. - I wrote in with a complaint about something a member of staff had done. Between the incident and Great Places investigating the staffer had been promoted, and so in their new role was tasked as the person to investigate the complaint. Amazingly, they decided they had done nothing wrong.- Also on complaints, on phoning in to request a copy of their complaints procedure, and chasing it later, it was never provided. This is a good way of keeping your stats down with the regulator.- In a letter after I had been there a few years they asked me how many bedrooms there were in my property. This does not suggest good record keeping, doubly so when their rent rates are based on the number of bedrooms.- And a year after I moved out I was still getting calls from contractors booked to do repairs on my old flat as their data management is so (probably illegally) poor that my number was still linked to the property on their systems.- No surprise that when I got in touch with them about that, they never came back to me.In short, Great Places are very happy to rent properties to you that none of the team would live in themselves.

records.text: I have been here for a while. equity merged with great places. while they also were hit and miss the previous tenant liaison officer did try to help and eventually stuff got fixed.However, since they have merged with great places, the care has gone down hill, about ten times I rang to mention my door buzzer was broke. The first guy they sent was utterly clueless and I was going back and forth for ages. this is awkward as on top floor so people need that for deliveries.but during the PANDEMIC they decided, (without asking tenants) that now would be a great time to go in everyone's houses (many here don't take virus seriously its a bad hit area) and take out ALL the windows. Its been over 2mths of constant noise, scaffolding everywhere, builders staring in to your place, no privacy, many been lackluster about wearing PPE and its a high risk area. Oh they get checked. well they didn't at first and have seen them mingling, one was agressive to me about eventually having to wear a mask because he was inside my house. Another was wearing his mask down his chin then after spoke put it back on. One also had a cough and left two water bottles and a half used cough medicine bottle on my kitchen side!They just dismiss you if concerned or get moody about it or blank you if you bring anything up and concerns. Especially around a high risk covid area during these times!I have ptsd and have had mental health issues for a while and been suicidal at times. this has added to my stress. after completely making constant noise and mess in the place, staff been ignorant not listening and doing what they like. The windows fitted are still not done and finished properly its been three weeks. It has messed up able to go out (blocked off green spaces/once blocked off the MAIN ENTERANCE to the flat) the windows also do not open fully due to the scaffolding (one is meant to as its my fire escape apparently).I could not hear my friends funeral online, I had also a family meeting on zoom and have regular counselling on zoom. with the noise its been night impossible to hear anything! I have repeatedly said when have appointments and been ignored.I was left five hours with no wall and it was freezing. I overheard a builder had just left the job halfway through and wandered off.they then left it again, and the windows are cheap and worse than ones I previously had it which I was fine with.they also have caused huge mess in the living room, done a very shoddy work of plastering and just don't give a damn. I've been trapped for hours in one room when all this has gone on. I have been ill and I explained if could keep noise down for my friends funeral online (they ignored this and I couldn't hear it, not been able to attend due to covid). I had a private meeting regarding family stuff and a zoom call and have a councillor who also uses this, with the constant noise and ZERO PRIVACY its made me very stressed unable to sleep. I can literally hear them all waffling from my windows/doors.they could just stare into the windows into ALL the rooms. I can't even go out to sit in a green space as they have made the place look like a prison with barriers closing all the green spaces off (I have no balcony/no garden). The scaffolding means can't open windows properly when they finally go home for the weekend.And repeatedly woken by heavy drilling at 8am in the morning for the past week.And the manager who took over from brian from equity, repeatedly her phone has gone straight to answerphone and not had any replies.And now they just said how they are planning during a pandemic MORE building work on the area!!!Basically saying "tenants we usually ask but were not going to because of covid (they could do zoom chat/querstionnaire for people!) basically ignoring and complete disregard for the tenants. And tenants safety and wellbeing!I don't feel safe here. not because of the neighbours but due to the shoddy builders they have contracted out to. I get feeling its cheap labour hence they so bad, and then windows with no regard to tenants wishes/privacy. Once they had blocked off the main entrance to the block due to building, I had to ask them to move it as had to go to the shop and couldn't get back in. I was caCasey building workers have been a nightmare. and officer isn't listening to any tenants about this nor are they.other pervious repairs for the place in the past have had to ring and repeat myself to over 10 people again and again, and they've often sent someone out who just doesn't want to do any work/clueless.my boiler's pressure always goes off and I have to chase for ages them to sort it, because there is no key for it here. The buzzer took forever to fix numerous workers and attempts until sorted.The mould in a corner they never fixed at all said ah just paint over it in one room.PEOPLE HAVE TO LIVE HERE. they don't seem to care. at all.

description:
The Heart of England Co-op Funerals has always been committed to providing client families and their loved ones with the best possible level of care and support during a difficult time.

Our colleagues are professionally trained to the highest standards. They understand the needs and feelings of the bereaved and the importance of spending time helping families to plan a funeral that truly reflects the life of an individual. 

In order for us to maintain the highest level of quality care and to continue improving our services, we have created five commitments that we will follow rigorously and strive to live up to ...

#1. We’re available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, so you’ll always have someone to talk to. 

#2. Every step of the way, we’ll explain all the options available to you. We’ll give you all the time you need to feel confident about making the right choices for you. Together we can create a completely unique and personalised service – the way you want it to be.

#3. We will listen carefully to what you and your family want and offer a complete choice and flexibility in your arrangements.

#4. Throughout, we’ll keep you fully informed of exactly what you can expect from us. All our documentation will be written in plain language and our estimate will outline charges in a fair and straightforward way.

#5. We know our service can only be as good as the people who look after you and your family. That is why we continually invest in our people to provide a professional, respectful service. We ensure that our people have access to regular and ongoing training and accredited professional qualifications and we only recruit people who can demonstrate the behaviours required in our business.
