records.text: Frustratingly long time to arrange a meeting to discuss arrangements and not a lot of empathy shown initially, but from then everything was fine. Professional yet friendly and comforting throughout. It made difficult period much easier

records.title: Very happy with the service and empathy…
records.text: Very happy with the service and empathy showed by all staff.Just one grumble - attention to detail required. This email received to review the service - the first name is incorrect.

records.title: Caroline was exceptional at helping  us…
records.text: Caroline was exceptional at helping  us with mums funeral. She made everything easy. Nothing was too much trouble,( she even found my mums coop number after her leaving work over 60 years ago) Her care and attention to detail helped all our family at this sad time.  Caroline dealt  with everything with respect and dignity. I would highly recommend her.

records.title: Use Foleshill branch
records.text: Quite a few problems arouse at the Ansty Road branch and unfortunately we had to move to the Foleshill branch because of this and thankfully we did as Jenny was amazing. She spoke to us with empathy and care and treated our loved one with the dignity she deserved . Jenny went above and beyond for us correcting the problems we encountered with at Ansty Road. On the day of the service Chris and his team were lovely and made our service go well and they were all compassionate towards us and we'd like to say a big Thank you to Jenny and Chris for their services.

records.title: Efficiency and sympathetic manner
records.text: On our 1st. visit to your premises, the young lady to whom we spoke seemed rather inexperienced, compared to the more senior colleagues we spoke to at subsequent visits.

records.title: Deceased - Robert Thomson
records.text: Tom Fitzpatrick showed great compassion & empathy during the whole of the process and was prompt and efficient with any requests - this was comforting for my mother, Marion - thank you.There were 2 issues - neither of which reflect on Tom.1. The dressing of my father was not as requested.2. The streaming of the service was not activated by the 3rd party - this was a disappointment for all of those unable to attend for geography/ Covid guidelines. The £25-00 fee has been deducted from settlement.

records.title: Heart of England - Kenilworth
records.text: The ladies that helped arrange my uncle's funeral were extremely good and I thoroughly recommend.  5 stars for the Warwick Road Kenilworth staff.I knock a star off because I question how joined up the whole co-op service is.  Co-op funerals are apparently different to co-op Heart of England and there was confusion from the outset to who we were dealing with.  It was also confusing knowing which office I was dealing with at times - Coventry, Kenilworth or elsewhere.For this reason I would always go for one of the few family run business while you still can, rather than a corporate.  That said, I can't fault the staff at the Kenilworth branch, so well done.

records.title: Generally professional but need greater attention to detail
records.text: Very professional on the day of the funeral. Everything went smoothly. However, they need more attention to detail when organising the funeral. The order of service booklet was printed before music was confirmed and I was not informed this would not be included in the booklet. And after I went into the office to sign a document, I had to go back  again as they overlooked that another signature was required.

records.title: I cannot fault the way in which you…
records.text: I cannot fault the way in which you handled my husbands funeral.  Amanda was positive but considerate and thoughtful and everything went like clockwork..Only 1 issue marred the event and as I had asked for the hurse not to travel ain excess of 30mph as some of the family had no idea where to go and as this had aslo happened at the funeral of my sister in Leicester 5 yeras ago, it was at the forefront of my mind.  However, the hearse hit the A46 and just "went" leving me to follow with my daughter and 2 grandchildren who had no idea where they were going.  An unfortunate incident but all went well in the endA special thankyou to Amanda Murey.. She ws wonderful

records.title: Personal touch
records.text: The staff provided us with a good quality service they look after our daughter with great care. Good personal service, The staff look after all our needs

records.title: Janice was amazing at lowers Holyhead…
records.text: Janice was amazing at lowers Holyhead road and is definitely meant for the job. The service on the whole was great other than I rang and waited a few days for a return call to book to see my friend. Also when trying to pay for the funeral my paperwork had no details of who to make the cheque to / bank details . I called from the bank and two people I spoke to didn’t know either. I did eventually sort it out.

records.title: The staff were caring
records.text: The staff were caring, efficient and were sympatheticto what is a difficult process to go through . Able to give helpful advice so the funeral arrangements wentas well as possible in the circumstances .

records.title: verall I was pleased with the service…
records.text: Overall I was pleased with the service provided. Very polite and helpful staff. Staff were very respectful and sensitive. There were a couple of issues with order of service regarding choice of theme card and dates,however these were rectified very quickly. On the day of the funeral everything went very well. Driver's very professional and experienced. Funeral Director leading was very respectful and had wonderful values. All additional services of Piper and doves were organised and in place. Finally the horse and carriage was a fitting tribute to my dad. On the day we were very well looked after and taken care of. Webcam link was a helpful service for family who could not travel. We were fortunate to have a pre paid funeral plan ,however the additional costs for seeds,order of service etc were priced fairly. Thank you to all staff on the day of dad's funeral for making it personal and special to him.

records.title: A good job done by the staff of Co-operative Funeralcare.
records.text: I was offered the services of Jenny Smyth, who was a great help guiding me through the arrangements for my wife's funeral, plus she went beyond the funeral in offering the help of the legal department in respect of probate  for my wife's finances.Every thing went well and the service was simple and good.On the journey back home I asked Jenny about the scattering of the ashes, she replied that it would be in 2 weeks time. After the 2 weeks I called Jenny re the ashes, she contacted the Crematorium to be told they had been scattered.I was very disappointed as I and my children had wanted to be present - I was told I had agreed to there being no one from the family present, I cannot recall any such thing.

records.title: Excellent service in very difficult…my brothers service
records.text: Excellent service in very difficult circumstances as we were in another country with everything having to be done by email and telephone The staff were very sympathetic and caring and helped us through the difficult and upsetting timeThe funeral was perfectly arranged and the service beautiful Many thanks to All involved

records.title: Excellent service - but discuss details carefully x
records.text: Overall support and experience received was, for the most part, excellent from start to finish. All worries in relation to the organising and finialising of details for the funeral were taken away; the Heart of England staff were excellent.My review rating reflects a lack of communication in relation to the use of pallbearers at the service; my husband was wheeled into the Chapel on a trolley and not carried as expected. If this had been discussed in advance that this was now standard practice, we would have arranged for family and friends to be pallbearers.Unfortunately, several mistakes were also made with the family flowers; my husband's name was spelt incorrectly and the colour choice requests were mixed up and were not natural ( 'red' roses had been sprayed red).Follow up discussions with Heart of England were excellent; explainations, resolutions, and a full apology was made. Thank you.

records.title: Pretty Good, But Could Do Better
records.text: The day of the funeral was handled very well and as a family we were grateful for the professionalism shown. However, the management of the process beforehand was not great. Many basic mistakes were made and suggestions to change meetings did not sit comfortably with us given these had been planned in line with time taken off work. As it was a sensitive time we were a little disappointed.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Poor communication where by advisors/organisers were changed without letting us know, £10 for viewing the body.Ashes collection arranged for a set date and location, only to be told that they had been sent to the Crematorium again without letting us know. We were not informed of what would be the process for the internment we had to find out on the day. Only good point was that it went ok on the day.

records.title: Arthur/Betty Small
records.text: The staff were very friendly and eventually flexible.I asked for my father to lie in Foleshill Road and at first told it wasn't possible. After a few phone calls they apologised and moved him there. I had a bad experience with a young employee at Ansty road which I reported to the Foleshill branch. Foleshill got the wrong recording of the exit music. I don't think it made a huge amount of difference on the day but the two former issues left a bad taste

records.title: Some poor communication…
records.text: Initial poor communication regarding the collection of the body from.the care home. Issues regarding music that had been discussed at the first meeting but not requested till 3 weeks later. Then told 2 days before the funeral that a A digital version was not available so alternatives had to be found at very short notice.

records.title: Sympathetic Compassionate Excellent Service
records.text: Regrettably second death in my family in last 18 months and both funerals undertaken by Heart of England Foleshill branch.The service from Jenny was excellent and nothing was too much trouble and if required to use services of funeral company again would certainly use Heart of England

records.title: Rather disappointing
records.text: The funeral director was extremely pleasant and helpful as were staff on the day of the funeral. However the service provided was disappointing overall. The order of service booklets were poor, despite several efforts on our part to rectify basic problems such as alignment and illegible type. We were disappointed by the very small choice of music at the crematorium and had to supply our own and play it through a speaker - surely it should be possible to use a USB stick with the existing sound system. We also felt that people speaking at the service should have been given a microphone as they couldn't be heard at the back. The service finished more quickly than anticipated - even though we'd had to leave out a hymn we wanted and had been told to keep the eulogies very short.

records.title: All the staff who attended on the day…
records.text: All the staff who attended on the day of the service at the Crematorium were great. However, on the day of the internment, I arrived to be told that the urn for the ashes had not yet arrived.  This delayed the internment and caused the family a great deal of distress. Very unprofessional and inappropriate.In addition to this, a member of the family was given the donation box after the service.  I had assumed it was part of the service that donations would be dealt with by the co op. However, when I went in to return the box I was told that I had to deal with it. This is not my experience of other companies.

records.title: PUSH PUSH PUSH But good price.
records.text: Contacted 3 weeks after sorting things out to find nothing was done, then had to re do everything and go in 2 days before Christmas to sign. So good price but need to push to get things done.

records.title: I had to take my service elsewhere as…
records.text: I had to take my service elsewhere as the date that I required you couldn’t do

records.title: Services need to be improved
records.text: Had to chase over various things and also given incorrect information.

records.title: Upsetting 😡
records.text: Everything  was good except  in the service  in the crematorium  they played  the wrong  music  whitch  really up set me as it was from my late husband  to his grandchildren I found this very upsetting  to my family  and my self if I had been feeling  a bit better  I would have said some thing it spoil  it for me  it was embarrassing  to say the least I hope they make sure in future  the make sure they get things right I am very upset  and to deal  with my husbands passing as well its not good they one and only chance  to say good bye  and it went very  wrong

records.title: A long time left waiting
records.text: I was with my nephew helping him sort his dads funeral. The initial meeting took a long time & during the process we sat for periods of time with no one there - apparently because they were short of staff . This did not help my nephew.

records.title: Prior to my mum passing away we went…
records.text: Prior to my mum passing away we went and spoke with the staff in branch about her wishes and we were quoted all the costs. However upon her passing and going to make arrangements we were told about costs not mentioned previously. In excess of £3000 as a working class family it has been extremely difficult to accommodate the extra hidden costs.

records.title: Problem with one, another absolutely outstanding
records.text: Siobhan and Nadeen from ansty road are 5 stars and alot more that are both a credit to your company, well spoken, kind passionate about what they do couldn't fault them in the slightest, my issue with giving 3 stars was when my dad was at another branch his coffin got damaged on the lid and looked pretty bad tbf they tried to get it sorted but to no avail it's wasn't there fault as again was done at another branch, I would use ansty road again without a second thought

records.title: The Ansty Road Practice need to ensure…
records.text: The Ansty Road Practice need to ensure undertakers such as the trainee we experienced are not left unsupervised to deal with directly deceased persons and their families. Furthermore when making an appoint to arrange the funeral again persons dealing directly with grieving families should not be trainees unless they are being directly supervised.

records.title: started off well but...
records.text: Initial face-to-face contact was excellent, however I later had to ring up to find out whether my mum’s direct cremation had actually happened (it had, but nobody had told me) and I felt that the phrasing of the person I spoke to was very inappropriate and could be offensive/hurtful - when searching on the computer for mum’s details he said ‘I’ll just get the system fired up..,’ Not good when discussing a recent cremation.

records.title: We asked for an unattended cremation
records.text: We asked for an unattended cremationAshes to be returned to the Funeral home for family collection and scatteringNever received any phone calls / chased for a date on several occasions got no replyLack of communication, however once this matter was high lighted all was resolved quickly and professionally

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: I found communication from them to be very poor. As I was dealing with an unattended funeral from a distance it was slightly more complicated. I couldn’t go in to sign forms , something that the reception staff seemed unable to comprehend. I also felt that because her funeral was unattended at my sister in laws wishes, there seemed to be very little communication as if she were less loved. This was far from true and we still wanted to have a date and time for our own reflection. She seemed to be in storage for a long time dispute no reason for any delay in terms of coroner or death certificate etc. Not the best service from them. It did improve however when I expressed our displeasure at how things were going.

records.title: The pushing for advance payment for…
records.text: The pushing for advance payment for disembersments when already aware of not being able to access the deceased funds due to a lack of death certificate was disappointing.

records.title: Several errors and lack of…
records.text: Several errors and lack of communication.  Main 2 problems were the obituary copy went into the local newspaper incorrectly causing distress to family members.  The other was I went to see Mum the day before the funeral and her age was incorrect on coffin lid and wooden cross.  These were my last minutes with my Mum and they totally ruined it.  Felt so frustrated, distraught and upset by the whole funeral arranging experience.

records.title: Staff weren't fully prepared for…
records.text: Staff weren't fully prepared for meeting despite previously speaking to another staff member, extensively, about our requirements. We had to chase up answers to our questions. It appeared that we had more information than the assistant. We were originally told that we could customise funeral to our requirements but were only able to do this if we chose other higher cost, unrequired, options. On the positive side, despite the staff member lacking the appropriate knowledge, they were very pleasant and caring. The lady at the crematorium, on the day of the funeral, was very kind and caring.

records.title: There was no compassion.
records.text: There was no compassion for the funeral I attended, which is such a shame as I have used you before for my own parents funeral. From when the cars picked Rick up and sped through the streets of Radford leaving the whole funeral procession behind, some of which were not local to coventry and had no idea where they were going, so just followed who they thought were there for his funeral.The service in the Chapel was just as rushed, songs and reading missed out and little things the family had requested were not followed through i.e donation boxes for cancer charities. The Co-op badly let Ricks family down and did not give him the send off that was requested and paid for. I'm not sure what went wrong but definitely not upto the usual standards.

records.title: Disappointing support
records.text: My Mum had a prepaid funeral plan and we had a copy of Mums wishes.  It was clear during our zoom meeting to discuss the arrangements that the member of staff had not reviewed the arrangements. She asked us questions as though there had been no previous arrangements made. I know the staff member did not know my Mum but she could have been a lot more sensitive by reviewing the plan and asking us to confirm the details.  Communication was also very poor. Some of the language used was insensitive at a very upsetting time.  The gentleman that led the funeral service was very good but the support service was poor from start  to finish.

records.title: February 2020
records.text: A very poor experience, and Covid 19 was not a reason.Poor and insulting communication including from the head office.Left a horrid taste at a very difficult time.

records.title: Initial appointment very good
records.text: Initial appointment very good, plenty of availability and time scale over a month but all emails not replied to or information read on email. Order service left until last few days and rushing causing errors and blaming myself yet the emails were not read. Wrong deceased names on email from the coop and over 2 full days to resolve this just days before the service causing more distress and worry than was necessary. Service was good and onetime. Mick (Humanist) conducted the service professionally and I would recommend him.

records.title: Prepaid plan was not suitable for…
records.text: Prepaid plan was not suitable for needs. The first funeral home that we were referred to gave a very poor service, the man was disinterested and showed no empathy at all, made us feel like intruders, we left feeling very upset and angry that we had been made to feel worse in a situation that was already very painful for us. We asked to be reffered to an alternative funeral home, the staff there were lovely, a totally different experience

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Not enough personal contact made during this sad time. Had to chase them to confirm details. Didn't actually speak to our funeral arranger until the day of funeral. Was promised a call in the morning prior to funeral to go through the events of the day but nobody rang. Not all of deceased effects were returned to us.

records.title: My mums body took 12 days before it…
records.text: My mums body took 12 days before it arrived at Coop Ansty rd Coventry and my Dad who’s 93 could only go to see the day before the funeral.because the funeral parlour was busy I was put through to a call handling service and the man that spoke to me was very abrupt,telling me to slow down.Our surname was spelt incorrect but we got an refund only after explaining it.This is the third I have used Ansty road and have never waited this long for body to arrive.

records.title: I shan't be using the co-op again
records.text: It's not complicated. I expect the funeral directors to prepare the deceased, turn up on time with the hearse and limousine to pick up the family, and distribute the order of service at the funeral.The hearse and limousine turned up late, leaving the family to wait outside on the pavement. We arrived at the crematorium with 1 minute to spare and the order of service had been left behind in the office. A pretty poor performance all round.

description:
With 30 years experience, Avalon Funeral Plans are experts in helping you plan for the future.

They understand that, just like every person, every funeral is unique and Avalon's team is dedicated to ensure that the plan you choose suits your individual needs and wishes.

They provide funeral plans that can help you and your loved ones if you are based in the UK and for expats who have found a home in Spain, Cyprus and Portugal.

They were recognised by the UK’s Personal Finance Awards as ‘Best Funeral Plan Provider’ five years in a row (2019-2023) for their dedication to delivering phenomenal service to their customers.

Since 1993, Avalon have helped over 105,000 people feel reassured their funeral is planned and paid for.

Avalon are dedicated to supporting families.  You can find free helpful resources on their website.

records.title: We were visited by Gavin Paskin
records.text: We were visited by Gavin Paskin. What a lovely man, was very upfront with his description of Avalon's packages. We never felt under any pressure to buy a plan. We were given many options, each was explained in easy to understand terms with the pros and cons highlighted. We feel confident we have chosen the best package for us.  Thank you Gavin

records.title: Avalon experience review
records.text: Avolon was recommended to us by many friends.The representative Jay Patel was curtious and helpful. The plan we selected was perfect for our needs. It has gven us peace of mind.We would recommend this to everybody.

records.title: Choosing a funeral plan
records.text: The company representative, Gavin Paskin, turned up on time, in fact he was a little early, which we did not mind in the slightest.  He was well presented and very well prepared.  He was extremely patient and well versed in all the plans.  He made sure that we were given every piece of information we needed to make an informed decision as to the best plan for us.

records.title: The representative was a nice guy
records.text: The representative was a nice guy, and also very intelligent which I enjoyed.He was not pushy at all and I trusted him. I bought a funeral plan for myself and my partner and felt very relieved that everything would be easy with no stress.Truly!

records.title: Excellent meeting
records.text: My husband and I met Alan Richardson from Avalon yesterday.  He put us at ease immediately. His presentation and explanation of all plans available was comprehensive and easy to understand. At no time did Alan pressurise us. We have therefore decided to take out our funeral plans with them.

records.title: Recommended
records.text: Representative Ashley Williams visited to discuss Funeral Plans with us. He was punctual, polite and professional. He gave us a comprehensive view of the various plans available. He did not push us to make a decision and was quite happy to return to give us time to discuss our options. Having heard various reports on funeral plans we were reassured by Ashley that Avalon was the right company to use. The company has been around 30 years and holds accounts in a trust fund with a 10% excess to cover any eventualities and is regulated by the UK and Spanish Authorities which we felt was really important for peace of mind. Overall a pleasant experience despite the topic being discussed. Thanks Ashley! Sue + Tom

records.title: Met up with Ashley at the office
records.text: Met up with Ashley at the office. Made everything easy to understand, all options explained fully.

records.title: A positive experience despite the subject matter.
records.text: The Avalon company representative, Jay Patel arrived ahead of time allowing us to get him onto the site punctually. He was very clear and precise in his explanations and really wanted to understand what we wanted and therefore which was the most appropriate plan for us. He also gave us all the payment options which was also helpful. It is a lot to consider and made us aware of other alternatives available and possible.

records.title: Clear to Understand Presentation.
records.text: Gavin Paskin arrived on time.  Explained clearly and in easy to understand language what the meeting would cover;  what the company had to offer, plus the differences in each plan.  Also how payments could be made.  Gave precise answers to our questions and often pre-empted things we'd wanted to know during  the presentation.

records.title: First meet Jay Patel in 2018
records.text: First meet Jay Patel in 2018, when we took out a funeral plan, so have taken out another one, Jay explained the different plans and payment options, so took the plus plan, and all paid for next day.

records.title: The explanations were all very thorough…
records.text: The explanations were all very thorough and I never felt pressurised to accept anything.

records.title: Avalon funeral plan
records.text: Jay Patel visited us twice, first time to explain the different level of plans and the second visit for us to sign the relevant documents.  He his presentation was very clear and precise and he was extremely knowledgeable and patient when answering any queries. For peace of mind especially in Spain when there is a language barrier l would definitely recommend a funeral plan.

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very good service.  Only thing is that my next of kin phone number was incorrect on cards.Have never received cards with correct number so hoping it has been corrected.

records.title: Really pleased with the telephone and Gavin Parkin
records.text: Really pleased with the telephone reception, arrange a consultation, Gavin Paskin, arrived promptly as arranged and was very helpful and informative, and gave us peace of mind. After doing all our research,on all the pro and cons, we would recomend Avalon X

records.title: Service excellent
records.text: Service excellent, the only downfall was supposedly a mistake of charging me in gbp and then changing it to euros which made it more expensive. I had a threshold of what to pay and when changed to euros took me over that. I believe I can remember that when I was getting prices the first part of the option was sterling which then was corrected so it leaves me wondering!!!?

records.title: We think this is a great insurance…
records.text: We think this is a great insurance product especially as we live in Portugal and gives us peace of mind. Our only negative is that the presentation takes a long time & is also repeated when you place the order, so in all it takes a lot of time. I think this could be streamlined. Our representative was on time, knowledgeable & professional.

records.title: Excellent at a price
records.text: My experience was overall very good. The downside was that there was no local agent so had to connect via zoom, which I had never used before. The agent was very helpful and patient helping me with this as I'm not good with the Internet. The service offered is great but would have liked each element priced as the final cost for myself and my husbands plan purchased together cost a lot more than I expected. I may not have purchased all elements at this time. However a great product.

records.title: The representative who contacted me and…
records.text: The representative who contacted me and my husband was courteous and clearly spoken.He gave us all the information we required and if he was not sure of an answer he found out for us as quickly as possible.

records.title: Mike the agent was very professional…
records.text: Mike the agent was very professional and patient with me!It is difficult to discuss funerals and death with anyone but he is ideal for the job.I am hoping your company will not disappoint when the time comes!!!

records.title: Jaymin Patel explained everything down…
records.text: Jaymin Patel explained everything down to the last detail and was very helpful. Would recommend this service

records.title: Very good finally got the information…
records.text: Very good finally got the information we wanted but had to sit through lots of talking. Why can't you just give written information so you can cut short the appointment.

records.title: Funeral plan
records.text: Met with Mr Jay Patel who explained everything really well. Impressed with the service outlined and we are now at ease with our funeral arrangements

records.title: Disappointed with Avalons Life locker
records.text: Would have been 5* if the Life Locker was more professional. For me it is useless. It looks like a kids video game. Otherwise very impressed with the whole process. Would recommend.

records.title: Thorough explanation of all aspects of the funeral plan and financing.
records.text: The funeral plan options are clearly explained in the advertising brochures - not just the 'headline' points but all of the contracted and non-contracted services.I had also done my homework so I was pretty 'clued-in' to the Avalon experience. But I still had to 'endure' a 40 minute telephone interview that basically assumed that I had no knowledge of what I was purchasing. There must be some way to let me opt out of sections of the interview with which I am already well acquainted. I'm sure that some people find this extremely helpful  but I found it slightly annoying; compounded by the fact that I made a special trip to the local Avalon offices to enroll in person only to be told that that wasn't possible, I had to go home and wait for a telephone call.

records.title: My wife recently passed away
records.text: My wife and I had a funeral plan from Avalon, so when my wife passed away and everything went smoothly I had no reason to turn anywhere else.

records.title: Efficient service
records.text: Everything dealt with quickly and efficiently. Extra costs mentioned straight away-nothing hidden or landed on you last minute. Good communication with funeral directors and with myself.

records.title: Change of mind We already had a funeral plan with…
records.text: We already had a funeral plan with Avalon which we took out a few years ago we have just changed our minds which plan we wanted and they made it very easy to do this

records.title: Informative but long.
records.text: The presentation was very informative. My only criticism is it took an hour plus another 20 minutes to sign up over Zoom.

records.title: Talk to a human beeing…
records.text: Good thing through Zoom to have a human beeing in front of you...His ability to listen and help to make a choice I really appreciated....and all what comes is future.....ask my daughter later....

records.title: So good to speak face to face on Zoom…
records.text: A helpful experience with Avalon.So good to speak face to face on Zoom rather than by email, through the website, phone or other means.Job done!

records.title: Magdelana was excellent but…
records.text: Magdelana was excellent but presentation too long.

records.title: Think before you leap!
records.text: To explain, how the Spanish Police deals with the ordinary humans who die on a street, or in their home, then,  what & how they sort that Issue out in the long run, is a BIT over stretched....../// That puts Folks in a another thought issue...

records.title: The only reason I am giving 3 stars…
records.text: The only reason I am giving 3 stars instead of 5 is due to the fact you no longer offer a direct cremation plan in Portugal.  I had to spend approx £1500 more to take out a standard funeral plan which had benefits we wouldn’t use.However the process to take out a plan was quick and easy, kind and friendly staff.  When we had to use the plan, the process was straight forward and everything dealt with efficiently.

records.title: Postal delay
records.text: Unfortunately, there was only one problem.  All the paperwork and cards were sent to our daughter in the UK.  We had said we wanted everything sent here and just a copy to our daughter in the UK.  When we did not receive anything, you immediately resent it to us here, and now all is well

records.title: At this moment I did not received…
records.text: At this moment I did not received anything.My wife does, but I received nothing.

records.title: I found it very informative and to the…
records.text: I found it very informative and to the point. I knew exactly what was expected from you

records.title: Took out the policy on Friday and…
records.text: Took out the policy on Friday and apparently the details are only out on Fridays and so was posted the following Friday followed by a bank holiday so it didn’t arrive until nearly two weeks. I was beginning to wonder if it was a scam and had to ring up to check. Need to get the information out quickly so people don’t lose confidence in your company especially as the money went out straight out..

records.title: Was it a good meeting?
records.text: Was a really good meeting,? we signed the dotted line, handed over the cheque, about 2 hours later had a phone call saying it was not quite right but had no choice other than to accept what we had signed, as during the meeting it was said that if we cancel even within the 30 days we would have to pay 350 pounds admin charge to cancel so here we are.

records.title: Still doubtful if their sales people…
records.text: Still doubtful if their sales people give buyers all the correct and accurate information and is there any other hidden extra costs at the time of the persin's death. With dispersment it has to be a guaranteed plus plan at higher cost. I took the plan as i was pleased with Gemma.

records.title: Rubbish After Sales Service
records.text: I wanted a funeral plan that would cover me in both Portugal and England and the Avalon Plan suited these requirements.I signed up for the plan on the day the rep visited.However, Avalon have sent the paperwork to the incorrect address, and after emailing both the rep Mike and the office in Spain 2 days ago regarding this, I have not had the courtesy of a reply or even a holding response.  I am not happy with the lack of communication, and I hope Avalon are more efficient when the time comes to use them!

records.title: When the salesman visited I said that I …
records.text: When the salesman visited I said that I was particularly keen to have the funeral plan with Sellers of Hinckley (independent).  He said he knew the undertakers and that I would be able to choose that one.  Instead, I was given an undertaker approx. 10 miles away who I had never heard of  Also, I was not best pleased about the Mail on Sunday report regarding how Avalon was the worst in paying £1600 in commission fees.  I certainly not be recommending them to friends.

records.title: Only just joined AVALON
records.text: Only just joined AVALON, so only gave it 3 stars at the moment but,for the service I have had so far - Very impressed & happy with it.Staff were very polite & did not rush everything, happy to repeat & explainagain if things were too technical, slow down.

records.title: The person who came to talk to me was…
records.text: The person who came to talk to me was lovely . I felt l wanted to agree with him but am not really ready at this time to make these plans and have had second thoughts . I did feel like I ought to commit to this purchase when I should have said give me time to think about it .

records.title: The plan is a good way of paying for a …
records.text: The plan is a good way of paying for a funeral. All the staff Including I have spoken to have been very polite and caring. Unfortunately the paperwork for my plan was not completed correctly and the advisor had to come back which resulted in me paying higher monthly payments.

records.title: I wanted  a catalogue first to read …
records.text: I wanted  a catalogue first to read  and digest but would appear its all direct contact from the start when first wishing to have the platform at the beginning.Kind Regards  Mt John R Allen  MBE

records.title: Such a pleasant experience
records.text: Such a pleasant experience.  I am so surprised how easy it is to set up a funeral plan.  With the aid of Chris Rhodes, I was able to set up my plan, without any “hard sell” tactics.  I now have peace of mind for the future.  Many thanks Chris.

records.title: This company gives a hard sell and…long time to return money for cancellation
records.text: This company gives a hard sell and discourages use of cheques. They only offer 3 weeks for cooling off if you pay a deposit and you have to pay within that time. They swiftly take your cash  it don’t return it so swiftly.

records.title: I have cancelled this as I am able to …
records.text: I have cancelled this as I am able to get a better and cheaper plan. Alison your agent was very helpful and I would  like to thank her, but financially I am many hundreds of pounds better off with my new contract. Bast wis es Anne

records.title: M. A.Wilson.  The Rep
records.text: The Rep. Mr. Mark Wilson who introduced the plan explained the policies very well and on that basis opted to go with Avalon.In about four years I or someone would be able to enlighten you further.Lambert Nasse.

records.title: The sales man was very informative and…
records.text: The sales man was very informative and pleasant. He explained everything so that we understood it. The plan was simple and effective just as we wanted. We are very happy with it.

records.title: Beware - the plan does not always cover a basic cremation
records.text: The staff at Avalon are polite and helpful but my father bought a pre-paid plan expecting it to cover his basic cremation and it didn't.  I have been given a polite explanations which is that the cost of cremation varies across the country so Avalon have restricted how much they will pay for 'third party dispersements'.  My father would have been upset that the plan did not cover what it expected and I have no memory of this being explained at point of sale (although no doubt it is in the small print). Just make sure that when you buy you understand exactly what you will get.

records.title: First time have tried to have a plan
records.text: First time have tried to have a plan. Whoever I spoke to first sounded young and inexperienced. Did not receive much information. Then later spoke to a very young sounding female that sounded annoyed at me asking questions. The plan was for cremation only, burial cost more. Have since seen another plan -only slightly more and I can decide anytime what I want. Also get a gift card soon after signing. So have asked to cancel my plan with money back as stated.

records.title: adviser not to good
records.text: your adviser was quite abrupt when i told him i would ring him back as i had a another company to speak to his  attitude changed and he said to me no you wont and i thought you are not good to people who may think your wasting my time even  though i took out a plan hope you get bacto me regards George

records.title: hope it,s the  right decision
records.text: Funeral adviser Kerry was very efficient she put my mind at rest answered all the questions i asked  i felt i had made the right decision .It was a shame she was let down by the Managerial inadequacy.After a lot of unnecessary Stress phone calls and E-mails i was sent 3 different plans before the right one was put into placeI only hope the funeral Director will be more efficient.If i hadn't been going away and had more time to deal with this matter I think i would have cancelled this plan.

records.title: I MET MARIN YESTERDAY TO ARRANGE A…
records.text: I MET MARIN YESTERDAY TO ARRANGE A FUNERAL PLAN ,I WAS TREATED  WITH RESPECT AND GIVEN ALL THE INFORMATION REQUIRED TO MAKE AN INFORMED DECISION TO TAKE OUT A PLAN WITH AVALON.WHAT A NICE GUY MARTIN IS AND SO HELPFUL .THANKS MARTIN ANN MCCANN

records.title: my mother has had a plan with avalon…
records.text: my mother has had a plan with avalon funeral plan for both her and my dad for 10 years.my father passed away recently and as i was on holiday at the time of his death my sister was trying to find who the plan was with ,but couldnt find anything.so she got a local funeral director to pick my father up and take him to chapel of rest.then when i got back i found it was with avalon,so phoned them up and told them,but they said there was no funeral directors in my town who was in the plan,so that cost me £185 for the other funeral director,and also after the funeral we got a bill of avalon for £224 for disbursement costs hich probably they dont tell you about,but it does say you get an allowance towards it not the full amount.so BEWARE,dont know who selt my mother this but would like to know!

records.title: Disappointment
records.text: I was/am disappointed at having no involvement in the choice of a local funeral director, and find that the one selected by Avalon is the smallest and least well equiped in the town.

records.title: dissapionted
records.text: cant give a review, because I have not had what I was told I would get when I took out my plan,  But I just hope that they are better a organising a funeral

records.title: I have asked for my deposit back as my…
records.text: I have asked for my deposit back as my family would rather I didn’t do this. I would appreciate my deposit by return

records.title: Should be called assumptions are us, not avalon!!!
records.text: I thought i would be using this company for my funeral plan, however after paying by cheque i found it cheaper elsewhere so i cancelled the cheque, they rang me to find out why i cancelled, i said that i had found it cheaper elsewhere but the lady was surprised that i did as she asked if i chose the £1,895 simple cremation, i said that i hadn't been offered that one, only the one for £2,695, she said the simple one isn't very popular as you just get a no fuss cremation, no church service, just the ashes are handed to your representative. I said that that would have been fine with me as people don't come and see me when i'm living so i wouldn't want them to see me when i'm dead, also i don't go to church so there would be no point in that either, it would be like closing the door after the horse has bolted. Although i was told that there was no pressure selling, when i asked if i could have time to think about things and consider my options i was told NO we need to sort it today, so that made me feel pressured. If you are inviting these people to your home you need to allow 2.5 hours as that's how long it took. People shouldn't assume, people should be given all the facts.

description: SO Resi is the brand for shared ownership homes by Metropolitan Thames Valley Housing that makes home ownership possible for more people. Find out how SO Resi can help you get on the ladder.

records.title: Sandhiya is a star
records.text: Been living in my SO Resi property for over a year now and I'm very happy. Was supported through the process by Sandhiya who gave me all the info I needed to make an informed decision and showed flexibility in accommodating ad hoc viewing requests. This support continued after I moved in as well as I adjusted to the new place. So hats off to Sandhiya. Great service.

records.title: Great customer service from Sunita
records.text: Sunita Soni has been helpful and supportive throughout a very overwhelming chapter for me. She has been very patient from the first moment we met, showing me a few properties, explaining the process step by step and guiding me taken into consideration my personal situation.  I am currently going ahead with purchasing my first shared ownership home and I trust that Sunita is the best person to efficiently and professionally help me complete on my new home. Thank you, Sunita for all your help and support so far.

records.title: Excellent Support Throughout the Process
records.text: We purchased our shared ownership property, and our experience with Soresi has been outstanding from start to finish. *Sandhiya Mohindra* was an absolute star throughout the entire process, starting from the property viewing. She was incredibly responsive and helpful every step of the way, ensuring that all our questions were answered and that we felt supported during every second of the journey.While Sandhiya was on holiday, Sunita Soni stepped in and supported us with the same dedication and professionalism. Her help ensured that everything continued smoothly without any delays, which we greatly appreciated.It’s not just Sandhiya and Sunita - everyone at Soresi was so helpful, understanding, and professional. We had very limited time to complete the steps, but thanks to their guidance and dedication, we were able to make it happen.Another thanks to Amber-Leigh Brown for the warm welcome and help with the direct debit setup.We are deeply grateful to the entire Soresi team, and especially to Sandhiya and Sunita, for making this journey to homeownership such a positive experience.

records.title: New purchase
records.text: New purchase. Assistance from Ariana and the team has been exceptional.  Informative friendly and very efficient. Thank you for making the process seamless.

records.title: So Resi guided me through the purchase…
records.text: So Resi guided me through the purchase well and Andrea who worked with me was lovely. Really informative and realistic around my expectations and reminding me about things to look into. Thank you! 🙂

records.title: Great help and experience in selling
records.text: Sylvana was a great in assisting me while I was selling my flat. She was easy to speak to and dealt with all my issues and told me the right people to speak to if she couldn't help. She made the staircasing to sale process smooth and straightforward. Thank you!

records.title: Helped us sell our shared ownership flat
records.text: Helped us sell our shared ownership flat through a sim sale-staircasing. Sylvana was very helpful and prompt. She helped retrieve documents that the buyer's solicitor, which eventually enabled us to complete before Christmas.Many thanks to Sylvana and team for you help!

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Roy Jones helped with repaying our equity loan, he helped turn it around with short notice to make sure we met the deadline. He was helpful and patient in the process and I am very appreciative of all his help.

records.title: I would like to thank Roy J
records.text: I would like to thank Roy J, for all his hard work and Support in sorting out the redemption statement to allow completion in record time. He kept us updated on the process and progress. We really appreciate all his efforts and replying to emails and phone calls to reply to our enquiries even updating after office hours to update on the progress. A big thank you.

records.title: Excellent!
records.text: Renne has been amazing! She has worked with me to overcome problems that arose while I’ve been going through the SO process and just made it so much less stressful! She has been so kind and understanding and I can’t thank her enough for all the support she has given. I really appreciate how she has communicated with me so frequently to keep me updated on the whole process. Thank you Renee!

records.title: final staircasing
records.text: We recently did our final staircasing to own 100% of our home. Our assigned staircasing expert was Sylvana Conroy who gave us all the information we needed to start the process. She was very helpful and throughout and pointed us in the right direction with any queries we had. During the final stage of completion our experience with our solicitors was very stressful as we were aiming to complete before the Christmas holiday period. Sylvana was very helpful as she prompted the solicitors and helped us complete in time! Thank you Sylvana for all your help and quick replies.

records.title: Klaudia Miara has looked after the…
records.text: Klaudia Miara has looked after the after sales process of our resale property. She has been a pleasure to work with, and we are very happy with the service level received. We had tight timescales to achieve our sale completion and Klaudia was there to ensure everything went through on time. We did experience a few bumps in the road however it was dealt with and resolved quickly and efficiently. Shared ownership has been a great stepping stone on to the property ladder for us and would recommend it to first time buyers.

records.title: Thank you Roy for your help
records.text: Thank you Roy for your help. Very polite, patient and knowledgable. The only reason for four not five stars is the phone menu system is very confusing. It took three separate calls and experimenting with about 9 different combinations of submenus to find the correct option. Furthermore, my scheme is with MTVH. I had never heard of SoResi and so when I called it was unclear if I had called the correct number. However, now that I know I can just email Roy and he will call me back I am relieved I will not have to navigate the jungle of menu options again. However, this does need attention.

records.title: Overall it’s a good experience with…
records.text: Overall it’s a good experience with Soresi. With Vanessa help I manage to make a reservation for my new home. Vanessa is very polite and answers all my requests. The process of sharing ownership are very confusing at the beginning but they guide you through the journey step by step. Even though at the beginning I found it very difficult to reach out to them because no one answers the call ( I would suggest they contact the client more proactive) and there are a few typo mistakes on the price list and floor plan but they correct them quickly for me .  I am excited to continue my journey to staircase my property and look forward to move into my new house.

records.title: Thank you Klaudia
records.text: Through a very rough ride to exchange, we had the pleasure of Klaudia working with us. Up until this point I have to admit I found SoResi very hard to get hold of and slow to respond. Once you found a buyer, Klaudia was assigned and has been an absolute dream. I really couldn’t fault her. She has been efficient, positive, polite and really helped to get us to exchange even when I thought it wasn’t possible. Thank you Klaudia, she is a real asset to your team and I hope you appreciate her on your team!

records.title: Good professional service.
records.text: Holly Moran dealt professionally with good communication and was very helpful.I was selling my share in a shared ownership property,which was quite a complicated process.So glad it's all gone through now, with Holly playing a big part in this.

records.title: I was selling my shared ownership
records.text: I am selling my shared ownership and didn't have a great start due to sellers pulling out or simply not replying. However near the end Lubna Suarez pulled out all the stops and secured a buyer very quickly.  Lubna kept in touch on a regular basis and given me great support.One recommendation though.  I would suggest that buyers are vetted more carefully and during the initial checks more viewings are carried out.

records.title: One to one service excellent
records.text: Worked with Ariana Resic for the sale of my property. She was excellent from start to finish. 1st class service, extremely professional and organised things very well and promptly.The only reason this is 4 stars instead of 5 is that getting through on the phone for myself and my purchaser was a problem, and on the rare occasion when Ariana was out of the office it was very difficult to get anyone else to deal with things.Ariana earned the 4 stars on her own and I can't recommend her enough.

records.title: Good communication with rep, mixed feelings about the portal.
records.text: It has been a good experience so far and I feel since getting a buyer the updates have been more frequent. Lubna Suarez was a great contact to have, made great first contact to set up the process and has been good with responding.  I thought the photos looked great however wasn't too impressed with the estate agent that was used so e ded up showing people around myself. The system to show availability for viewing is a bit clunky. Overall a good experience though and looks like I have sold my property through SoResi.

records.title: Good experience so far during the…
records.text: Good experience so far during the process of selling our property. Lubna has been very friendly and helpful. The only negative of the process so far is that when Lubna is on leave etc we can’t seem to get hold of anyone nor receive any kind of updates / communication which has caused delays in answers. On the whole, ok so far.

records.title: A lengthy process.
records.text: Having moved a substantial distance from the flat I am selling, to be able to have much of the administrativework explained and handled on line was of great benefit. The process, however, was complicated somewhat latterly by the introduction of Checkboard which delayed matters. Fortunately a dialogue with a dedicated contact of SOResi resolved these issues.

records.title: Klaudia
records.text: Klaudia, was a good agent from SoResi that help us during our house process. The only thing I would say that was a little bit frustrating was trying to get hold of Klaudia, as her phone line would not connect, which meant I had to keep in trying until the line connected or I would have to send an email. Other than that the service was ok, just need to work on their communicating with clients more often, than the client chasing all the time

records.title: I have been selling by shared ownership…
records.text: I have been selling by shared ownership property, guided by Lubna Suarez at So Resi. My dealings with her have been professional at all times, she has been efficient and very assuring to deal with, she made my selling process go smoothly and provided great guidance in the process to the point of her handover, here's now hoping the new team can complete my sale in my required timescale in the same way. Thank you for giving me the confidence to use your services.

records.title: Goal Achieved, sold my home
records.text: I recently sold my home, and it was quite an interesting journey, especially with MTVH. Despite a few bumps along the way, I’m pleased to say I achieved my end goal and couldn’t be happier with the outcome. Alexander Tozer was my contact, it was a long process but he pushed for the completion date and that was achieved.

records.title: Great Experience with Ahmed
records.text: Great Experience with Ahmed and Renee. I recently purchased a property. The process was difficult due to external parties however Ahmed was amazing throughout the whole process as he explained every step, was always a call away. He reassured me when parts of the process became a challenging. He was a great advisor and provided all the information in thorough detail about the apartment, area etc. He is a credit to So Resi and extremely knowledgeable. On my move in date Renee was on hand with her team to ensure the process with smooth and again, I was in great hands. Renee and Ahmed are both reactive and easy to get a hold off. I would recommend working through these two if you decide to purchase an apartment through So Resi. I will say its not the easiest journey but the end result is worth it and having people like Ahmed and Renee 100% make it easier. A huge thanks to these two!

records.title: Just bought my first home via shared…
records.text: Just bought my first home via shared ownership with SoResi. Shared ownership is (unfortunately) the only realistic way to afford the size I need as i needed a second room for my son. Elliz Kamil, our sales rep, was very helpful throughout the process and made himself available whenever possible as well as answered many questions. There are inevitable 'snagging' issues tbc with the property but the staff at SoResi have been helpful and confirm they have these issues in hand.

records.title: House sold within days
records.text: Sold our house within a couple of days of it being marketed, only to be frustrated by the length of time it took for our buyers to be vetted, but otherwise a very smooth process. Hopefully the next stages will be just as good. We dealt with Lubna and she kept us informed and was very friendly.

records.title: Be patient
records.text: Miss communication from the start after a phone call from Lubna Suarez everything began to run smoothly. She was professional and very helpful. Lubna ensured we were on the right track to purchasing our shared ownership property. Also Dorothy was a huge help.

records.title: Thanks to Klaudia for doing a great job
records.text: So Resi were a little slow to start the process due to staff shortages, but once my sale started Klaudia Miara did an excellent job in keeping me updated and pushing the process along to complete as quickly as possible. It is unfortunate I was not able to receive any updates or get through to anyone while Klaudia was on annual leave. Otherwise Klaudia worked as hard as she could and always answered my queries.

records.title: selling process
records.text: I was selling my shared ownership and didn't have a great start due to unknown reasons to me. However near the end I had a great staff support that made me feel that some of the staff are offering 5 star service specially Lubna Suarez who did a brilliant job in moving the process forward. She has been an excellent star.

records.title: I have recently gone through a partial…
records.text: I have recently gone through a partial redemption.  The initial stages of seeking information was great.  For everything else I could write book on the many barriers  I faced in getting the redemption approved. Sometimes it felt I was being held at ransom. The process began in July and may probably conclude this. It's been time time consuming,  expensive and lack of senior team engagement.

records.title: Dorothy is a great member of staff
records.text: Dorothy has really made this experience easy for myself, great member of staff and always goes above and beyond when ive asked her for assistance. My review would be five stars but I find it very hard to get in touch with my estate agent which can be frustrating.

records.title: Stressful Experience
records.text: I am finding the selling experience very difficult, everything is very slow, lack of communication from Soresi, I’m in the complete dark as to what is going on. It has taken potential buyers to contact me telling me they want to buy be can’t get any response from Soresi, this is very worrying when I could lose buyers. The only thing that’s gone well is the pictures, the company were really nice.

records.title: 3 Stars..
records.text: As a first time buyer, the sale process could have been a very daunting & stressful experience, however Jade has provided a very comprehensive service on behalf of SoResi. Polite, informative & patient with all questions I had. The bar on my future relationship with RoResi has been set very high!Edit: Unfortunatley I spoke too soon. For over 2 months I have been chasing responses & countless emails gone unanswered; I've now passed through 4 case handlers. The service to begin with was fantastic but severely dropped off once the sale moved to Sold STC. Very frustrating experience so far

records.title: Slow start
records.text: Things with SoResi have been a little slow to get going but as soon as I had a resales agent assigned things got moving a lot faster. Lubna Suarez has been really helpful and responsive to my requests. Whilst Lubna was out on annual leave however, getting hold of anyone was a struggle. I never had a reply on the resales email address and calling up there wasn't anyone available to answer in Lubna's absence. The answering team are amazing they genuinely seem like they care and really try to get things sorted.

records.title: Well meaning but very slow
records.text: Despite giving very good notice of the sale, and requesting the mangement pack in good time, a month later I was told "we are just going to request a mangement pack for you". Sadly everything else appeared to my opinion to be done super-slowly. On the plus side, the tone in which I was dealt with when talking on the phone or interacting via email was always upbeat, polite and respectful. I suspect that they have too little staff doing too much even though they mean well.

records.title: Website is good but service not great
records.text: We are obliged to use SOresi as we are selling our shared ownership property. The website and booking system on their site is good however I have been disappointed with their lack of or very slow response times to both people that have contacted them about viewing the property and ourselves.

records.title: Pa Manneh
records.text: Pa Manneh was a really good consultant when finalising the sale. After having a number of issues with a different consultant and being passed pillar to post when Pa got involved he made the finalising of the sale stress free and a breeze! He always replied to emails within a very quick time frame and always made sure he had the correct information.

records.title: Final staircasing process
records.text: I would like to say thank you to Pa Manneh. Who supported me through out the process of the final staircasing process of owning my home.Pa have demonstrated a distinctive client orientation approach from the moment I contacted him. Pa was compassionate with genuine desire to help. Especially at the very early stage. When he successfully managed to set the ball rolling in the process of getting my application moving forward.From a client perspective. I regard Pa Manneh as a great asset for the after sales team in MTVH. Pa Manneh rightfully deserve the best advancement in his career with MTVH and beyond.

records.title: Equity Loan, See a Financial advisor first.
records.text: Roy assisted our solicitor and us very professionally throughout our house sale so we could reimburse our keyworker scheme equity loan and this was done very smoothly. My advice for anyone thinking of taking out one of these loans or schemes is to see a financial advisor first,we did not and paid for it. Our equity loan served us a purpose and got us on the property ladder but we have repaid much more on a much higher interest rate than we would have done if we would have re-mortgage earlier or waited to build a higher deposit. As this type of scheme is for Keyworkers which obviously includes a massive umbrella of staff such as teachers doctors, nurses, paramedics, etc I feel there should be an upper limit to the profit/interest MTVH can charge/make not simply keep rising with the value of your property.

records.title: So Resi
records.text: The first part of the selling process with getting our property on the market, viewings and getting the property sold went well with no hitches. However since the property sold in March '23 we have had issues. We needed our roof tiles replacing due to them being curled, I originally reported this to So Resi in April'23. However nothing was done about this until months down the line. The communication between So Resi and myself was poor, and it was only because I kept ringing and making calls to the relevant agencies that anything got done. Roof is finally being fixed this week - 7 months later!However since Klaudia Miara took over the case things have been better. Communications have been much better, she has kept me informed whether this is via email or phone call. When she has been on annual leave she gave me someone else to whom I could contact with anything due to the ongoing issue with the roof and has also been helpful in chasing up the relevant parties in getting them to give us a date for the roof to be fixed. Even though we are still waiting to exchange and complete, I cannot fault Klaudia with what she has done. if it was just to rate Klaudia on her own, then the stars would of been higher, but I had to think about the overall service before Klaudia and this is where the star rating falls.

records.title: So resi Resales team
records.text: My initial experience was very slow and found it difficult to liase with the resales team, phone line was y working correctly which was initially frustrating , the situation was escalated once I got through to the met housing assoc by a very professional and helpful receptionist , Once this was done the situation improved .Resales person Klaudia was efficient and kept me informed during the latter part of my purchase also her colleague Ben Thanks an finally settled into my new home

records.title: I disliked that Hemel Hempstead was…
records.text: I disliked that Hemel Hempstead was spelt correctly on the post and despite the fact I emailed to inform, this wasn’t changed. So many people have commented on it too.

records.title: Marketing of the property
records.text: No marketing of the property and only one viewing the first week isn't good.However, Hana is very good and I am hoping will help with the sale and the purchase of the lease

records.title: After initial problems relating to…
records.text: After initial problems relating to historic errors, Pa Manneh and his Team worked hard and kept me informed of developments. Any issues I raised were addressed.

records.title: Pa came to the rescue!
records.text: Pa is the ONLY person within SoResi that truly understands that people like myself that are buying a property for the first time require detail, re-assurance and an expert in the field. He was, simply put, outstanding! He helped get the deal over the line, he followed up, knows what he is doing, I could not fault him. Five stars to Pa, he is a credit to his team and organization. Thank you Pa!That said, sadly three other individuals I dealt with I can only describe as amateurs, un-interested and in general EXTREMELY POOR. Specifically Lubna, for every 5 phone calls made to her, only one was answered. The advert of the property had the wrong rent, service charge, lease duration, parking slot allocated to the property which resulted in a very stressful situation that meant I had to increase the amount required for the deposit (thankfully the mortgage advisor had a good relationship with the lender and the increase was reasonable). When I complained and asked for a manager, I did get the details on the second ask. Only good point is she allocated the property to me and my family.The progression manager Alex I was stunned with and not in a good way! Incapable of writing a professional email, referred to me as his mate (I am not nor will I ever be), complete luck of detail when this was requested(I am not buying peanuts from the corner shop, its only the biggest purchase of my lifetime!!). My 9 year old daughter can write better emails than him. Like Lubna, he was also consistent in being difficult to reach, but he was not as bad as her on that front. I cannot think of something he did that I can praise.After complaining to Lubna, you would have thought that she will make her line manager (Ben) aware and he in turn would look to deal with the issue. She did not nor did Ben have the courtesy to deal with an unhappy buyer, so I called her and demanded he contacts me. And to my surprise he did so on the same day, on a Friday after 5pm. That is were praise for Ben starts and finishes. His opening line was I need to apologize for our shortcomings in relation to the false advert about the property hence why I reached out to you. I thought to myself you talking to me now due to my demand, but I stayed quiet on the phone and listened to him apologizing and telling me what he would do about it. He told me he would speak to their specialist that was off for more than a month on Monday and he would come back to me. He didn't, and on Tuesday after 5 calls (can you spot the pattern?) I got through to him for him to say he has no update as he did not see the specialist.I chased again on Wednesday, please note lease was actually 68 years instead of the 99 years posted on their site, and luckily I built a good rapport with the seller and knew that she was prepared so spend the tens of thousands of pounds needed to get the lease back up to 99 years as she wanted to leave the country for personal reasons. Ben though was not aware of this, and instead of him reaching out to her and confirm either way (extend the lease or not) he made the assumption that she would not be prepared to spend this vast amount of money. Over the phone he told me the deal will collapse, as the seller would not extend the lease! Ben did not bother contacting the seller, and he wanted this headache to go away, so he chose to cut corners.Ben simply could not be bothered to do his job. I can see why his subordinates were well below par, you are only as good as you manager they say in my trade. The same way Pa is a huge credit to SoResi, Ben is a huge liability to SoResi. Lastly, Sarah (Head of resales) and also Ben's line manager, also deserves praise. I did speak to her explaining that pretty much everything was broken in my dealings with SoResi and to her credit, she listened and more importantly she acted by allocating Pa to my case and this lead to the deal being sealed and I have now become a property owner!Once again thank you to Pa and Sarah!

description:
Who we are
Housing 21 is a leading, not for profit provider of Extra Care and Retirement Living for older people of modest means. We operate in 215 local authority areas, managing over 24,000 properties and providing over 49,000 hours of social care each week.
Our history
Our roots lie with the Royal British Legion (RBL), which in 1921 began to house disabled ex-servicemen and widows and, later, older ex-servicemen and women. In 1964, we became a recognised housing association before separating from the Royal British Legion in 1993 to become Housing 21.
Our guiding principles
Our three guiding principles are: 21, Better and Experience. We seek to apply these to all that we do.
21
We are committed to providing a modern, forward-thinking 21st century service. This includes updating and modernising our existing housing, as well as developing new and innovative property designs and service models for the future. We will challenge ourselves to think differently, embracing the disruptive potential of new technologies and the challenges and opportunities of social change.
Better
We strive for continuous improvement and innovation in all that we do. We will never become complacent and will constantly challenge ourselves to do better and achieve better performance, quality and value for money. We aim to be ‘better than good’ and work hard to provide excellent services we are proud of and our residents deserve.
Experience
We aim to provide a consistently excellent service and a great experience for all the people we serve. We seek to engage and empower residents to make choices and exercise control over the services they receive and to devolve decision making to local employees who are closest to the residents whenever practicable and possible. We are committed to acting ethically and openly in all that we do, questioning whether we are ‘doing the right thing’ and being ready to acknowledge and learn from mistakes. Ultimately the success of Housing 21 rests on the satisfaction we provide to our residents.

records.title: Housing 21
records.text: So far I have tried 2 different properties from housing 21.  The accommodation is up to date with modern built in appliances, some at eye level if requested.  The shower rooms are fitted with walk in showers & mostly large enough not to trigger my fear of small places!I had a bedsit, which after six months became a goldfish bowl!  Try if possible to obtain a 1 bed flat in which there is enough room to stretch!The manager service is okay, and certainly gives the tenant some one to report faults too.  The maintenance team is great, & comes twice a month.Some of the system, heating and water are inherented from times past. With modern pressures, which also affect the elderly, the inner city courts which offer - a home for life - should have a concierge or night Watchman for security reasons.   In all regards this company has high standards, good structure, and plans forward for improvement in the courts.  At base level, the training schedule for court managers could be improved.  On the whole though, Housing 21 offers good value properties and a way of life for the 55+.

records.title: The manager here is most helpful
records.text: The manager here is most helpful and takes great care of the building and the residents. So, for him I would give 5 stars.However, one star has been lost due to the fact that Housing 21 has decreed that we do not use front door mats as they are supposedly a trip hazard, despite them not protruding into the main thoroughfare, yet the exit doors that everyone uses do have door mats.Also, while Housing 21 declares sensitivity towards LGBT+ residents, it does not seem to be addressing the problems that autistic people suffer - people like myself - who have sensory difficulties. While one of my sensory issues, extremely oversensitive hearing, is supported due to the quiet nature of the residents and the general region, two other sensory issues are not supported. One is light. The building has very bright lights inside the corridor (right outside my door) and outside at night in public places, shining all night. This light, despite my use of blackout curtains and door seals, seeps in and keeps me awake. I understand that this is a security and safety measure, but surely they could be softened at night?The other sensory issue is my sense of smell and associated allergies. Although I am on the top floor, the smell (stench) of strong laundry chemicals wafts up through my windows throughout the day, every day, necessitating my closing my windows to avoid the inevitable allergic reaction of a sore throat and a general feeling of revulsion at the powerful scent.This scent is emitted via a duct placed at the front entrance, so all who enter or exit the building are subjected to it. I would recommend that Housing 21 provides scent free laundry liquid and softener for the use of residents, to combat this.

records.title: Most good about the apartment but not so good with my dealings with your office to my fanally moving in over 6 months after I made the first offer
records.text: I love the apartment and so happy to be finally here after many stressful months. It has been tastefully decorated throughout with high quality fittings in all the communal area and prints on the corridors are particularly pleasant. everything in the apartment has been thought out very well with a locked cupboard for important document medicines etc. Plenty of plugs and safety procedures in place. The box you left with lots of useful contents was a nice touch and thsnk you very much for that. However one or two items need thinking about in future like the taps in the sink appear to be designed for left handed  people, there is no sink trap to stop objects from going into the drains,(which I have bought) same with the shower room you cannot lift the plug out to clean it. There are many very stressful episodes leading up to my finally moving in :1 I was given the name of Sam to contact but only found out later that when she was away no-one picked up her messages till I made a fuss and was transferred to someone else.2 No-one responded  to calls most of the time after 3pm Friday and lunch times and there were two days when everyone was sent on training days so no one available3 I frequently asked the question why number 40 was such difference in price to the other apartments 40 was £131 000 and the others for sale at the time £175-180 000 and was told that an independent surveyor told Housing 21 the amount. Then a week before Christmas I was told that the property was undervalued and also Probate was still outstanding and not likely to be granted till March. As I had sold my house this left me in a very difficult position. Luckily I had a partner with his own house who I could live with which turns out to be from the 19th of January till the 19th of April. This led to a lot of re-organisation for both of us and a lot of cancelled utilities etc as well as the expense of storage.I was able to meet the extra cost because of the sale of my house. But if I had known this previously I would not have been in so much rush to sell my house and would have hung on to the price nearer the valuation which I sold at lower than that for a quick sale.So a lot of stress was caused to me and my family and they especially were worried thinking of my age at 84 and increasing challenges of Parkinson's which is one of the reason's that I wanted to move in here.I hope this may instigate some thought in the way your office works as when my children come to sell this I would not like to think that they would  have the same problems.

records.title: We have effectively been without a…

We now have a new permanent manager (appointed a month ago) who seems to be excellent, plus a new, very efficient cleaning regime, but the general response to past issues (from both area and head office management) have routinely ranged from indifference, to incompetence.
