records.text: Richard Onslows court, Shrewsbury Shropshire More support and transparency when leaving. My 70 yr old parents who have had serious health issues this last yr. (Heart attack, previous stoke and brain damage and father had half a lung removed). They are now moving in with me and have mostly moved put just finally cleaning bits to do. They have been there 5 yr and their notice told them they had to rip up the carpets and since the landlord/housing manager has told the to paint etc. There is really nothing that isn't fair wear and tear there may be some excessive wear and tear due to parents being  unable to complete those regular deep cleans that most of us do 63-6monthly. I have commu scared with them and they just keep being vague and quoting the notice and an exert from the tenancy (decorative condition, furniture removed, fair wear and tear). Which having googled asked tenancy forum etc this appears to be something they can't ask for my parents to do. I think they are rude, vague on purpose to try and make them panic and do more it has been hard on them moving as it is and they are as active as they can be. I just think this is poor management and customer service. Really rubbish.

records.title: Poor customer service

Disgraceful company.

records.title: Pardoe Court Dirty Unkempt Duck Pond

records.title: First Manager is missing a lot

records.title: I have just moved from a scheme in the…

records.title: Administrative contact with Housing 21
records.text: The difficulty in obtaining information throughout the purchasing produce was very poor.  However, the local Housing21 Manager, Michelle Linton, although being new to the post, has and continues to be very helpful and prompt in responding to all matters needing attention.

records.title: Learning to work in partnership with tenants.
records.text: There is clearly much room for improvement.There is a big disparity between what was said to present tenants and now the reality of living in housing 21,Lavender meadows in Stratford upon Avon.This Is a fairly new service and the flats provided for rent are of good standard but with the rent and service charge expensive with the main concern being what you get for your money and the culture of housing 21.If this review is published then I am prepared to talk about specifics.The potential for the service at Lavender is enormous but in my considered opinion presently falls well short of good/best practice.This I am prepared to elaborate on and welcome a debate with the powers at housing 21 about how their service can be much more tenant centred and how to work in partnership with the tenants in a just and equitable fashion.The latest situation that has developed is the massive hike in the rent and service charge starting on 1st,April 2023 this causing real problems as tenants income is forthcoming much later in the month,thus putting a severe stain on individuals.Our bistro has closed leaving vulnerable tenants, family ,loved ones picking up the responsibility for a person living at Lavender meadows with no solution in sight.Despite a huge service charge to gain care support there is a additional charge of over £21 per our and not enough care/support staff to meet the need.The onus of housing 21 appears to have getting money as it’s number 1 goal and leaving this tenant to think that value for money is exceedingly poor and now even more vulnerable and very worried.

records.title: Use a local skip company,  this is an agency.
records.text: I am a landlord. My tenant was moving out and, without my consent, ordered a skip in February via Circle Waste. The tenant moved out on the 18th March, skip was still on the drive. No name was shown on the skip, but after making a number of local skip companies,  I found the tenant had ordered via Circle. By the way, they are only an agent, so if you require a skip, use a local company. The skip had, according to Circle, had overloaded the skip. Plus, after the 19th March,  with the property being empty,  more waste appeared, as I told Circle, would happen.  I have called Circle many times this week, always being promised a call back, but never receiving one. As the skip was ordered by the tenant, so the contract is with them, and the lack of response from Circle, even as I have reduced the skip height, photographs sent, legally the skip is causing an obstruction on my property. If I don't receive an answer to resolve this tomorrow,  31st March, a local company will arrange to pick up and they can keep the skip. I have informed Circle of this, guess what, No reply. Also recommend,  if you have a bad experience,  report them to the Environmental Agency, they issue licenses. After spending over a week talking and emailing Circle Waste, eventually received a solution and everything went to plan, even if I had to do the work myself.  Maybe a lesson to landlords, ensure the skip is requested via you and it is cleared before ending the tenancy.

records.title: Not a great experience
records.text: Absolutely shocking experience with them. They were the third company of three I rang. First two quotes were £260 and £270 then I rang them and they said £250. I then check my invoice the next day and they have taken £300 - it said £250 plus VAT which I was not made aware of on the call. I call back every day for a week asking for Matt Driscoll who happens to be on lunch every time I call (even a different times in the day). Eventually he emails me saying he had covid (even though he was working), and that the refund of the difference I paid versus the second highest quote would be refunded. It is now over a month gone by and I still have not received my refund. I rung him today and he was… on lunch. The other operator said Matt would ring or email me… this still hasn’t happened.As a side note, I ordered for the 5th November - three weeks from when I made the booking. The skip arrived the next day (three weeks early), the issue being this was not my property as I was to move in on the 5th November. As you can imagine the existing owners were not pleased.Update (7/12). The day after this post I was refunded the difference. Then a few days later Charlie from Resolutions contacted me to add to my refund to the amount I was originally quoted (which was £250). Have changed my review from 1 to 3 stars for this resolution.

records.title: Never using Circlewaste Services
records.text: I used Circlewaste Services  for a 8yard skip. Things didn’t go as planned as the skip had been taken away prior to the delivery date and without acknowledgment. When I made contact to highlight the issue. Adam Jones was nothing but professional and understanding. He appreciated my point of view and resolved the issue immediately. As that is what I thought. The skip didn’t arrive until 2 days after and late afternoon. Until then I had traders waiting around as we couldn't continue with the work as the rubbish was in the way. I had to constantly chase them for an up date, even though they said they would call me. When I asked to be put through to the manager Chris. This was completely pointless. He continues to explain how lucky I was that i got a skip as other companies wouldn’t have bothered. I had to inform him not to speak on behalf of other companies and to concentrate on his dept. The lack of communication and direction clearly shows with the company. The repercussions of this delay put off the other traders from using this company. Unreliable

records.title: Nice staff, lousy company
records.text: Do not use this company if you're working to any kind of deadline.We hired a skip for two weeks to be delivered to and left on our drive (behind locked gates). We were told that it would arrive between 8.00 and 12.00. It arrived at 7.25. OK, just a minor inconvenience and one that afforded the driver the less than glamorous sight of me still in my dressing gown.The real problem was when it came to collection. The person I'd spoken to on the phone when I made the booking said that it would be collected on Thursday 15 August. This was perfect as we would be permanently vacating the property the following Tuesday and returning to Spain where we've lived for a number of years.When it got to 15.00 and no one had called advising us of the collection time that Thursday, I phoned the company. The person I spoke to then said they had no vehicles in the area but it would be collected the next day or Monday morning at the latest. It wasn't.On Monday afternoon I tried to phone the company again but evidently Monday is their busiest day and three separate attempts resulted in around 40 minutes of musak -- but no human operator.I emailed the company explaining that we needed to have the skip gone by Tuesday lunchtime. No response.On Tuesday morning, I phoned to company and, after only about 10 minutes on hold, got to speak to a person. She told me the skip was booked in for collection on Wednesday. She said I should have been advised at the time of booking that there could be up to five working days' delay in collection after the date quoted. I wasn't -- otherwise I would have clarified my situation at the time. Our travel dates were known to us months before we hired the skip.Having lived abroad for many years, we have no friends in the area or neighbours whom we could trust to open the gates and admit the skip driver to the property, besides which, as the house has been sold, I'm not even sure that would be legal.So we have had to hang around for an extra three days (no ferries from the UK to northern Spain available until then), miss the ferry we were supposed to be catching, and stay in a hotel as the house is no longer ours. This skip that was supposed to cost us a little over £200? Well, what with the ferry we were unable to catch, the extra cost of rebooking (prices have gone up as it's now holiday time), and three nights in a hotel... we're around £1400 out of pocket -- plus the cost of the skip.I would add that the drivers and people in the call centre are all very nice and helpful but that does not compensate for the overall incompetence of Circle Waste.

The most surprising part was your follow up call to me to find out how I had found the site and providing useful tips when viewing the homes, also what benefits I might be able to access for my relative. Your staff are so kind and compassionate at a time when I am feeling exhausted, overwhelmed and upset, you were there for me also and have suggested support sites or calling you back. Your organization is truly  amazing and I was blown away by the care and compassion. Many thanks for your help you have really lightened my load.

records.title: Helpful support
records.text: Joe was very helpful at identifying Care Homes which he felt would match the requirements for my Mum's care. He was kind, friendly and knowledgeable. Using the Lottie website with its links to care providers' websites and CQC reports, together with personal recommendations, advice and actual visits helped my decision-making process, and I'm very happy with the home I selected.

records.title: Updated: bad initial experience, great customer care
records.text: UPDATE: I got a call from Lottie shortly after this review and I am reassured that my experience was an accident. The tech team is now investigating why I didn’t get the “do not contact me” option in the form on my mobile browser and seeing if they can recreate the error. As for the phone number leaking to a carer agency outside the shortlist, it is unclear what happened but it is unlikely that the leak was on Lottie’s side and not one of their partners’. As upsetting as the initial experience was, I am very happy with the followup.I used Lottie’s database to search for local carers and there is no way to view the results without consenting to calls from agencies… and I have now received insistent calls from more agencies than the ones whose details were shared with me. They very much don’t stop after one left voicemail message either. I have had ten unsolicited calls (ten!) in the last 24 hours. The whole reason I need a carer is that I have a severely energy-limiting condition. I simply do not have the capacity to deal with predatory calls. I knew I wasn’t interested in some of the options based on price the moment I got the search results — there wasn’t a way to at least not let them call me. There is no way to inform Lottie that you have chosen a carer and don’t need all these calls either — or if there is, I have not found it, which means it is hidden away in an extremely non-user-friendly way. I wanted a service that gave me control, which has to include a chance to contact prospective carers first. Instead I am hounded with calls from agencies I was never interested in.

records.title: Very helpful
records.text: Very helpful, prompt and empathetic.Am following up on all the advice that Lottie gave me.Thanks Lottie!

records.title: Clara was very professional yet very…

So thank you

records.title: Very supportive

records.title: Lottie is a very useful site but i did…

records.title: The site gave a good comprehensive list…
records.text: The site gave a good comprehensive list of care homes base on a few simple but relevant questions. It made the job of searching for care homes simple. They all showed a real interest in our requirements and gave some useful information to help with our search.

records.title: Friendly and helpful
records.text: Friendly and helpful I was contacted and offered assistance with looking for a care home for mum after visiting their website, which is a weight off my mind as I was not getting very far searching on my own.  They offered advice and would follow up with an email.  They were friendly and polite and look forward to making some progress.

records.title: Help in tricky times
records.text: We were in a rush to find a home for my father who has dementia as my step mother wasn't able to cope with him any more.  everywhere we found shut after assessment due to covid, but Will kept helping us find alternatives and we found somewhere covid free in the end.  Its location was far from ideal, but the care excellent, and he's in safe hands till we find somewhere with a large garden. Will also made a huge difference to our search by advising (it transpired correctly) that we'd been badly advised as to the level of care needed.  His advice opened up far more possibilities, and I'm very grateful to him.  Lottie worked for us.

records.title: Respite Care for my mum post operation
records.text: I had to find a care home for my elderly mother to go to after a hip replacement operation. I did not know where to start, and knew nothing about care homes. She needed a short stay, and the Lottie representative explained everything to me and was very reassuring and caring. She really put me at ease, and started looking at suitable care homes for me. From that I started to get a much clearer picture of what the options are. She also spoke to managers at the homes so that when I phoned them it was much easier to get through and speak to them.

records.title: Easy to use great resource
records.text: Lottie provided a good shortlist of highly rated care providers several of whom got in touch with me and offered to meet and discuss the care requirements we have. Simple and easy to use. Useful site.

records.title: WFrustration !hy asked to enter preferences/red…
records.text: Why asked to enter preferences/red lines, then post details of totally inappropriate properties that you have to scroll thru to find anything that remotely suits ? No way that I could see of just rejecting.

records.title: They are trying to drum up trade
records.text: A Google search brought up what I thought might be an interesting article, so I clicked on the link and it brought me to Lottie. Unfortunately, a panel popped up on the right of the screen and prevented me from reading the article. It insisted on asking me irrelevant questions before I could move back to the article. So I clicked on one of the irrelevant answers. Then it took me to another screen and would not let me go back to the article.I am not allowed to edit this to include the link to the page it would not let me read. Try looking for lottie.org fees-funding pip-freebies and perhaps you can find it.29.06.2024Got an email from the founder. Nice try, but the email was addressed to someone else. If you had responded appropriately I would have considered deleting this review.

records.title: Not impressed at all
records.text: Not impressed at all. This is the first and last time I will use lottie! I hit the No thanks I do NOT want any phone calls from the various care homes I was looking at. All I have had is phone calls from most of the homes as Lottie has informed them I wanted a call from them. I have explained each time that it was lotties fault that they, meaning the care homes, had been given false information and wasted their time. I also explained to them that I would be telling lottie about their own poor service.It is infuriating that as a user I have to give much more information than I wanted before I could see care homes, but to have the given information ignored by the same company shows what little worth they have in the care home sector. What a waste of my time and also a waste of the care homes personnel’s time who made the calls to me!

records.title: the operator on the phone was polite…
records.text: the operator on the phone was polite and cheerful she kept apologising because her computer was slow  the 2    workmen that come got on with  there job with no fuss very pleased

records.title: Excellent service from the Repairs Team
records.text: Woke up this morning to a cold bungalow as the heating hadn't switched on.Checked the normal things and still didn't come on.Rang Pfp at 8am and by 11am a service engineer had arrived.Sorted the problem quickly and now back to a lovely warm property.Well done PfP ! Excellent service all round.

records.title: From the moment I applied they reached…
records.text: From the moment I applied they reached out within hours the whole process has been amazing

records.title: I love my home and would not want to be…
records.text: I love my home and would not want to be anywhere else. They respect me and during covid went out of their way to check i was ok especially leanne. I would wish in the future that some improvements could be split if for eg i bought a new radiator they would fit it for me providing the materials but the added security that it is done properly with trusted workforce. They went out of their way sending somebody to fix a leak he was respectful and really over qualified but otherwise i would have had to wait till next march to get this sorted. My grateful thanks to all concerned.

records.title: Very quick response for any problems
records.text: Very quick response for any problems

records.title: They fixed my boiler and cleaned up the mess
records.text: They finally fixed my boiler after several visits and a new boiler. The fault was with the new boiler and not the engineer who came out . One of the pipes had not been screwed up tight so it was leaking. The engineer soon had the leak under control and cleaned up the mess.

records.title: I think it is a good company to be…
records.text: I think it is a good company to be with.Always there if you phone about any problem.

records.title: Places for people 4 stars.
records.text: Places for people are pretty good at responding to a repair. Also they can be helpful with regards to rent and any concerns. One thing I think places for people  could work on and that is keeping more in contact with tenants especially if they have a mental health problems or if they have a general disability and keeping in contact with the older tenants.

records.title: Great listeners to the complaints made…
records.text: Great listeners to the complaints made about dog barking incidents !! Unfortunately the problem is still ongoing ! Places for people have not sorted the tenent out and the dogs continue to bark !! Disappointing to tell the truth .

records.title: Moving house
records.text: Very helpful when we applied for a house. Good communication..only issue I have is trying to get permission for any alterations ie online form does not work and it takes a long time to have a paper copy sent out..

records.title: Personal impressions
records.text: I’m impressed at the way the gardens are maintained however the car park/road on the site badly need repairing.My front door which I think is very old needs replacing as in keeping with the neighbours. Depending how the wind blows when it’s raining it appears to be seeping in and lifting wallpaper. It smells on opening my front door to smell on wet paper on entering the flat.

records.title: Overall it was very good
records.text: Overall it was very good. It is a bit of a mixture though.The original lady, who showed us the property, was pleasant and polite, and was there to greet us. She didn't sort out a couple of problems we had regarding keys though and was inaccurate on the information regarding utilities.The lady that I contacted at your main office to sort out all the final paperwork was polite, professional, pleasant and efficient.The repairs we needed have been haphazard, with people getting times and dates and jobs wrong,  nevertheless the work done has been excellent and each of the workmen polite and helpful and did a good job.I think that 4 stars is about right considering the above.

records.title: I bought an ex show house and had a…
records.text: I bought an ex show house and had a number of faults, these were rectified quickly upon notification. The only problem we have found is having only one radiator in the open plan lounge/diner/kitchen which doesn’t heat the space satisfactorily.

records.title: Living here at Mellors Court for the…
records.text: Living here at Mellors Court for the last year and a half I have been fairly comfortable in general.I’ve found the company very helpful in every circumstance.Following a meeting  a few months back with residents, former manager and two ladies from other entities I was pleased to know that some of the matters which arose have since been addressed and promises made for others to be attended to.I am also happy to have the assurance that someone would call at times to check to see if us the residents are okay or have any needs.Many thanks to the Team

records.title: Good service but were very slow on our…can do better
records.text: Good service but were very slow on our fence repair also we feel forgotten with our neighbours on the state of our windows doors and exterior decorating Cost of rental is fair and the new online service provided is also good

records.title: community walk
records.text: i went to Castle Park to go on the community walk but couldnt find anyone.   it was not signposted or anything and i didnt go as far as the bandstand, where apparently everyone on the walk met. missed out on what probably was a good experience. Also the landscape/gardening team either don't come enough and when they do they're over-zealous with the cutting back of bushes/shrubs.

records.title: Substandard repairs
records.text: The latest repair of fitting a cupboard door in the hallway, after a long wait for the appointment & emails to Customer Service Manager, was not fitted to an acceptable standard... in fact... wouldn't close. I complained & now have an appointment for January 2025 for it to be remeasured. I have given a 4 star as I can see Places for People are putting a lot of work in to improve their standards of repair work & the extra star I have given is because of Leann Hibbert , Customer Service Manager, who has been extremely helpful & professional especially with the kitchen refit previous.

records.title: Job ongoing not being done until may…
records.text: Job ongoing not being done until may 2025. So can't comment on work yet

records.title: Some things still need addressing such…
records.text: Some things still need addressing such as phoning customer relations the instructions can hardly be heard, this isn't good after all not all elderly people have good hearing and after trying to hear the instructions it is sometimes easier  to give up. This has also been remarked on by other residents.

records.title: I’ve moved into two bedroom flat
records.text: I’ve moved into two bedroom flat. I’m very happy with it. They’re just a a few problems. It’s been empty for a year but it was only when I moved in. They found out it needed a new boiler and gas supply so I spent two weeks without any heating or hot waterthat could easily have been avoided other than that I’m pleased. In general of the block is in good condition Neighbours seem very friendly and there’s a beautiful garden.  Glad to be here.

records.title: Places for people are a  fantastic…
records.text: Places for people are a  fantastic housing association however the only downside is that they don't upgrade their properties much. If you need a repair though they are pretty quick to respond and very friendly 😊

records.title: Struggled to find a number to ring and…
records.text: Struggled to find a number to ring and couldn’t go online.Once the job was booked it was carried out very well and I didn’t need to be there.  The person who did the job even connected the broken guttering successfully to the neighbouring guttering

records.title: Places For People -  Kitchen Light Repair
records.text: Places For People attended our property to repair our celing light fitting. Turned out it needed replacing. The operatives did the job smoothly and efficiently, and were very polite.

records.title: Keeping up with repairs?
records.text: I am not one for moaning.  I sent an extensive list of small outstanding communal repairs, only half of them have been covered.  I don't have the time or patience to chase these up, but I will now I have some time available to do so.

records.title: Once reported
records.text: Once reported, repairs are promptly dealt with by polite, helpful staff. However, the landscaping problem, which has been a real issue for years, has yet to be resolved. Hence the 4 and not 5 star. Sorry!

records.title: Terrible booking system
records.text: I assume that this is to do with the repairs to our central heating boiler. Generally, the engineers were great but the booking was a total disaster, with engineers not coming when we were told they would, and coming when they were not supposed to, with us being out! Complete mess and hardly instils confidence in the system. Time to sort it!!!

records.title: I have berm miss informed about the…
records.text: I have been misinformed about the road closure around my new property.We woke up one morning to find bollards across roads. There is now only one exit through an existing housing estate.I pity anyone who needs emergency services as they will never get through.

records.title: When I first notified you of our damp…
records.text: When I first notified you of our damp problem, you must be congratulated at your speedy response you took, in attempting to rectify this. However, the remedy provided by 'Envirovent' proved mostly inadequate. The system only worked if the bathroom door,( where the 'continuous' fan operated), was left open at night, and the door to the bedroom was also left open.? Thus keeping a constant movement of fresh air into the sleeping area. This was proven on our vacating the property, by the amount of time, and further work needed throughout the flat, to bring it up to a habitable standard. Hence only 3 Stars.

records.title: Repairs/ maintenance department needs to be  reviewed
records.text: Workmen being sent to carry out certain planned jobs/repairs but unskilled, twice in the last month signed out sick at last minute and unwilling to carry out the work needed. This problem has been long long term (from 2013). There have been workmen this year who were very good and jobs completed properly, willingly and on time , so hoping this good standard can be maintained.

records.title: Important checks and services are often not completed properly
records.text: Switches left off, important plugs left out, sharp debris on floors and carpets and a promise to return in two months!

records.title: Take to long to carry out repairs phone…
records.text: Take to long to carry out repairs phone lines always take to long to get through always long queues. Do not keep front of the building in good repair and clean. Grass cutting carried out is a joke looks a right state after gardeners have been. Very bushy and high shrubs planted alongside path way which restricts the pathway  no body checks them.

records.title: Not very quick to repair problems in…
records.text: Not very quick to repair problems in the property this is a negative to me a lot slower than other landlords would be a big downfall

records.title: I’ve been trying for years to get…
records.text: I’ve been trying for years to get cracks in the wall and damp spots sorted but all they do is take photos and that’s the last I ever hear about it,  they did send a surveyor out a year or so back who recommended that it needs to be repointed, but nothing has happened yet. It’s annoying because I need to get the place decorated but no point when the paper keeps peeling off. Apart from that they are amazing.

records.title: Use of scaffolding for repair work.
records.text: Overall Places For People are doing OK. My main criticism is that we are not informed when work which requires scaffolding is about to begin. All I see is scaffolding going up and not knowing what the job is, how long the job is going to take and when the scaffolding will be removed.Scaffolding reduces building security, especially when it has been there for some time. I have seen scaffolding still there for months at a time. More control over the tepairr work is required so that times and costs can be minimised.We should be informed of repair work either by email and/or notice board.RegardsBrian Hilton

records.title: Customer review
records.text: I’m satisfied with my property and the location in which the property is based in but when I moved into the property the agent who showed me around never mentioned that they was damp and mould behind one of the walls which now means that somebody is due to come out. I just think she should have mentioned before showing me how to send the money into the places for people bank account.

records.title: A few times I have been given an…
records.text: A few times I have been given an appointment. From different agencies. But they never tell me what it's for. I had to phone the agency regarding an appointment with engineer. But there was no information why . Need to explain why they are coming into property

records.title: Only do what they need to do once you complain
records.text: my recent experience was a complaint, regarding work carried out by a contractor employed by p4p.I was told at the end of the conversation that i would be contacted by the contractor, but i was not. I was also told i would be contacted by the department that look after the housing stock, but once again, no contact. P4P don't do anything unless you escalate it to a complaint, where they have no choice but to do something.

records.title: Resource Issues
records.text: There seems to be a distinct lack of resources at PFP to rectify issues, for example it took 3 months and 3 visits to fix the leak in my bathroom. It is still only half finished as the floor needs replacing but at least it is not flooding the room below me now.

records.title: They are okay
records.text: They are okay. I’m not very happy with the quality of their repairs, I had to re-silicone the bath tub’s edge as it kept leaking, even after their repair. But at least they found the problem for me.I have to add, I was very amazed and am still very grateful for the new staircase they put in. The last one wasn’t level and (as it turned out) the banister wasn’t according current regulations, but at first they weren’t going to replace it, but somehow it got done. So I thank PfP for that one!

records.title: Poor consultation…
records.text: Double glazing fitted to housing scheme.Despite letter apologising for lack of consultation and useful timetabling.It was a shambles. THE Coordinator  was frequently unavailable. When miraculously the phone was answered,  standard reply was 'I will ask my manager' then no return call.Supliers were changed, as we're spec's  for the widows causing  disruption to  fitters etc.Not an enjoyable experience

records.title: Improvement on communication and repair times
records.text: I reported a repair and the plumber was an absolute star and fixed the problem, it's made such a difference in our home I cant tell you how grateful I am. It just took PFP weeks to get the plumber there, which is a shame. Although I don't think this is PFP directly. The work on improvements to properties in Spaldwick has not been well communicated I have requested to work from home twice now and no one has turned up. and one of these days they called the day before to ask if they can come so I had to make special arrangements with work at short notice, they did not turn up, only explained what happened because I chased them and now I have no clue when they will be back. I want to be accommodating for them to do the work but they need to give a bit of notice for dates and stick to them. Let people know what is happening. Thanks

records.title: Couldn't report repair online as I used…
records.text: Couldn't report repair online as I used to. Had to phone to book appointment, then went online later to report it as a security risk, and had visit same day, which was good. Needed further repair which was 2 months later. Seems to be a lack of availability.

records.title: When I need repairs seen to they are…
records.text: When I need repairs seen to they are often done fairly quick.Emergency calls are dealt with very efficiently too.My last housing officer (Catriona Fraser) was the best person I have ever dealt with in housing in over 20 plus years and this includes 2 other council areas.Sadly she has retired and will be missed.I've yet to hear anything from my new officer.The windows and kitchen are extremely outdated but no one seems bothered much just now!I pay my rent on time and I think this should earn me priority status,something I think you should consider for good tenants???What about a weekly/monthly cash draw too.Or even just rewards to appreciate good tenants??I've been with you for over 10 years and hope you want to keep me content by making things better.Hope this email will assist you.

records.title: Space
records.text: The space in the flats are too small, especially my kitchen and bedroom. Only the bathroom is to my suite. As it is now, am running out of space, need more space for my clothes.  I am still unhappy about the emergency escape ramp that is not install. Another thing,  I am  still trying to find out at what stages or time  does one becomes a long-term tennant?

records.title: Good experience but after care isn’t great
records.text: Had a really good experience buying our house and leading up to moving in, but the aftercare let the whole experience down. Communication was very poor.Overall, still had a good experience and I’m happy I’m my home.

records.title: Very disappointed
records.text: Very disappointed Generally I am satisfied not requesting much from PfP repairs have been dealt with. I was told we should have a new bathroom after 25 years still waiting to hear about thatAlso having to police drug dealers ourselves we have to fill in log book have done wait and see if they do anything, I am becoming very ill with coming and going bikes dogs in stair all day long, these dealers have the arrogance to move in and start dealing 3 weeks into tenancy, how do they manage to get a and keep tenancy, I have been with places for people over 25 years and feel very disappointed and upset they have done this to us again we had dealers below for over 6 years

records.title: I have lived in an 55s building for…
records.text: I have lived in an 55s building for over three years,at  this very time the neighbors beneath me smokes weed every day, I have complained  3 times with an empty promise of someone reaching out We have a resident who sells drugs from his home and has given his customers the PIN number for the gate and to enter our building so ALL DAY LONG we have drug users entering the building or through “locked “ gates This problem had been reported to the manager for the last 8 months, she said she would have a warning sent to him , but then she left this position and told my neighbor she didn’t report him because nobody complained We are paying for security cameras that cost £10’000 but nobody looks at them even though we have given the day and time of the issues we have seen , the drug users are now using our washing machines and shower room , HOW LONG DO WE HAVE TO LIVE WITH THIS OUTRAGE , maybe until something disastrous happens and it’s too late

records.title: Fed up
records.text: Places for people are absolutely atrocious at responding to & carrying out repairs or improvements. It’s like the office staff fail to communicate with the staff on the ground. The only way to get a response is to raise a complaint.

records.title: k of communication also takes far to…
records.text: Lack of communication also takes far to long get get repairs done can be up to 2 months very poor service

records.title: These flats were supposed to be for…
records.text: These flats were supposed to be for over 50,s.We now have 20 somethings who have barbecue,s ,drink excessively fight amongst themselves and take drugs.Damage their properties and are generally offensive characters. I wish I could move to a more decent accommodation. But I have put a lot of money into my own premises.

records.title: I had to wait far to long for my heater…
records.text: I had to wait far to long for my heater to be fixed.  Damian was lovely, it's taken him five minutes to fix the problem.  Just a matter of changing the heater, it's  taken P.F.P many many weeks to get here.Less of a wait would be good.Must try harder P.F.P

records.title: Takes awhile for repairs
records.text: Waiting on repairs I reported since I moved in. Taking awhile, I had no toilet for 2 weeks and had to wait for repair I had to keep ringing up got different reasons they only have 1 plumber, they sent someone who wasn't a plumber, wasn't down as a emergency ended up having to complain. Not the greatest for repairs etc.

records.title: Is damp and mould being ignored?
records.text: Since we had a survey into a problem with damp and mould we have not had any updates. We sent a request for further information after a two week period but have still had no response. This is a situation where our health is being compromised. The issue was supposed to have been given high priority. It is now three weeks since the survey was conducted.

records.title: Housing
records.text: The reason for 2xstars the state of the cleaning of the property is not satisfactory. You need to inspect property's after so called cleaning .Also don't put one amount on site when in reality it's another.

records.title: Applied for alterations to add a shower…
records.text: Applied for alterations to add a shower over my bath . Forms sent 28th aug after 5 emails and 4 phone calls still waiting for answer . Other than that flat is great just your office letting yourselves down .

description:
We pride ourselves on offering quality cremation services at an affordable price.

As part of the Memoria group we have a mission to provide exceptional standards of service and facility to the bereaved families that use its crematoria and gardens of remembrance. This is because it is not only commercially sensible to do so but also because it is an essential act of human decency towards people who have just lost a much loved member of their family or friends.

records.title: My Friend John Cawley
records.text: My Friend John Cawley of over 30yrs passed away in the Royal Derby Hospital on the 15/12/24.he had no funeral plan and had previously told me that the council can cremate him but I found out that if the council did this there would be no return of the ashes.On knowing this l looked on line for a simple though respectable cremation at a reasonable cost and I found low cost funerals and rang up and spoke to a woman called Sam Duffett who was friendly and helpful and explained the cremation procedure to me and kept me informed of of everything that was happening with regard to my late friend.I would recommend low cost funerals to anyone looking for a respectful cremation service without the usual costs of a full funeral service which are expensive and family and friends can remember the deceased person in their own way.Thank youStephen Bishop

records.title: Sue was a great help
records.text: Sue was a great help, she was kind and considerate and made the process easy as can be. Our family would highly recommend this service.

records.title: Such An Amazing Service
records.text: I cannot begin to describe what a beautiful service my wonderful husband Ian had yesterday. Everything went as planned and Shirley was amazing. I cannot thank you enough for doing such a wonderful job.

records.title: Christmas time funeral
records.text: They made a bad time bearable and arranging a funeral so easy.  Very helpful with my endless queries and were just great to deal with and communicated every step of the way.It meant a lot being allowed the freedom to step outside the normal funeral boundaries by honouring Dad the way he wanted to be remembered, sticking his 2 fingers up to political correctness with the song choice.It couldn’t have gone any better, the flowers were beautiful and the celebrant was the perfect fit for our family.

records.title: As you advertised.
records.text: As you advertised.. to me I totally couldent find a better way of service..you have been absolutely genuinely appreciated for the help you gave me throughout this ordeal...I really do appreciate what you have done for me and my late son darren...thank you once again I truly would recommend your services to anyone including myself...not to  soon though...thank you..(james stott)

records.title: Kind, compassionate service
records.text: Your lovely colleague Rhonda was so patient, kind and compassionate in her dealings with me as we navigated this sad situation. She made everything simple and did everything in her power to accommodate our wishes. She's a great ambassador for your company and a pleasure to deal with.

records.title: Great support at a difficult time
records.text: We approached Memoria as Mum didn't want a "proper full on" funeral. Rhonda was so helpful and always available to answer any questions and rearrange things. When we couldn't get the date arranged at our original choice, she was able to help me organise a small attendance gathering at a lovely chapel with the date to fit with my brother travelling from abroad. Would definitely recommend.

records.title: Supported step by step
records.text: Every step of the way we were supported and given all the options to choose the perfect send off for my Dad.Nicki was very helpful and guided us through the process. We were kept updated at all times.The funeral home that was chosen were exceptional, very kind, supportive and helpful and went the extra mile for us making the morning special and as perfect as it could be during this upsetting time.

records.title: Very impressed with the service we…
records.text: Very impressed with the service we received. Really helpful and compassionate. Nothing was to much trouble and kept informed at all times. Would highly recommend.

records.title: Difficult time made simple.
records.text: This has been the most difficult time I've had to endure and the only reason I managed to get through it is because of Rhonda, she has made everything so easy for me to deal with. She went above and beyond for me and made everything as stress free as it possibly could have been. Thank you for everything i couldn't recommend this company highly enough.

records.title: My daughters funeral.
records.text: Everything went well except that the flowers were not put on the coffin as expected. The staff were very sympathetic and acted perfectly at all times.

records.title: Professional but very caring
records.text: Ah need to edit! You've put dad as the reviewer. He's the one who passed. I'm his daughter.... Whoops! The staff on the phone were very caring and attentive. The process of picking dad up from the care home was very smooth and I had nothing to worry about. I wonder if the cremation and return of ashes could be a quicker experience? I was at peace with my dad's passing but some may find a "28 day window" a little too long. Overall excellent though.

records.title: Sad day.
records.text: Everything went smoothy. Nicki was very pleasant to deal with. Helps at times like this. I was told a rough time for the cremation. Someone would ring to confirm. No one did so we went ahead not knowing the precise time. The only complaint so would use them again.

records.title: Father’s cremation
records.text: The company was very professional and supportive at this traumatic time, which made things that little bit easier. They took their time to gather all information which helped as I could not deal with too much at once.

records.title: Helpful and compassionate funeral arranger
records.text: Our funeral arranger was very helpful and supportive. My mum had pre arranged the funeral plan but from the moment we called the telephone number on the little card when mum passed away the company was very helpful and compassionate and kept our family very well updated at this sad time.

records.title: Direct cremation is OK
records.text: We had a direct cremation so no service but we were given a time of the cremation which enabled us to gather at North Oxford Crematorium.  We located a stone circle on the site which was perfect for us all. Surprised they don’t promote the gardens more.

records.title: My lovely daughter Rebecca was snatched…
records.text: My lovely daughter Rebecca was snatched away from me without warning, it was the worst day of my life by far.When I contacted Memoria Nicki and her colleagues treated me with the utmost respect and dignity. The help and understanding they offered me made the whole procedure easier.Chris Brewer

records.title: True peace of mind .Thank-you
records.text: The telephone conversation letting know all that we needed to know was 100% informative, but also sensitive and understanding.  The only reason  I knocked 1point off was that the follow through with the paperwork was abit slow. Also we had to do some chasing up to get hold of a paper copy of the crematorium etc. Price and regulations very fair.

records.title: We decided not to proceed with the plan…
records.text: We decided not to proceed with the plan but the plan was cancelled without any problems. I suggest people discuss with their family first as these plans may impact on grieving. Also be aware of cost of collection of loved one other than hospital 42percent of people die in hospital.

records.title: Hayley was extremely polite
records.text: Hayley was extremely polite, helpful and sympathetic at a difficult time. She controlled arrangements as I had hoped.My only negative comment would be the invoice for a doctors fee pre cremation. Maybe I missed the small print but this came as a surprise.

records.title: Experience with Low Cost Funeral’s
records.text: My younger brother passed away suddenly and I chose Low Cost Funerals for his cremation. At first I was concerned about having to chase the team for information and experienced my calls and emails not being returned. This is why I haven’t given five stars. However fortunately our case was then assigned to Rhonda Blair and she showed both kindness and support during the most difficult time in my life. She helped me organise the best type of funeral for my brother and was very patient and knowledgeable throughout the whole process. At the service Robert and Michael were very supportive and professional. Thank you to them both too.

records.title: Becky was very professional
records.text: Becky was very professional, considerate and polite. I gave 4 stars because i never received a call back from my initial call as promised.when I followed this up, I was promised that my case would be logged and I would be called back. I was called back by the lovely Becky who was a blessing to have. Her colleague who covered her leave was also professional.

records.title: The staff were very helpful and…
records.text: The staff were very helpful and accommodating especially when we were close to printing deadlines for the order of service.  The funeral went very smoothly and the staff present on the day were very supportive.  Thank you

records.title: Affordable Funerals - A great way to remember a sad day
records.text: Affordable Funerals - A great way to remember a sad day. I worked with Quona Baylis and Rhonda Blair and my experience was really good, epecially as there was a significant change in plan part way through. Best wishes and kind regards, BD.

records.title: So far so good
records.text: I first made contact in November just before going on holiday and was contacted on the day of my return but said please call back in a few days. There was no return call. I called again later and was told that the original scheme was no longer available. A new scheme was suggested. I made contact again after receiving details of the new scheme that I didn't like but was later told that the original scheme WAS still available and went for it. Of course, the proof of the pudding is in the eating so we shall have to see.

records.title: Good  experience…
records.text: Gabrielle made the whole experience very easy and informative throughout the process. Not the easiest subject talk about but  very well dealt with. The only one issue I had was her being late for a phone call for my decision.

records.title: Easy to set up the cremation plan
records.text: Easy to set up the cremation plan, very prompt service by their partners the Co-op.A couple of problems with communication by Memoria due to ill health.The actual cremation was 27 days later than the death.

records.title: As painless as possible under the circumstances
records.text: Very pleasant, helpful people. Honest advice about process and costs. Slight minus was Memoria understandably use their crematorium rather than nearest one. This was explained before booking so more of an observation than complaint.

records.title: The quality in funerals at a low cost
records.text: The staff are fabulous in the office and help quickly with anything.As a Celebrant it's always an honour to give the best service to families.The funeral directors are a joy to work with, they make you feel at ease and everyone works as a team.Thank you

records.title: Affordable Funerals
records.text: We used the direct cremation service. We were issued with a person to contact and phone number to ring if we had any queries or concerns following the death of my mother in law. We managed to speak and get hold of someone every time and were happy with their response. My only issue was that they were only able to give a date and no time when the cremation was going to take place. In addition, we were never informed that the cremation had actually taken place, and therefore, left wondering if it had? I telephoned the following day to find out. They informed me that they never informed anyone of this and Affordable Funerals had to contact the crematorium to find out. I found this very disappointing in terms of a lack of understanding a families need for this knowledge.

records.title: I keep getting email reminders to…
records.text: I keep getting email reminders to contact this company.Very annoying as i'm in good health.No way i would waste my money, anyway.What's wrong with a D.I.Y. garden cremation ?Cheap and cheerful, i say

records.title: Not the experience I had expected
records.text: Not the experience I had expected Almost two weeks after my father had passed away, he had still not been collected from the hospital. I was forced to ring the mortuary myself following a call to Low Cost Funerals as there seemed to be a break down in communication between them. Also, I was initially told that I would be informed at every stage of the process. This did not happen.

records.title: It is impossible to rate this service…

records.title: Dad's cremation
records.text: When dad booked his cremation we did it through the co-op website. Paperwork came from Memoria. Apparently Memoria is also called Low Cost Funerals. It was a nightmare trying to keep track of who I was talking to. I also had to go to the Co-op to sign papers. So confusing. Also we had to pay for the return of dad's ashes £100! This needs to be made clear on the website. Daylight robbery. The cremation was not done at our local crematorium (less than a mile away) it was about 40 miles away. This part needs to be made clearer on the website by Memoria.The only saving grace in all this was the lovely person who brought dad's ashes home. He was not only dressed very smart, he was kind, respectful and we had a lovely conversation. Upshot? Could do better.

records.title: Very misleading on fee prices
records.text: The head banner on the homepage is very misleading. I have kept a screenshot of this as their offer of £950 without any additional charges was not correct. The company has since added a link to T&Cs but, at the time I found their website, the homepage had no asterisk against the quote £950 to indicate a ‘from’ or ‘T&Cs apply’. I ended up a bill increased by a massive 46% because they added on collection and transport and then £100 fee to post the ashes to me. The banner heading stated cremation would be at Altrincham which is just a few miles from me so I could get a bus to collect the ashes. However, the cremation actually took place in Wales. I have no transport so had no choice but to accept the £100 postage fee.

records.title: Ashes weren't delivered as promised
records.text: I was satisfied with the service I received over the phone and in the stress-free administration. I waited for the ashes of my very dear friend to be delivered as agreed between 10.00 a.m. and 2.00 p.m. but they hadn't arrived by 2.40 p.m. I rang the company, to be told that there had been an 'issue' with the driver. I was told that they had tried to contact me on my mobile but that it didn't take calls (rather odd as someone had called me on it in the morning - besides they could have left a discreet message).I had to let a friend and close neighbours of the deceased know that the scattering of the ashes had been put forward to another date. Thankfully no-one had travelled for the sad occasion, but for something so intensely personal I would have thought delivery as arranged was vitally important.The ashes were delivered on the second date agreed but I am sorely disappointed with this aspect of the company's service.

records.title: Ok so we haven’t had the funeral yet so…
records.text: Ok so we haven’t had the funeral yet so taking a bit of a risk, we went for low cost flexible package which seemed like everything we needed, I didn’t really know my brother in law very well so handled this myself as it was easier for all concerned. The lady I spoke to seemed lovely and sent me all the forms I needed to fill out and what I needed to do with all the paperwork which turned out to be a complete nightmare but thought hey hoo one of them things, in one of the forms it asked about the funeral Director so called low cost to find this out, so then we got a date and time but after a week had not heard from the minister/celebrant so called again to see what was happening, to be told we did not have one in this package, so as you can imagine panic struck in as we did not know what to do, but I looked at the package again and the receipt it definitely said we had a minister, so call back again to be told, oh yes so it does, I better get on to that straight away, and thankfully the celebrant got in touch the next day and the meeting has taken place and he has written a lovely speech. I ordered some flowers to be sent to the funeral Director for the morning of the funeral, I was then call by the florist this morning to be told the funeral Director will not take the flowers as the funeral is not going from there, as you can imagine I was shocked again as I thought it was something you did, have flowers in the hurst, so I called the funeral Director to see if this was true, I was then on the phone to the most unsympathetic woman, all I said  was I thought it would be ok if we had some flowers in the hurst on the coffin, and I got, you have just got a low cost Funeral and it’s got nothing to do with us and I’m not getting into this with you this is stupid, I’m not discussing this with you and you shouldn’t even know he is here. Ok so how the hell would I have filled the forms out if I didn’t know where he was and how would we have got any clothes to him if we didn’t know where he was, makes me worry about my brother in law stuck in that place, so rude and she didn’t even ask who I was so I could have been his wife or anyone very close to him and she just spoke so out of tone, but maybe my bad for calling them direct but I’m glad I did because I will definitely not recommend them to anyone. So as you can tell I’m not to impressed and had this been a close family member of mine I would be so upset instead of angry. I just hope and pray that everything goes well on the day

description:
HBP offers support to organisations in contact with individuals and families either threatened by or experiencing homelessness. The legal definition of homelessness includes those experiencing domestic and other abuse, financial difficulties and care and support needs that make their accommodation unsuitable. 

We deliver regular training courses on homelessness law for lay people. Building on this understanding, HBP provides ongoing support to staff to put this understanding into practice through regular case management meetings and follow-up contact via telephone and email. Additional work can be agreed with organisations.

They take the complex legal framework, unpack it and present it in a simple way giving me a clear understanding of the help and support that those experiencing homelessness should receive from the local authority. Great, motivational and safe to say it has lit a bit of a fire in me!
