records.text: I have POA for my MUm and she has had this policy some time. She has been paying by standing order as its an old policy. I called for a balance to pay off the final balance, to find the company has gone into admnistration and I have had nothing about any transfers to Dignity. They haven't even messaged or mailed me to advise of that - they have MY address. I have been told that as its a old policy they will get round to it. What happens in the meantime? Surely its a matter of sending information to everyone. It should take long to send letters or emails from a database? I hope to see the transfer information ASAP as thisis concerning and a worry as Mum had almost paid up on her plan.

records.title: Hi iam writing this on behalf of my…
records.text: Hi iam writing this on behalf of my elderly mum and dad that have tried to contact you several times a day about the policy ect mum has left several messages and nobody has got back to them,this is making her very ill with worry! Mr and mrs a simpson York somebody plz get in touch with them!

records.title: after taking out a policy many months…
records.text: after taking out a policy many months ago,im begining to doubt taking it,you are not FCA or fpa aproved,so im going to ask for a refund,also u dont jave any 3rd party expence package available(others do) plus i dont feel comfortable with ur company. please advise on a refund,and please dont try to change my mind,ive already decided. thanks sammy mcphail.UPDATE.......since speaking again with prosperous life,i have now had a refund in full,after i stated that they did tell me they would be going with  fca,it turned out they didnt so a full refund was issued.

records.title: Funeral Plan cancellation
records.text: Signed up for the funeral plan. Afterwards I read that Prosperous Life was not FSC registered which may preclude future sales of this plan with new legislation. Consequently I cancelled the plan within the 30 day cooling off period. I am still awaiting refund of the £100 deposit

records.title: Amazing presentation
records.text: Amazing presentation, not what I was expecting as I said I didn't want to sign up for anything on the day, I was told 1hr it was nearly double that, I won't get back, sorry I'm not convinced, you really need to stop talking & listen, just felt theatened & wanted to end interview, but thanks anyway, if you can pay on the day with my card, so can I a week later

records.title: I didn’t not buy The options available (not all given…
records.text: The options available (not all given initially) were similar pricing to other providers but the company lost my business with the hard sell and their sales tactics used during a home visit ( different sales man turned up from the name I was given).It made me feel uncomfortable thinking of others that may be less confident in dealing with this situation.

records.title: No problem with the plan but your admin…
records.text: No problem with the plan but your admin is dreadful!  I set up a plan for myself and my husband.  Paperwork was wrong and set up direct debits for ten years instead of five.  I phoned and that was corrected.  Then you sent funeral plan with my husbands wrong dob.  I phoned again and you said it would be corrected.  Yesterday got new funeral plan for him with the same incorrect dob!!!I am about to send you another. £1000 as deposit but am wondering if I should cancel because you make so many mistakes.  Please phone me and explain!!!!

records.title: Your scheme does not cover me as I live…
records.text: Your scheme does not cover me as I live in Cyprus.The costs of removing the body to a chosen area in the U.K. is not covered.Whereas I can get a complete "package"  for cremation for a few pounds more elsewhere.Can I have my £150 deposit back please?

records.title: Review
records.text: I originally filled in the questionnaire online to get an idea of how much my funeral would cost. I then had a follow up telephone call with one of the team to ascertain if  I was the correct person and to take details. There was also a follow up call with Matthew who explained everything in greater detail and ap further call with the compliance manager to ensure e I understood everything. All in all very professional

records.title: complaint
records.text: I felt pushed into buying a policy for myself after saying no several times and despite the fact I was calling on behalf of Mr  Daniel Kerr for information only which I made quite clear to the first agent I spoke to as Mr Kerr needs time to process the information so he could make his decision. I felt my disability was used to push me into also into also buying a policy and was asked if I was physically or mentally disabled.

description:
LITTA™  is the UK's fastest growing waste removal company and operates throughout the UK. Our on demand service and allows you to book a same day rubbish removal, or bulky item clearance in a few clicks. You can pay using Apple Pay or call our team to make a booking over the phone. Our service is fully guaranteed with the use of local approved licensed waste carriers to clear your rubbish.

You can visit our website at litta.co.uk or email any enquiries to hi@litta.co.uk

records.title: AMAZING SERVICE!!
records.text: The guys who came to collect Alano & Merrick were efficient, courteous & helpful definitively using this service again. No hassle book online it’s all done to your convenience & no need to wait for local council which are weeks away for an appointment!! JD at the office was fabulous!!!

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Fantastic service. Gavin was like superman going up and down stairs in record time. All the rubbish/things I had accumulated were out of my life in about an hour or so. Fantastic value, great service. Need to dump anything? Can’t recommend these guys enough.

records.title: Flipping brilliant service!
records.text: Flipping brilliant service- from initial request through to collection! Can’t fault it!  Needs better advertising as only fell on them after a quick search on internet and a slightly sceptical hit on their website

records.title: Really good service
records.text: Really good service. Reasonably priced and booking was very straight forward. They came when they said they were going to - even provided tracking information so I knew when to expect them. Collected my rubbish and sent a ‘before’ and ‘after’ picture.

records.title: Easy booking, efficient collection
records.text: The booking was fast and easy and the team that came to collect was professional and efficient.Especially brilliant if you need things collected such as a metal bed frame that the council doesn’t offer to collect as “bulk item”

records.title: Excellent service and customer support
records.text: From the initial call to collection and removals, the whole process was seamless. Staff throughout were professional, friendly and extremely courteous. The collection/removal handlers are to be commended for all their efforts. Would highly recommend this company without hesitation. Well done to all!

records.title: Long wait but was glad to get rid of the rubbish.  Waiting for the van was an issue I was…
records.text: Waiting for the van was an issue I was ready at 7am but it didn’t turn up till 4-30pm but when it did it was fine all my rubbish went in the van.

records.title: Effortless & Affordable
records.text: LITTA made removing my old washing machine so easy! Their pricing was very reasonable with no hidden costs. Quick, professional, and hassle-free. Highly recommend!

records.title: Seamless experience booking the removal…
records.text: Seamless experience booking the removal of lots of packaging from a move. All online so very easy. I would use Litta again.

records.title: Really efficient and very friendly guys…
records.text: Really efficient and very friendly guys who picked up an old bed and mattress. Great to receive an SMS 10 mins before they arrived.Very good service I’ll use again.

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very good service, unfortunately the timings window is between 7am and 11pm. They want to charge you £12 to come an hour later.  Although we had a text to say they were on their way. Which was most helpful.

records.title: Quick removal but confusing live tracker
records.text: The removal was quick and the person who came really nice and professional.However we received the live tracker the day before showing ETA 24min. We were booked for the next day so got a bit confused when the tracker started showing 6min away and then back to 13 min. In the morning it was still showing 13min away and then stopped working. It went live again just 2min before the person arrived.

records.title: An expensive exercise as the local top…
records.text: An expensive exercise as the local tip was closed, That said the service was very efficient.

records.title: The collection service was good but a more definitive time slot would highten
records.text: The collection service was excellent, waste moved from premises to van impeccably.Only slight issue being the extensive arrival time slot of the removal team.I'm sure there's a reason for this that may be beyond your control.A more targeted collection time would greatly improve the effectiveness of this service.JT

records.title: Easy booking process
records.text: Easy booking process. Plenty of options for time of collection. Same or next day options were available.Driver arrived a 20minutes after my time slot, otherwise I would have rated 5 stars.Excellent communication.

records.title: Excellent prompt and quick service
records.text: Excellent prompt and quick service

records.title: Very efficient service
records.text: The online booking is great, would be nice if we can book for a specific time of the day though. Also would like separate entries for mobile phones and land lines on the booking - we usually have someone at the house but it's not always me so would like the landline to be the primary point of contact.

records.title: Service was really fast and they got…
records.text: Service was really fast and they got the job done on the day they said they would. The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is because the tracking on the website was not in sync with the delivery.

records.title: Easy to book but not exactly stress…
records.text: Easy to book but not exactly stress free with a 7am - 10pm slot with no prior warning. Had requested for at least half an hour notice but received the notification as the van turned up

records.title: Only just shy of five stars TBH
records.text: Not quite five, as cost was more than I expected.Very pro team, got it all sorted thoroughly.

records.title: First time user of LITTA.. it won't be the last!
records.text: First time using LITTA and will definitely use again. Very easy system to use in terms of adding your unwanted items and selecting a pick up date. I was sent a text 1 hr from pick up time which gave me enough time to make sure all items were ready for pick up. On arrival, service was great and very efficient.

records.title: Efficient friendly
records.text: Efficient friendly and fast service was brilliant service .Would be better with shorter delivery slot 7am-10pm is to long.

records.title: Very prompt and efficient company but expensive
records.text: Very prompt and efficient company.  They keep customers informed at every stage.  Friendly admin staff and contractors. I couldn't give 5 stars because they are very expensive.  They ask you to estimate how many square yards of rubbish you have, and that isn't easy.  I estimated 6 but the men who collected the rubbish estimated 4.  Why don't they wait until the collectors come and then send the bill afterwards instead of taking payment in advance?  I have probably paid one third too much. But I was grateful for prompt service.

records.title: The guys who came did a great job
records.text: The guys who came did a great job, though despite downloading the tracking app we received virtually no notice. A rough eta earlier in the day would have helpful.

records.title: The collection team were very good they…
records.text: The collection team were very good they took away item with no hassle.

records.title: Always quote the correct address when making a booking, our driver went to the wrong address, fortunately the problem was solved within 5 minutes
records.text: Able to come at short notice

records.title: Litta to the rescue!
records.text: After being let down by a cheaper competitor, I booked Litta as they could come very soon (same day) and they were great. They gave me a window and an ETA on the day, a link to track where the driver was and a phone number so you can speak to a real human if any issues. I’d say they were 100% worth the extra few quid! Only slight gripe was that I was sent a discount code to get the price down but whilst the voucher worked, the price was about £5 higher than advertised in their email. Small beans but every little helps these days!

records.title: Efficient Clearing of Assorted Rubbish
records.text: Their arrival was tracked so I knew when to expect them. They carried everything tidily to the van and were polite and respectful. They asked me if I needed my garden sacks back,which was sensible (although I didn't in fact). Removal of items was quick and efficient and a weight off my mind!

records.title: You came with no notice- albeit at a…
records.text: You came with no notice- albeit at a cost but you were there on time

records.title: Good service and reliable and very good…
records.text: Good service and reliable and very good communications. I did have to call them back as the first lot only took the radiators. And left pallets and other bits. In fairness they did send a second team to pick those items up. So overall happy with service.

records.title: Don't be fooled by the reviews on Trustpilot
records.text: Having used Litta before, I thought I would use them again to collect some furniture from my home.Unfortunately, they cancelled my collection half an hour before they were scheduled to arrive. The reason is that they could not empty the truck as the transfer station closed early on Christmas Eve.I asked for a refund and they only offered 10% (which I have yet to receive). I expected better from you, Litta. Surely if a collection is cancelled with such short notice, you should be the one to offer a refund.Check the Litta's reviews on Google and choose them at your own risk.

records.title: Pick up was on time and efficiently…
records.text: Pick up was on time and efficiently executed. However the operatives had very muddy boots and have left bits of earth and dirty marks all over the carpets which will now have to be cleaned. Carrying plastic shoe protectors would have avoided this.

records.title: OK, but just that
records.text: Pros: Convenient and easy booking system, good availability, good tracking once activated on the day. Cons: Very high price for a service that's just OK and is farmed out to other businesses that would do it cheaper if booked directly and then you can also pick which one and how far from (you pay for their fuel). Time slots covering the whole day are ridiculous, and paying more for a 8am-6pm slot even more so. App didn't want to import my booking.Overall, if you use them and get particularly good service, just get contact details for the lads and book them direct next time.

records.title: I don't think the people picking up my…
records.text: I don't think the people picking up my load had ever seen the list of items to be picked up and I never received a tracking link

records.title: company is legitimate but customer service needs improving big time!
records.text: This company is legitimate and reliable - the only downfall is the customer service. Some of the male staff who work here can be rude and they can’t be bothered to help customers. I had issues with making a payment online so I had to call in. There were a few times I was put on hold without knowing whilst I was explaining how important it was for me to make a payment as I needed the items gone asap as I had tenants moving in to the flat where the waste was. Once I completed the payment I had to call back to double check if I could be given a more accurate time slot as no one is living at the property, however the staff just let the phone ring and ring and ring. I think they were avoiding me because I had to call up a few times- regardless I’m a customer I can ring 10x if I wish/need to! Word of advice: if you need to call in be prepared to deal with rude/lazy staff + staff have poor communication skills.

records.title: The man who came did an amazing job but..
records.text: The man who came did an amazing job and was really friendly.We got everything out very quickly and professionally.The thing I didn’t like is that they wouldn’t give you a specific time of when they will be arriving so i had to miss a few stuff that morning and had to keep waking up to check whether they are on their move or not yet.I ran to the pick up spot when the tracking was suddenly updated to “on the way”.I had to pay £12 more pounds just for them to come in a slot between 7am-12pm instead of 7am-10pm which for me doesn’t seem fair.So scheduling a pickup was such a bad experience overall and it doesn’t make sense.But the person who came did the job well.

records.title: The ladies that came to remove the…
records.text: The ladies that came to remove the rubbish were brilliant but not all communication reached them in time, so there was a heated debate on the phone between them and Litta before they could start

records.title: I like your vision to "keep the streets…
records.text: I like your vision to "keep the streets clear of flytipping and illegal waste dumping" but your prices say otherwise. I got a quote of 328.8£ for a couple of wooden desks and 2 mirrors. Dumping things should be less expensive than buying them again, at the very least.

records.title: The man that came to take my sofa away…
records.text: The man that came to take my sofa away was very good, however I had requested 2 people and sent photos of the sofa prior to the removal date. Only one person showed up and it was definitely a two person job - the sofa is very heavy and he was almost not able to do it. Not fault to the man but not what I paid for…

records.title: The collection guys were brilliant
records.text: The collection guys were brilliant. I have no problem with them at all and they did an amazing job. The only problem I had was that my extra information I provided to Litto was not given to the collection team so they didn’t realise they were collecting from the first floor. That information should’ve been passed on.

records.title: Reliable company but poor customer service
records.text: This company is reliable and I appreciated the fact I can use their online service to set up the waste collection. Their online features are easy to use. However, customer service could improve MASSIVELY; and here’s why:I was having issues with paying for the collection on multiple occasions so I had to call customer service; and unfortunately, I found some of the male members of staff quite rude.The attitude they portrayed during the call evidenced that they couldn’t be bothered to speak with me - even to the point where I had to explain how Important it was for my order to be completed (as I had tenants moving in to the property that had the waste) I was muted without me knowing opposed to shown empathy and being reassured that my order will be completed.  As constructive criticism to Litta: give training to staff on of how to handle issues with customers. Having issues can be frustrating and stressful for customers who are working alongside tight deadlines and during these times we expect patience and understanding from staff. Your staff’s behaviour and attitude during the call evidenced that they did not really want to help me but instead they just wanted me to come off the call and not ring back as I called multiple times that day - it’s a shame.

records.title: The feedback from Litta was scrappy and…
records.text: The feedback from Litta was scrappy and often late.  The removal date was rescheduled three times.  The fridge has been removed with no notice of arrival time.A fairly stressful experience but at least it has gone now albeit a week or so later than the original date

records.title: Good service but overpriced
records.text: I had to get rid of a wardrobe that I had dissembled but our car was way too small to fit in the back. I stumbled across LITTA and booked the day for pick up, it was a Good service, but to make it a 5 star the communication and price could of been better as well as the ability to book a specific time slot.

records.title: Good service, but intrusive marketing and sales tactics
records.text: Good service, polite collection staff. Efficient. Nevertheless, their marketing and selling strategies are far too aggressive for my liking - they will call, message etc when you give them your email/phone number so only do this if you actually intend to go ahead.

records.title: 3 stars. Misleading pricing, but overall, decent service.
records.text: I have given a very fair 3 stars here. I inquired into a 6 yard collection, and it was too expensive. I then received an automated follow-up marketing email which had my reference number and mentioned a 12 yard skip for X price, and which offered a discount.The email stated 'click here to accept discount', so I clicked on it, and the price dropped further. I had no option on the checkout page to change the size of the collection, so given 12 yards was offered in the email, that's what I assumed my collection was, and what I accepted.The outsourced collection company arrived and was told it was only 6 yards. Litta called and told me if I wanted 12 yards of collection (or 1 ton), I'd have to pay extra.Overall, Litta's service was good. The rubbish collection guys (not Litta, but an outsourced local company) were brilliant.Be if that it was intentional or not, I believe the pricing was highly misleading, so I had to pay an additional £80, which was apparently 'discounted'.I'm left with a bitter taste in my mouth, even if it was *probably* cheaper than hiring an actual skip.

records.title: Easy to book collection but…
records.text: EDIT: dropped to 3 stars from 4 as once I went outside I discovered that parts of the bookcase and chest of drawers that were collected have been left all over the car park. Some parts have been left where the collector threw the bookcase out of the window as well as some where they parked the van so would have been obviously visible. Easy to book collection and items were moved quickly. Dropped to 4 stars because we had booked a 2 man crew and 1 person turned up, which was fine as I assume they felt able to manage what we had listed to be moved. But they then proceeded to drop items out of hallway window without any warning, we’re on the first floor so caused quite a stir with the neighbours. The phone option on the tracking link also doesn’t work, I watched the van go passed 5 times before the worker arrived as they weren’t able to find the property and didn’t phone me for directions either.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Poor communication, no advance warning of arrival. Two pleasant guys but with only an estate car and roof rack to take 3 seater sofa and armchair. Not very professional for the high price paid.Following this feedback a 20% refund was offered and accepted. Very good customer service.

records.title: Booking online was easy
records.text: Booking online was easy, good phone follow up, prices were fair. The issue was that the drivers came during peak hour when the road is on a red route. Highlighted this when booking but drivers were angry to arrive with no parking option. Suggest booking team check booking notes and review addresses that are on main roads and reschedule pickups in view of this

records.title: Be careful with their pricing strategies…they overcharge
records.text: I booked the service based on a quoted price however they charged a higuer price for no reason. Their pricing practices are excessive (eg additional £18 for specific time slot pick up) among others. The job was super easy and service overpriced (on top of the additional price they charged me). I had to let them know that they charged thr wrong amount. Still waiting for the refund.

records.title: Better prep required
records.text: The driver was courteous and helpful,  but did not appear aware that he was booked to remove the contents of my desk as well as the desk itself.  As well as being alone on a two man job he had nothing in which to carry the contents and left much of it (small items) on the hall floor/in refuse sacks.

records.title: Not worth the money they charged me
records.text: Not worth the money they charged me, refused to take a pallet which was in the pic I send them.

records.title: 2 freezers
records.text: The two gentlemen who collected our two freezers were dismayed when they saw the appliances. This puzzled me as they were within LITTA's size restrictions and I had, at their request, sent photos in advance. One gentleman kept shaking his head, saying 'this is diabolical'. They struggled to manhandle the freezers out of the garage and along the drive to the lorry. (They had refused to try and reverse down the driveway, despite the fact it is wide enough for a lorry.) Why on earth do LITTA not have a trolley to help them? They were not rude or unpleasant to us, and they did eventually take the appliances away, but they clearly had a big problem moving two freezers.

records.title: Not good for a simple odd-job, faulty app
records.text: Had a simple job, wanted to get a mattress taken away. Removal men were very competent, polite, and quick, but had a bad experience with the app.Price seemed very high, but reasonable enough all considered that two men did show up.Was only given two options for vague delivery window. Even the "convenient time slot" was inconvenient — 8am to 6pm, nothing more specific — as I was a 2 hour journey from the property. Found only the day before that I could not cancel without a £40 fee, and anyway the app had no cancel button.To make the vague time slot worse, there was no indication in the morning (or ever) of the van's ETA, so to avoid missing it I ended up having to wait 5 hours in total in an empty property, not including travel time there. When van arrived I was caught by surprise as I was never notified of the van's ETA with the "live tracker", which seemed to only activate after the job was completed. It was nice to have a human provide support and update messages however.If you are looking for a man with a van to get a simple job done, I would not recommend this service. Seems only worth it if you have a lot of waste to be taken away, and time and space on your hands. My mistake.

records.title: Deceiving quote
records.text: Sent pics of the trash. Got a quote for 700kg and 8 qubic yards. I trust them. Paid in advance. Half way through the job I was called by Litta to tell me they won't take anymore.

records.title: Very reactive and quick turnaround
records.text: Very reactive and quick turnaround, website and app very good to use but collection crew took less than half than what was quoted for and agreed then wanted extra payment to return - 1 x 1100 Bin does not equate to 4 cubic yards and the waste was not 300kgs. Shame as it would have been 5* and a great experience other than that.

records.title: Bad experience with 550£
records.text: Web experience was good , timing to reach the property was good!They using a second company to come and collect the waste, before the arrival I have been super proactive to get everything ready for collection!Before start the job I could see them taking their time ,Half way done same feeling at some point they said that was too much and couldn’t get more , after various phone call we agreed with another 100£ (on top of the first 450£) tot finish the job.They did get few more items and left the property because couldn’t get more!They left me there still with rubbish!They could get everything and leave a happy customer but decided not to do so , despite the extra money paid the didn’t keep the agreement!550£ in total !

records.title: They required my 70 year old registered blind mother in law to help move the item.
records.text: Booked a job for my mother in law. They send you a form to get a greater understanding of the job required and I advised on the form that it was a large double wardrobe on the first floor of a house in pieces and was a two person job. My mother in law is in her 70s and registered blind and only one man showed up and advised she would need to help. Would not recommend this company to anyone.

records.title: they quote a mattress removal without…
records.text: they quote a mattress removal without specifying that there are add ons related to where, which floor, when is picked; it starts at  around 50 gbp and ends up at around 100... then they send you a quote on email which is lower but when you go on check out it is not reflected in the checkout pages ( in a call they justify it with a technical problem). very lousy customer experience

records.title: Would not recommend to a friend
records.text: The two people who removed our furniture seemed inexperienced and a bit underprepared. I think that they dragged furniture when it would have been better - if only not to leave drag marks on the floor - to lift. They didn't realise that they needed to remove drawers from a cabinet before carrying it down stairs until the drawers started to open as they carried it. The driver tracking app told me they were 44 minutes away - turned out to be 2 hours. They also arrived after 2 PM even though I paid extra for a pre-2 PM pick up. I would not recommend LITTA to a friend.

records.title: Service not worth the money charged
records.text: The process to book was easy but uploading the picture of the garbage took hours as the site wasn't accepting the picture.  I wasn't around when the Garbage was picked up and they took items that were not included in my booking and left the bins I actually wanted emptied filled and no one even called to say the bins couldn't be emptied.  When I tried to get into contact with Litta  to address the issue my messages were left unanswered for hours. I was then told my load was bigger than what I booked and I had to pay a further £114 to get my bins emptied.  I ended up using another company who emptied the bins within an hour and charged £60.

description:
Fosters Family Funeral Directors has served the community for nearly two decades and is now an award-winning funeral director with funeral homes throughout Scotland. 

Above all, we pride ourselves on the quality of personal and professional service we provide to you and your loved one as you bid farewell. We know that thinking about you or a loved one’s funeral can be daunting, so we will guide and support you every step of the way.

records.title: Fantastic service from Lorna
records.text: Lorna made a very difficult time much easier for the family.  We felt comfortable with her arranging the funeral and everything went totally to plan on the day.  We couldn't have had a better experience at this sad time.

records.title: Reliable and professional
records.text: I was very fortunate that my mother had already arranged a funeral plan, which helped tremendously. All her wishes were  put in place, with the wonderful service and further advice and knowledge received from Fosters Family Funeral Directors, Burnside, Rutherglen. An appointment was arranged to meet Caroline, an advisor, who made me feel so at ease. Her professionalism was excellent, so understanding, and very sympathetic, her approach was 100 per cent perfect. Every detail was discussed until I was fully satisfied that everything requested by mum, was absolutely correct. Organising a Funeral can be stressful, very emotional, very sad,  but the service provided by Fosters made it less stressful which meant I had no worries, regarding cars, flowers, timing etc. The staff are excellent.

records.title: Very professional and caring staff
records.text: Very professional and caring staff. Given time to make changes and decisions. Never felt rushed at any moment.There was no pressure to buy a certain package. As a family we felt very comfortable and we were looked after very well.

records.title: Great service, experienced and friendly staff
records.text: The Staff were amazing throughout a very difficult time. Special thanks to both Angela and Lorna. As a family, we can't thank them enough.

records.title: A professional and caring service
records.text: Everything was arranged extremely well and professionally by Angela in Stirling during our difficult time.  Real genuine care and support was provided before, during and after the funeral. Can’t thank Angela and Steven who was funeral director on the day enough.

records.title: Fosters Dunfermline …
records.text: Thank you for the care and respect that was shown to us during a very difficult time. Lynne was supportive through the entire time and checked in on us afterwards. Thank you for your compassion and understanding.

records.title: Our family is very grateful to all the…
records.text: Our family is very grateful to all the staff. They made it as easy as they could for us, we didn't expect to get such support. But it was necessary at such a difficult time. Lynne is an incredible person.

records.title: At a very difficult time the process of…
records.text: At a very difficult time the process of planning our funeral was made it as easy as possible. Angela was always available to telephone and replied to emails very quickly. Our desire for how we wanted the service to unfold was made to happen.

records.title: Lesley was a great Help such a…
records.text: Lesley was a great Help such a fantastic Service

records.title: From the very first phonecall
records.text: From the very first phonecall, the staff were compassionate and helpful. We used the Kilmarnock funeral parlour. Carole and all the staff,could not do enough for us. Nothing we requested was too much trouble for them.Carole in particular was so compassionate and spoke about our deceased family member with so much dignity. In your darkest times I would not hesitate to contact them.

records.title: my first funeral…

records.title: BUYER BEWARE
records.text: In February 2019 my wife and I, having reached our late 60's decided to put our funeral arrangements in order. We chose Fosters as the plan they offered was comprehensive and a good price. Their agent came to our home and after a short time we decided to initiate a Fosters Funeral Plan for each of us. A week or so later our plans arrived in the post, and  after checking the salient details consigned  the plans to our documents folio. Fast forward to the present day , having paid Fosters since the start of our plans we were wondering when our packages would be paid up and took the plans out to check them. We were puzzled that the figures we were paying on the plan did not jibe with a total amount for either 60 or 72 months of payments for our requested plan. We read our contracts (which we should have done at the start of our association with Fosters but didn't) to find the following details in the small print. We did not sign up for an easy pay plan for the cost of our packages, rather we had signed up for an All of Life insurance plan which will mature upon our deaths or when we reach the age of 90.It was our error to believe that Fosters would not seek to mislead us in any way. However at our friendly meeting with their agent the term "All of Life Policy " was never mentioned. Had it been mentioned we would never have signed up for a 20 year payment plan. In closing we hope that anyone who takes out such a plan with any funeral director takes the time to read all of the documents sent to them by their chosen company. Please do not trust that these people are acting in your best interests as they are not and not all of your financial commitments will be explained to you.

records.title: Not the best service
records.text: Had no choice but to use Fosters as our mum had arranged for a prepaid plan. From start to finish it was mistake after mistake. Firstly we were told that our mum hadn’t paid for a limousine or to be embalmed but our paperwork showed that she had. When we challenged Fosters on this they simply said ‘oh so she has’. Next mistake was to be told we were being charged for flowers & again when we challenged Fosters, Gillian said ‘sorry my mistake’. We also didn’t get to view our mum as Fosters don’t embalm a body until the day before the viewing. Our mum had already changed as her body had been lying for 2 weeks in the morgue so we feel this should be done ASAP in these circumstances so families can say goodbye to their loved ones. These mistakes are unacceptable especially when families are grieving for their loved one. It’s as if they’re deliberately trying to get extra money out of you. Would not recommend Fosters based on our experience.

description:
As a mutual, Yorkshire Building Society is owned by our members, who are customers of our Society. 

We were founded more than 150 years ago for the benefit of our members, to provide real help with their real lives, enabling more people to buy their own home and save for what’s important to them. 

Our ambition is to be market-leading for financial inclusion and deliver tailored outcomes for all customers.
