records.text: had to jump through hoops to join..if i was 20 then probably no problem but i am a pensioner and it was difficult..

records.title: Setting up the accounts were fine the…
records.text: Setting up the accounts were fine the reason I’ve marked the experience down is that although installing the app on my phone twice I still don’t have the ability to change my details. Contacted the customer service who changed the details, but could not help in explaining why I don’t have the feature in the app.

records.title: Frustrating YBS account application
records.text: On 21/11/2024 I applied on the YBS website for an easy saver account and received a welcome email and another regarding other checks required but my account was opened. By 27/11 I had not received any correspondence from YBS which really frustrated and annoyed me as I wasn’t applying for a mortgage or loan I just wanted to open a savings account so I telephoned YBS and asked why things were taking so long. The service advisor took some personal details and when he checked everything was in place for the account and couldn’t understand why I hadn’t received the account number with the other information I needed use the account and be able to transfer funds into it. He furnished me will all the relevant information and after a few days I received a welcome letter in the post from YBS with my joint account number. The process was overly long and unnecessary in this instance and frustrating but I’m prepared to give YBS a second chance.

records.title: Long winded deposit and withdrawal system
records.text: The deposit transfer system could be made more user friendly and efficient. I have an account elsewhere that has enabled me to deposit or withdraw to a current account with my bank, once initial security is set up , without the rigmarole of long winded transfer each time . If one provider can do why can’t you ?

records.title: A good savings account  just took a while to set up…
records.text: It took a little longer than hoped to set up the account initially , but a good rate of interest available, and managed to clarify our identity by a visit to the local branch.

records.title: Taking the video /photo was not easy…
records.text: Taking the video /photo was not easy especially when asked to remove glasses making it somewhat difficult to see.Long winded but we got there.

records.title: I really disliked the security…
records.text: I really disliked the security information required to prove I was who I said I was. I was rejected the first time although all my pictures had scanned ok, so I had to repeat, not really knowing what the issue was.  So approved and decided to open another account with them and again had to go through all the identity checks again which I feel is overkill having been accepted once. Again, for whatever reason, it rejected me, even more maddening given I'd been accepted for the other one. I was just determined to do it!

records.title: Problems making a deposit
records.text: On opening my account I tried to make my deposit using a bank transfer but when I put in the name of the Yorkshire Building Society my bank said it wasn’t a match. I rang the help line and was told that that was the only name the Building Society used. It clearly wasn’t. In the end after various tries I had to make my deposit with my debit card on line which I didn’t want to do.

records.title: This is based on the sign up…
records.text: This is based on the sign up experience. Maybe they are 5* for the rest of it but don't know yet.They make you post proof of identity. Then take absolutely ages to approve you for opening a savings account. Why couldn't it have been done electronically? What's the difference between a scan uploaded and a photocopy?

records.title: Opening my first account was painful
records.text: Opening my first account was painful.  Initially could not find information on the web site then one of the sources for idenfication was rejected - my wife's out-of-date passport.  Yet my out-of-date passport was accepted.  This only become apparent after I rung YBS a week after applying.  The web site doesn't state that passports/driving licences need to be current.

records.title: A complicated process
records.text: I found it difficult to open an account and my first application was rejected, although the reason why was not explicit. It was a complicated process, and not one that I had to undergo when applying to another building society. Also, I don't find it clear how I will withdraw money to another account. The App gives little information or instruction. Until this is clarified I won't be depositing further funds.The interest rate is good, obviously, but I found the process quite stressful and not user friendly.

records.title: Not happy visiting one of your branch
records.text: Not happy visiting one of your branch. Wanted to fix large amount, your branch tells me to come after 18 days as there are no appointments available From next day Branch fix deposit rate was dropping and I had to carry cheque in name of YBS for 18 days this loosing interest.Such a competitive offers going all round, me being YBS customer for over 20 years

records.title: Had to phone for passbook to be…
records.text: Had to phone for passbook to be returned to me from branch. On receiving it, it had not been made up, resulting in me having to make an extra visit to branch to get corrected.

records.title: had to wait…
records.text: It may be part of the t and case but I expected whe  I transferred money it would at least go the same day and  not next!!! Maybe it's just me, but I don't know of any establishment which waits between 24 and 48 hours to transact.

records.title: ISA transfer not completed in time
records.text: I opened an ISA on 13th  December and needed funds transferring from an existing provider before the end of the year. The branch failed to complete the request properly meaning that the deadline was missed. I rang the branch on the 27th and visited on 31st but they were unaware that they needed to complete the process. I had to contact my previous provider to discover that they had not been contacted about the transfer.

records.title: Poor initial setup
records.text: Had to call YBS central office after travelling to provide ID as branch office had not uploaded ID correctly. No e mail received with account number and password, had to call central office again to get logged on. Good interest rate though.

records.title: Lack of Care
records.text: Deposited pass  book for update in YBS Woking Letter Box on a Saturday when town busy but YBS Branch closed . Expected to be returned but on following Friday not received so telephoned Branch . Polite response from Branch and passbook found after 15 minute search and not updated. Had been concerned passbook lost or stolen.

records.title: Trying to open an online account was…
records.text: Trying to open an online account was one of the most frustrating experiences I have ever had. Instructions lacked clarity, emails contained blue writing i. a green background making it difficult to read and the help desk was less than helpful despite my theat of taking my substantial savings elsewhere to another provider. The day was saved a little by a proactive branch contact, but the experience did not fill me with customer loyalty nor warm me to the company.

records.title: Joined YBS to save online
records.text: Joined YBS to save online - mobile app still not working after nearly 2 weeks! Unable to get past the security screen - Deleted and reinstalled numerous times - gave upHave to use laptop to check balances via browser/ website. Had already reported the issues and was told that YBS were aware and IT were updating systems! Still not able to use mobile app running IOS latest version

records.title: Paperwork problems in a digital age!
records.text: Polite and friendly staff on the phone.  Secure message staff not too helpful.  Issue explained, assurance given that it could be rectified on completion of a form.  Wrong form sent out, returned with letter, explanation and documentary proof as requested.....which has subsequently been lost!  Whole exercise has to be repeated.  In a digital age, its astonishing that the matter cannot be handled on-line!

records.title: Unhappy with new online account opening procedure
records.text: Been a customer for many years since back when they still had a local branch.  Have been able to open online with them in the past. Tried to open a new online account with a higher interest rate but found out that this only possible if I provide online ID including uploading a video selfie. So basically they are now excluding everyone without video uploading facilities from their higher interest rate accounts.

records.title: The process of opening up the account…
records.text: The process of opening up the account was extremely difficult because it entails online applications and then still having to go into a branch with several forms of identity. The account opened is a joint account but only my wife was asked to verify her identification in a branch.Why couldn’t the whole process have been completed in a branch If you needed to go in in person anyway ?

records.title: If you’re switching to their Instant…
records.text: If you’re switching to their Instant Access Savings account be aware withdrawals from the account aren’t instant at all, it takes until the next working day. I thought banks etc. were digital now, what year is it?

records.title: Difficulty opening savings accounts
records.text: I tried to open some savings accounts but they were always asking for documents that I had already provided for a previous account, and when I did send copies they weren't in the right format. So I gave up and opened accounts elsewhere, it was so easy taking just a few minutes

description: Part of the global SUEZ group, we employ more than 5,000 people in the UK. Since 1988, we have been delivering innovative and environmentally responsible solutions to manage waste and water for our customers – households, local authorities, and industry and commerce.

records.title: Great customer service they are so…
records.text: Great customer service they are so reliable. I highly recommend it to everyone and the price is really great. I’m so happy with them.

records.title: Lost Bin
records.text: No hassle talk on the phone about a missing bin and then a follow up conversation via e-mail about a replacement and the new bin delivered on the day it was said to be.

records.title: excellent customer service clear and…
records.text: excellent customer service clear and concise in what they would be able to deliver

records.title: Help desk
records.text: Would like to say a massive thank you to the help desk at Suez (Katherine and Becky) huge help after some issues with the collections. Thank you!

records.title: Excellent Service as always
records.text: Come once a week and your driver is excellent always smiling and cheerful nothing too much for him.THANK YOU

records.title: A lovely experience
records.text: Would like to say that I believe in this company, I am a non-customer and I fell over as it was a frosty slippery morn. One of Suez's employee's helped me up, and bandaged me, as she said that she had prior experience in first aid. She said her name was Jemma, and she made the point of saying Jem with a J not a G.

records.title: Great, reliable service for a number of years
records.text: Great communication from the local depot once an issue had been raised. This was sorted quickly and without the need for multiple phone calls and chasing up.Great, reliable service.

records.title: Excellent service received - Tina Blake
records.text: I spoke with Tina Blake who helped us prepare ourselves for the food waste recycling requirements next year. It was simple and quick. We now have our contracts all set up and ready to go (thank you Tina). The website and portal also provide so much information, we are always aware of changes before they happen and can keep track of our performance. We are a happy customer - thank you Suez.

records.title: The issue of non collection has now…
records.text: The issue of non collection has now been resolved

records.title: ALWAY LET ME KNOW IF YOU CAN MAKE IT.
records.text: ALWAY LET ME KNOW IF YOU CAN MAKE IT.AND GIVE A DAY WHEN YOU WILL COME.VERY HELP FULL WHEN I PHONE OR EMAILWITH A PROBLEM .WELL DONE ANOTHER GOOD YEAR.

records.title: Helpful it missed my service on the…
records.text: Helpful it missed my service on the worst time but the gentleman that I spoke to was very good and got it sorted for a later date would have been nice to know why my service was missed ?

records.title: After phoning and getting a schelude…
records.text: After phoning and getting a schelude sorted glass bin and rubbish bins are now being empty when they should. Thank you for getting this sorted.

records.title: The whole team are very helpful Emma is…
records.text: The whole team are very helpful Emma is an absolute start

records.title: The only problem we have had is…
records.text: The only problem we have had is information getting through from the sales / customer service teams to the driver

records.title: Very good for normal waste collection services
records.text: Happy enough with the normal waste collection service, and the admin team is on the ball.

records.title: Generally happy with the service
records.text: Generally very happy with the service. I think the only reason Suez didn't make 5 stars is due to the issues we've had with our food waste collections. I must say each time the issue was sorted quite rapidly and collections were rescheduled. Our account Manager Craig has been great in sorting this out for us.

records.title: New Contract
records.text: Good Customer Service with quick responses and proper chat on the phone as well as emails to back it all up.

records.title: Joe and his department in…
records.text: Joe and his department in subcontracting....who  sorted out the latest logistical mess of the Company deciding to change the Euro Bin General Waste Collection days from a Monday and Friday to a Wednesday and Thursday....or Thurs and Friday even less helpful. Joe's Team are superb at understanding a Pub restaurants wastecare needs and sorting it so professionally. Best G Wright Director

records.title: Pretty smooth.
records.text: Notified by Suez that we were out of contract and offered a reasonable reduction on a new two year contract. All pretty smooth.

records.title: Better than biffa but room to improve
records.text: We have a general waste and a recycle waste. The general waste collection is clock work every week. The recycling is schedulers every 2 weeks but often isn’t collected. The driver blames blocked access but no body else struggles. So our bin is often over flowing. It is frustrating.

records.title: Recycling wasn’t  picked up on the…
records.text: Recycling wasn’t picked up on the allotted day I called to ask why - the chap was very helpful said that the new driver had said bin was empty- I said it wasn’t and they must’ve looked in the wrong bin… they came back and picked it up 2 days later and I received an email to let me know. It was dealt with efficiently and corrected swiftly.

records.title: Bad start but reliable now
records.text: Missed 8 collections in the first month, constantly having to chase them. Untransparent invoices and lots of 'Case resolved' no reply emails in the beginning.They have improved greatly since then I'm pleased to report and are now very reliable, so I have added a few stars!

records.title: excellent service but please improve communication
records.text: excellent service. only thing is that the reporting online messaging is not as clear as it could be. I was informed  of the 'emptying date (25/09/23) and then as the garage code was not transferred to the local depot the empty date changed by two das later. this could have been a problem so it is important to respond and inform and check that information has been received.

records.title: Suez generally do a great job re…
records.text: Suez generally do a great job re collection. The people are polite and always collect on time in full. My only issue has been when we order bags, we always  had a wait of up to 2 weeks for them to arrive which was annoying  That said,  the last lot of bags ordered did arrive on the day specified. Hopefully this will continue.

records.title: Part Collection corrected
records.text: The usual collection took place but for some reason some of the waste remained in the bin. After an email explaining the situation, i received an email and the remaining waste was collected two days later. Very helpful and efficient.

records.title: Suez have always been accommodating & helpful
records.text: Suez have always been accommodating and quick to implement any changes we inform them about.  The drivers have always been polite and friendly.

records.title: Item discarded in error…
records.text: After a few calls to your customer service section, I received a mail asking for more details. I sent this but unfortunately you advised further assistance was not possible to retrieve the item concerned. At least as a company you showed interest in the issue .

records.title: Milton Keynes waste collection total failure by Suez
records.text: UPDATE. Following my posting I received a home visit from the Suez contract manager today who apologised and provided me with his work number in case of future problems. The bins were collected and returned today with no issues . Thank you Trust pilot!  My local authority, Milton Keynes, uses this company for waste collection. I am disabled and have an assisted collection - although I may as well not have for the number of times the crews miss my bins. They always lie because online the bins are marked as collected when they are not! Numerous complaints, online reporting it doesn’t matter one bit. All I get is that they have »talked to Suez ». Clearly not in the least customer- focused just out for profit. The nano seconds longer it takes to collect my bins from outside my front door to the pavement cannot possibly affect their bottom line. Milton Keynes council also need to look at their contract management as whoever is leading on this particular contract doesn’t know what they are doing either. You fine companies who break contract terms until it hurts and they improve their performance.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, always notified me if a collection was day changing or if one will be missed due to unforeseen circumstances. Great friendly staff,

records.title: Suez keep closing the cases even though…
records.text: Suez keep closing the cases even though it hasn't been resolved and without even checking if the issue has been resolved I keep on opening the same cases over and over againupdate... the communication has been improved and in the end the issue has been promptly resolved. Thank you

records.title: Speedy response with lots of extra…
records.text: Update: Suez has now provided the missing information, and I had a lovely call with Steve from Customer Services to discuss my issue! All good and hopefully it will be a 5 star next time!------------------------------------------------------------Speedy response with lots of extra info.My query regarding more information on why TetraPax were not included in our recycling bag was answered swiftly with extra information on the recycling process for TetraPax and other anomalies.However I am still awaiting a response over a query regarding a period of no collections.

records.title: I would really like more conversations…
records.text: I would really like more conversations with the depot team, especially when collections are deemed not possible due to external factors. Moving collections to 3 days in the future have a huge impact to the smooth running on the Estate. Collections could be moved to later on the same day for example which would keep us happy and would mean you wouldn't have a greater workload on a different day. I'm happy to pick this up with our account manager Jason.

records.title: sometimes collection doesn't happen…
records.text: sometimes collection doesn't happen even though the waste is left out and comms can be poor

records.title: Response was slow
records.text: Response was slow, requirements not understood, expensive solution. We were looking to dispose of a small quantity of dated medicines. Suez claim to be able to do almost any waste disposal, issue is that when you get specific, if they can do it, it's going to cost a lot even when contracted.

records.title: Small things actually matter
records.text: Gates to the bin compound are left closed for a reason. Your drivers constantly leave the gates open after emptying the bins, even with a sign on the gate asking them to close them! Unprofessional and unnecessary.PHS who collect sanitary waste seem to have their own agenda of 'missing collections'. Is this by design or incompetence?  You appointed this company, I suggest you control them. Stars will continue to decrease until these issues are permanently resolved.Suez contacted me promptly and have taken action to resolve these issues. Thank you Suez.

records.title: Thank you for eventually sorting my…
records.text: Thank you for eventually sorting my problem with being not been able to buy my sacks a very happy customer now thank you

records.title: Collections missed saying blocked when…
records.text: Collections missed saying blocked when they have access code. Always results in extra weight which is not our faults due to non collections. Need a proper contact available so that these issues are resolved and not get repeated time after time

records.title: Driver failed to empty our bin on…
records.text: Driver failed to empty our bin on designated day.  He claimed there was insufficient space to move the bin but we had checked before leaving the previous evening and there was plenty of room.  Eventually collected two days later - which was preferable to having to wait until next collection day but still rather inconvenient.

records.title: Waste removal!!!My initial query was handled very well
records.text: My initial query was handled very well, providing information and detail, however the information turned out to be wrong. We were told the FEL had not been emptied on week commencing 19/06/23. Only to receive an email saying it had been emptied that week. This does not really ring true from our end because the waste is overflowing the following week.Then we receive an email saying the case is now closed!There is not the personal engagement it used to be for us to put our point across, it is just the automated system.

records.title: Failed collection
records.text: I don't like the fact that it takes until Friday to pick up a Tuesday collection and that it's happened two weeks running so I'll be on the phone sometime sorting it out again.

records.title: Poor service lately
records.text: Suez used to be very good but recently I've had service issues, bins being emptied randomly on the wrong day or late, a bin left on my premises by a former tenant not collected and now festering with rubbish. Can't get through on the phone. I've emailed and they've opened 2 cases but no response after 10 days now. I now have no idea when to put my bin out for collection next and I don't want to leave it out because I get fly tippers.

records.title: Despite our sending the required forms…
records.text: Despite our sending the required forms in September and October 2022, they stopped our waste collections without warning because the form had not been logged their end.  We are a GP Practice.  We don't need waste overflowing.No apologies forthcoming.

records.title: A vast improvement. Well done SUEZ.
records.text: UPDATE: after making a 1 star review, Suez responded professionally and with the greatest of respect and courtesy. I am pleased to say that our collections have taken place each week now for the past 6 weeks and if it continues like this it would be a 5***** review. For now, I will increase it to 3 stars to reflect an honest experience overall of how the service has been. PREVIOUSLYOne star is too many. Suez are responsible for collecting our recycling and miss the collections regularly. They are slow to respond to complaints then make promises they don't keep.

records.title: New sack request
records.text: We requested new refuse sacks which were EVENUALLY sent however, we used them once or twice and then the collectors refused to take them as they were not the correct bags. These were see through whereas the ones we should have used were white. This is not good enough. If we request bags then they should have sent the acceptable ones and if not then the collectors should have taken with no hesitation. They even knocked to tell us they were not taking them :(

records.title: No general waste collected Wed 7 Feb
records.text: No general waste collected Wed 7 Feb.  had to phone Suez as the bin was over full by the end of the week to ensure it got emptied before start of second half of school term 19 Feb.  I was informed that the driver thought he didn't have the gate key so it didn't get collected but he could have round to the office and got a member of the staff to open it.  This is not the first time this type of failure has occurred

records.title: Delayed collection
records.text: Samantha was great and always really helpful when speaking to her. she understood my situation and confirmed that it would be collected the week after by the end of the week so I agreed to go ahead based on these timings. I then later found out this didn't happen so I followed up  it was then moved back to nearly a week later! Not Sam’s fault I know but if I knew this was the timings prior to confirming the booking I would have gone elsewhere! Not very impressed!

records.title: Hoping for some improvement
records.text: Let down on our collection. However since posting a review I have been contacted by Steve from Suez and we have discussed our Company concerns and he has taken forward my issues with the Depot and we are hoping moving forward things will improve. Thank you to Steve for your time in trying to resolve our issues.

records.title: Collections Missed
records.text: The issue concerned missed bin collections. The last one having been due to inexperience of the driver not knowing where to access the bins. No contact was made with the school to try to gain access or determine access. There was no re-scheduled collection and waste built up outside of the requisite containers causing a potential risk. However Staff were apologetic and comms were maintained throughout.

records.title: On going Rubbish
records.text: Cheaper on a slow week but too expensive on the weight charges and the weight break is low.We asked for a Thursday collection, which they did when they first signed us, but now they do it on a Wednesday. Slow at returning email questions too.

records.title: Overweight charging
records.text: Unfortunately, I keep getting charged for being over weight in the bin . I’ve nowtaken to taking pictures of what’s in the bin and sometimes it’s not even half full with paper and card yet I’m 80 kg overweight and this cannot be possible.

records.title: Waste collections
records.text: Need to know that our waste is being collected on a regular basis. Late afternoon collection times are a problem due the fullness of the carpark due to on site activities especially during the football season.Please tell your drivers to keep to the speed limit within our car park, excess speed causes damage to the car park surface.

records.title: FAILED COLLECTION
records.text: Last week when i raised the problem of both our bins needed to be emptied due to them being full to the top, I was informed that it had now been arranged for them both to be emptied today, 4/9/24.  General waste has been emptied but not the recycling bin so as of today all recycling material will have to go in the general waste bin.  I've even got an email from the chap I spoke to !!

records.title: More cases than OJ Simpson
records.text: Repeated collection attempts out of hours leading to overflowing bins. Reported this so they arranged collection and came out of hours 3 times to collect the rubbish that hadn't been collected due to attempted collections out of hours. Called again, ended up with more cases than OJ Simpson. Switched Supplier.

records.title: Our blue bins and food in ME115AS…
records.text: Our blue bins and food in ME115AS Castle st were not emptied this week despite the fact that I saw truck at the far end of North road emptying bins, how can you possibly just not do one end? Our collections had been fine up until this week and now it looks like we're joining everyone else in Queenborough.

records.title: Beyond a joke
records.text: Our blue bins in ME115AJ and ME115EZ were not emptied this week (Tuesday) despite the fact that I saw truck at the far end of North road emptying bins, how can you possibly just not do one end? Our collections had been fine up until this week and now it looks like we're joining everyone else in Queenborough.

records.title: Some drivers are very good but Suez…
records.text: Some drivers are very good but Suez seem to have a small number that are more interested in sitting in their cab and taking photos from strange angles as proof of lack of access. Usually this was sorted next day but last case took a week so skip wasn't emptied but still charged.I have given 3 months notice and would not recommend this company

records.title: Customer Service Terrible
records.text: Bins collected on time and man who collects them is always very helpful. My issue is with Customer Services, all I want is a bigger bin or an extra collection but apparently only Colin or Damien can help me with this. I've been ringing every day for a week now but they are never available and don't call back. Not sure what to do. We are a new customer but looking to go elsewhere now.

records.title: Perfect for skips BUT
records.text: Perfect for skips, amazing service.... though messed up my payments took full payment even after paying a 2007 deposit. Now my company insurance payment will bounce as they have taken more than a week to look into it.  So SORRY to leave this review but honestly I have phones and emailed

description:
Hungry elephant, likes to collect and recycle junk! 

Multi-award winning technology platform for bulky waste disposal, offering rubbish removal and skip hire UK wide for trade and homes.

records.title: Really great experience
records.text: Really great experience! Very impressed! Dan who collected the stuff was really friendly, helpful, and arrived when he said he would. Had called earlier in the day to check timings so make sure we were in when he arrived the lady who answered the call was again really friendly and helpful. I could not fault them at all. Thanks again for such a great service and making our lives easier. We'll be in touch again!

records.title: Absolutely amazing service
records.text: Absolutely amazing service, from booking to clearance.A few months ago, we ordered a new mattress and the pick up for our old one was included in the price but outsourced to AnyJunk. It was super easy to arrange everything and I was impressed by the continuous updates provided by e-mail and text. The crew even took photos of the mattress and then the cleared area, both of which were then sent to me by e-mail.Because of this great service, I booked a pick up of bulky rubbish when we had a clear out a couple of weeks ago. The price was more than competitive and the service absolutely amazing again. As a bonus - because some of our items had been taken by someone over night and there was less to be picked up by AnyJunk, they automatically issued a partial refund so we ended up just paying the fee which would have been due for a tier below that amount of rubbish I had booked.AnyJunk will definitely be my choice every time. 5*+++

records.title: We have been using AnyJunk for a number…
records.text: We have been using AnyJunk for a number of years. They are reliable and have competitive pricing. Would highly recommend and we look forward to working with you more in 2025!

records.title: Prompt and professional.
records.text: Easy to book on line compared to a lots of on line things. Prompt response. On the day very impressed with email to say driver on the way and name of the driver with image.Professionally handle , felt comfortable the rubbish will be dealt with correctly.

records.title: I have used Anyjunk a few times and…
records.text: I have used Anyjunk a few times and they have been extremely reliable. They leave no mess behind and their prices are reasonable. Would Definitely recommend.

records.title: Effective and professional service.
records.text: The guys gave plenty of updates on their eta. They were personable and professional and made light work of clearing away all the rubbish that Biffa had failed to collect.They left the site in a clean, tidy state.

records.title: The AnyJunk team arrived as arranged
records.text: The AnyJunk team arrived as arranged. They were pleasant, efficient and hard working - segregating the rubbish into what could be recycled and what needed to go to the tip. They cleared everything. I would definitely recommend this company.

records.title: Easy to book
records.text: Easy to book, polite efficient pick up and reasonable price, no complaints

records.title: Kitchen waste removal…
records.text: Very pleased all round with the two  lads that removed our kitchen waste today,very efficient and left no mess.(Would not have known they had been) D Lawrence

records.title: Quick
records.text: Quick, efficient and got rid of some unpleasant settees that the council would not take. Worth the money.

records.title: Always go for more space
records.text: A good service, easy to book and fast. It is difficult to estimate the amount of space you are clearing, even using the descriptions on the website. So my recommendation is to go for more space and then you'll get everything done in one go. I had to book a second clearance.

records.title: Collection of junk went very smoothly
records.text: Collection of junk went very smoothly. Two team members turned up on time and were very efficient and helpful. I would have given five stars if not for the fact that an off-site boss wanted to upgrade my service from a four square yards collection to seven square yards, at a further cost of £88. This was apparently based on pictures he received showing the collection included a lot of wood. He decided I must have exceeded my weight limit.Luckily the two team members agreed with me that the limit had not been exceeded and I heard nothing more on the matter.

records.title: Polite and professional
records.text: The guys turned up on time, notification by text when nearby.  The were polite, professional and very helpful and efficient. Would definitely use again.Error with booking so not everything was collected, awaiting refund.  It's been a week

records.title: Very good quick and no hassle
records.text: Very good quick and no hassle

records.title: Pick up done on time
records.text: Pick up was on time although the team who arrived were not fully equiped to lift the heavy item. I had given full details,but all in all, job was done well and I would recommend this company, especially for removal of standard items.

records.title: I was so sad that they couldn't take…
records.text: I was so sad that they couldn't take all the rubbish 😔 husband palliative at home, trying to get everything sorted on my own 🙏 their truck was already full when they arrived. Polite but 😔

records.title: The men who came were kind …
records.text: The men who came were kind and efficient.The admin made me feel I was committing a crime and the invoice was not called an invoice and itemisation on it was unclear and I found all that upsetting.But all done as hoped and I think AnyJunk is competitively priced.

records.title: Really quick turnaround with lots of…
records.text: Really quick turnaround with lots of availability for collections in comparison to the previous company and was able to have my items collected the very next day. Only downside was a set of 4 dining room chairs counted as two items as did a set of 4 garden chairs so I had to pay for two separate collections at £35 each (£70 total) as they will only collect 5 items per collection. They came the same day and took all the items in one go apart from one table that they came back for. I had 9 items collected according to their collection policy.

records.title: I'd booked pm session but driver phoned…
records.text: I'd booked pm session but driver phoned early morning 8am to ask where items were. He was polite so no problems but our commitments meant we could only put items out in am which is why we choose pm pick-up.

records.title: Professional friendly service
records.text: Not their fault but they were very late - but the depot  called me and the driver kept me informed.  Two very nice men finally arrived and took my furniture away carefully (no damage to walls) and really politely.  Would definitely use again.

records.title: pleasant staff to deal with
records.text: pleasant staff to deal with.  Communicates politely and answers all questions.  When the car arrived, I picked up the children from school, called the operator back, gave instructions on where the garbage was, came in 20 minutes, almost everything was removed.  The only problem turned out to be that you need to let us know in advance about the garbage that you are going to take out.  On the day of the export, they could not report anything.  But when they complained, they asked me to wait a couple of days until they figure it out.  As a result, they made a discount of £ 20.  A trifle, but nice.

records.title: What can I say
records.text: so anyjunk were a bit late but that is fine, in the end they came today to pick everything, Luke who came stayed and tried to ring me and luckily just as i was about to leave for work, i approached him and asked if he was from anyjunk, caught him just in time before he had left due to address issue from BNQ. Issue resolved. Luke was  a legend. all cleared in ten minutes

records.title: Pleasant company from arranging to completion
records.text: The company informed me of the registration of the vehicle and gave me photos of the men who would be arriving, which was useful. I was informed approximately 30 minutes to when they would be arriving. The men were pleasant and just got on with the job.

records.title: Competitively priced
records.text: Competitively priced, easy to book collection, reliable. Good tracking service let’s you know exactly when they are on their way and their time of arrival.

records.title: They are good.
records.text: They are good.They are responsive to email enquiries and don't do the "it'll take 48 hours to reply" like many companies. They reply very quickly.Turned up on time and the 2 guys were good.The reason why I give 4 stars is because I doubt that there is tracking, I only got a tracking link when they actually arrived.Will use again.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service.  The only thing I would question is the price for removal of one television.  However they were a lot cheaper than another quote I had.

records.title: Cleared away efficiently
records.text: Cleared away efficiently

records.title: Any Junk website review
records.text: This seems an excellent website and service that has been well designed and tailored to meet individuals different needs, their prices are also fairly reasonable and their website is easy to navigate around and find the information that you need. Highly reccommended.

records.title: The company gave full text messages of…
records.text: The company gave full text messages of when theywill arrive and were prompt. They also collect the household waste very professionally

records.title: The time slot given was 7 am to 6 pm…
records.text: The time slot given was 7 am to 6 pm which is quite long to wait at our previous place. We literally had to wait 6 hrs. Rest other was good collection and good staff.

records.title: GONE
records.text: I liked the speed of removal but communication about pick up time could do with a bit of work

records.title: Paid for 4 yards but changed the price…
records.text: Paid for 4 yards but changed the price when they attended because they said it was too heavy, although it was less than 4 yards and not too heavy.Reply.At the time of collection the rubbish had been moved from the garden to the street we had no choice but to accept the extra charges. There was below the 4 yards we booked and i was unaware its based on weight also. I did not see that when booking.

records.title: Not a good service.
records.text: We had ordered a large van and had paid almost £200. We did not expect the collector to want to change us more money. One man came to collect our rubbish. He took two vacuum cleaners, Small piece of Carpet, a rattan conservatory suite, a mattress, two bedside cupboards and two bags. He wanted to charge me more money to take six  bags of light material. He arrived on site with an old washing machine and rubble on his truck. When he left his truck was still only half full. I won't be using Any Junk again.

records.title: Clearance from Ealing
records.text: I booked a rubbish clearance from Ealing for 6th October. I booked a 14 yard clearance which includes 90mins labour. Unfortunately the rubbish wasn't cleared in the time frame and another collection had to be arranged for the following day to clear what remained. I believe it could have been completed, but one of the guys was lazy. I moved more than he did and felt he let the team down. The second collection was totally different and both guys worked hard.

records.title: Exhausting to watch
records.text: Communication and timing were excellent and any questions answered promptly. The reason for the indifferent scoring is more about the execution of the actual collection process. Two guys turned up in a flatbed truck with cages on all sides. They swung the back wall of the cage open and proceeded to physically drag the hippobag nearer the truck. Then they threw larger items into the cage and followed that by manhandling the whole hippobag into the truck. I'm not a health and safety expert but I could practically hear the snapping of muscle and tendons from my front room vantage point. I realise that the job was completed successfully on all counts but surely some sort of crane would be in order before someone gets damaged?

records.title: I had booked for collection in the…
records.text: I had booked for collection in the morning and they arrived after 4 in the afternoon.   Nothing to notify me they were running late.

records.title: The lack of communication when my…
records.text: The lack of communication when my driver did not arrive at the allocated time slot.  However satisfied with the follow up and the offer of 50% off.

records.title: fast service
records.text: fast service, reliable and good prices, but when I ask the price to collect 2 doors, that asked me £90 for a small collection fee.  Shame.

records.title: I liked the friendliness and good…
records.text: I liked the friendliness and good manners of the teamI did not like the fact that they broke a piece of glass on the roadside and did not clean it

records.title: they will collect things only outside…
records.text: they will collect things only outside the door, which is not great if you live alone.

records.title: Not the best collection
records.text: Can't fault the driver, very nice. However anyjunk didn't tell them it was the xxlarge collection so they didn't come with a big enough van. Didn't manage to take everything, then I had to battle to get the refund for the smaller collection. The customer service person argued they took the right size even though the driver said he didn't even have a big enough van for it. Shame as I've used them before with no issues.

records.title: A tip from my experience
records.text: First time I used them everything went well and I was on site when the waste was removed.Second time I wasn’t on site and a substantial amount of waste was left behind.I recommend you be on site for the pickup.If the load is larger than expected they should call you and agree an extra charge.That didn’t happen.I would definitely use them again having said that.

records.title: I waited inall afternoon and finally…
records.text: I waited inall afternoon and finally phoned the office.they got in touch with the team who eventually rang me back and said they would  have to come the next morning.they did come on time the next day and were efficient and polite. However was annoyed to have to wait infor nothing.

records.title: It all depends on the team you get
records.text: Ashley's team who collected our stuff were brilliant and I would give them 5 stars. I would also give Jade 5 stars for being so helpful on the phone sorting out the mess created by another team who arrived earlier in the day as scheduled, parked opposite for about 20 minutes and then drove off, without coming to the front door to explain and without collecting anything. That team get zero stars, so 3 is a compromise.

records.title: I booked a time at 13.00pm
records.text: I booked a time at 13.00pm. - 18.00pm.But the driver call me and wake me up around 6.50 in the morning and he was at my house already. It is just okay for me. Even I need more time to sleep. Next time, he should call to customer before he arrive and should check the time before doing anything.

records.title: Customer service great but actual…
records.text: Customer service great but actual collection wasn’t. Refused to take a tv we had paid to be collected (were refunded by customer service but still had a tv to get rid of) and wouldn’t take rubbish from bins even though it was just cardboard boxes and they had the space which was frustrating as we had paid for the space and couldn’t use it all. Really not very flexible at all

records.title: Good company but poor sub contractor
records.text: The operative that turned up to remove the waste tried to charge me more due to him believing there was additional volume and weight to what o ordered. Although I disagreed with his assessment I had to agree the additional fee for him to remove it all. Took the issue up with AnyJunk office who agreed with me and did not charge extra. Ended up ok but could have done without the argument.

records.title: Consider the weight of your goods and not just the volume
records.text: The collection service was great. My only concern is that it is very hard to know how much waste you have. I used the online photo guide but later found that my rubbish, although not bulky, was too heavy so I had to upgrade to a larger collection incurring more cost. Whilst they do reference weight in the details there is no reference to it when you look at the photos guides and prices.

records.title: Booking was a little confusing
records.text: Booking was a little confusing as 7 square yards to 14 was difficult to compare against a small to large ship . Then pickup time  offered 7.30 to1pm I asked if one hour could be delayed was possible as I had 1 hour journey  was told yes ok, only to receive text by pickup truck driver that they’d arrive 11- to 11.30 rather annoying bad communication reception to truck driver . Work men were good Polite quick almost tidy enough . I’d probably use them again .

records.title: Capable but disorganised
records.text: The removal team were obliging and efficient - when they arrived.  But they were based a long way away (as in 80 miles), did not know their way around the area, and arrived 3 hours after the end of the morning slot I had booked, which seriously disrupted my day.  Moreover, they did not forewarn me that they had been delayed, meaning I had to chase through the switchboard.  The driver did apologise on arrival, but I will probably choose another firm for the next phase of the clearance.

records.title: Beware of extra charge on the rubbish
records.text: The driver promised to remove all the rubbish as I have to leave him to it.  He left soon after I left and left my rubbish behind. When I called Anyjunk back, they said my booking only covered what he took and I got to pay extra to get the rest taken away.

records.title: Not value for money.
records.text: The price for the amount of items taken is outrageous.  We've recently moved into a new house & had a lot of cardboard boxes to get rid of. Not having a car made this difficult for us so we decided to use AnyJunk to collect them & take them away.We'd collapsed, compacted & tidied the boxes as best we could. Having checked on the Website we'd chosen the "Small " option which the accompanying photo shows 2 tables, some offcuts of wood, a bath, approx 6 bin bags & a bucket.  We had 5 bin bags containing the collapsed cardboard boxes, a small lamp & a kettle. The guy wasn't happy when he saw this & said it was too much.  He said he could take 2 Wheelie Bins worth. For £116.00 + £5.00 labour we feel this is taking the mickie.  I will never use this company again & won't recommend them.  If we had a car we could have taken it to our local Landfill site for a cost to us for petrol etc of £4.00 per trip.  Even if we'd had multiple trips it would have cost approx £20.00/£30.00 at most.  How they arrive at a cost of £116.00 I don't  know.  I would only use this company if you have money to burn.

records.title: not great
records.text: not great. Seemed overwhelmed by normal London parking issues and had to push/persuade them every inch of the way just to do the job

records.title: We had used AnyJunk before...
records.text: We had used AnyJunk on previous occasions and were very impressed with their work. But this time:-Having measured the quantity of junk we had and listed the things we felt weighed a lot we opted for a van suitable to take our rubbish. One man turned up (late) - couldn't/ wouldn't take it. To cut a long story short (which goes on for over a week with various men turning up unexpectedly) everything was finally taken. On numerous occasions I was told "the office would call me back" but they never did. Then various invoices arrived with no explanation as to why or what. Basically a complete shambles.

records.title: Anyjunk failed to arrive the first time…
records.text: Anyjunk failed to arrive the first time the second time they tried to move the pick-up to the next day but forgot to tell me the appointment was changed. On the third attempt I rang them to confirm and they did arrive but needed two journeys as there was too much. Collection workers were good but their organisation needs to be radically improved.

records.title: I asked 5 items to be collected.
records.text: I asked 5 items to be collected.When they came they could not take 1 items as they had no room in their van and needed to make other collections. They did not offer many options or say it would be collected later. I had to call the support number which was reluctantly provided. Unfortunately they couldn't resolve the issue either, so I had to dispose of the final items myself.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: App was not working properly. Made a mistake and AnyJunk wants me to pay for it. They didn’t take all the rubbish away. Even helped them load the rubbish, they still found issues and customer service was below average standards. Not really sure I wanna use again.

records.title: Mega Hippo Bag pick up
records.text: We paid for a mega hippo bag to be taken, paid online.  When the operatives arrived it was not with a grab truck but a van so the rubbish needed to be unloaded.  They said it was too heavy and we needed to pay them another £20.  How they could assess it was too heavy I have no idea.  My husband agreed to pay the £20, we were then charged another £28 instead. Again no idea why.  On a positive note when I complained their customer service was very good, very quick and responsive, they gave me a refund immediately.

records.title: Won't use again
records.text: Booked a for a large load, safe in the knowledge (from seeing other reviews) that I would get a partial refund if it was medium.  Took gang 15 minutes to removed my junk so requested refund.   Anyjunk did a "review" and said it was large.   Not happy.  Won't use again.

records.title: The driver could not take the whole…
records.text: The driver could not take the whole pile saying that we had been misquoted .. and wanted more funds.. which we couldn’t do.. We were left with rubbish which we thought would have gone that day.  If we had been told the correct fee we would have chosen a skip instead. There were no bad feelings, just  disappointment that for the fee we paid- half the pile was left behind.

description:
We are a family-run business based in Hertfordshire. We take pride in what we do, how we do it, and the service we provide to our customers.  
 
No matter the size of the job, the nature of the task, or the location, you can guarantee that every job will be dealt with professionally and on time.

records.title: The service we received was second to…
records.text: The service we received was second to none, really easy to organise. Quick to arrange, the team that came were fantastic and efficient. Cost effective too, exceeded expectations. Would highly recommend.

records.title: Quality Service
records.text: They were easy to contact, polite, arrived on time and did exactly what they said they would.

records.title: Made enquiry on Sunday
records.text: Made enquiry on Sunday, not expecting to receive a reply until Monday. But from the photo that I sent was quoted a very reasonable price, and informed removal could happen on the Monday.Everything was arranged swiftly via email, and rubbish removed as I asked. Great service, will recommend to friends and family, definitely will use again myself !!!!

records.title: Efficient and certified
records.text: Used Rubbish Clearance for general stuff, chairs some sand and bits from guttering replacement.  They were quick to respond and actually able to attend that day. They called me just before arrival as requested so I could put dogs away. When they arrived they were quick and efficient.  Most importantly I was provided with a Waste Management certificate .The price was good value.I wouldn't hesitate to use them again or recommend them to others.

records.title: Would 100% recommend. Great service!
records.text: So so pleased with the service received today from Rubbish Clearance Hertfordshire. The guys were really friendly and professional, got the job done with no issues whatsoever. Will 100% be using their services again and absolutely no hesitation in recommending them. Even got a call from Richard himself after the job had been done to make sure everything was satisfactory. Very pleased and many thanks for your hard work!

records.title: Cheaper and less work than loading a skip.
records.text: I have used this company on two occasions. A few years ago  I demolished a shed in my daughter's garden and removed 50 bags of rubble from under the ground floor of her house.I also took out a fireplace.Richard's team very efficiently removed it all at a very reasonable price. More recently I replaced an old fence in my garden and again they came the next day and removed it very tidily. It was cheaper than hiring a 6 yard skip and I didn't have to cut up the boards to pack them into the skip. I will use this company again in the future.

records.title: Blinding service
records.text: Responded straight away to my enquiry. Richard and his team arrived promptly, clearing all the rubbish from our renovation within an hour, at a very reasonable cost. Absolutely blinding service from start to finish. Highly recommend Rubbish Clearance Hertfordshire.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service! Where able to collect same day and did all the heavy lifting for me. Thanks guys 👍🏻

records.title: Brilliant service from Richard and his…
records.text: Brilliant service from Richard and his team. Helped me & my brother to make a start on disposing of some household rubbish & clearing the back garden. Nothing was too much trouble & the price was very reasonable as well. We will definitely call on them again.

records.title: Fantastic
records.text: Fantastic, efficient service and job done. Richard was very quick coming round to give us a quote and the men who came to remove all the rubbish (old shed panels, furniture, garden waste etc etc) were brilliant. Took everything that had been agreed plus a few extra bits we had come across. Even swept afterwards. Cannot rate or recommend more highly

description:
Abri is a large housing provider who own and manage more than 50,000 homes and various community assets, serving 114,000 customers. Silva Homes joined Abri in October 2023 making the group a financially stronger and more resilient organisation. To help deliver our services Abri work with 36 local authorities and 63 different parliamentary constituencies alongside partners in our community. 
We believe everyone has the right to a good quality safe, warm and sustainable home in a community where they can belong, grow and thrive. What does that look like in real terms?

We’re investing £689m over the next ten years in our existing homes to improve building safety and make them more energy efficient

We’re delivering 10,000 homes by 2030, ensuring affordable housing is built where it’s needed most

We’re investing in our communities, to address local issues and create opportunities for everyone



If you want to raise a repair, make a payment, send us a message and much more, you can do so by logging on to the portal.

Log on to the portal:
Visit MyAbri

records.title: Abri customer relations
records.text: I've never had a problem!Everyone I've ever spoken to has been friendly, helpful and always polite, no matter what the problem/fault has been!Solving any problems,has been dealt with quickly, efficiently and very professionally !Couldn't ask for more!Keep going.Very much appreciated!

records.title: Abri operators take pride in their work ….
records.text: Abri operators always go out their way to carry out a job, completing it so the clients safety is a top priority as well as using their expertise to advise clients what needs to be done etc.  Darren the operator carried out the job rather than coming back which was very handy and Lucien, he will thoroughly carry out each job and put in jobs that need attention too. He doesn’t just do the work and leave, he will only leave when he is 100% satisfied with the work.

records.title: Amazing customer service team
records.text: I've been in this house with Abri (previously Yarlington) for many years. I can honestly say, that the customer service is outstanding.  Every time I call, whoever I speak to is lovely. Whenever I need a repair, the repair team are great. Recently I've spoken to Michelle and Carla, both were really friendly, engaging and helpful.  I also had a heating engineer out today (3/1/2025), I can't remember his name but he was great.  It was a minor problem and I worried I was wasting his time, but he reassured me, sorted my minor issue and again was super friendly and helpful. Overall Abri is very good landlord.

records.title: Like a breath of fresh air
records.text: Like a breath of fresh air. They come promptly at convenient times such as school run hours and very easily booked. When they arrive, they are prompt and very friendly. They make you feel like nothings too much bother and I have every faith that they will work to a high standard.

records.title: Abri have got it right.
records.text: Abri have got it right, customer service is excellent I have to say, the people I speak to on the phone are very friendly very helpful and very understanding of my needs in full.

records.title: Mathew fixed the electrics in my…
records.text: Mathew fixed the electrics in my kitchen very efficiently and was very friendly and helpful.

records.title: I had to contact Abri on their portal…
records.text: I had to contact Abri on their portal to arrange a repair. The customer service agent was very helpful.  So the rating is for him not for the company. Other experiences have been below average.  Far too long for repairs being carried out. Customer service getting things wrong, causing stress. 2x Stage 2 complaints upheld. 1x Stage 1 complaint not upheld as an operative was believed over me. So damaged caused by the operative was not remedied.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: After coming home from work and losing all power on a Sunday my first thought was 'what now'. I rang the Abri ooh team, the first person was very reassuring and I had an electrician at my home within an 45mins. He immediately found the fault but unfortunately it was a network issue and not one Abri could resolve. But he made some calls and within an hour SSE had arrived, in total I was off for only 10.5hrs, and that included having to dig to the main cable and repairing it!! Superb response and service from all. Many many thanks.

records.title: Abri, perfect 5 years!
records.text: Every time I've had to call someone out they have promptly resolved any issues in a friendly and efficient manner. Never have I encountered an issue from the Call Centre to the Operatives that attend. Everyone at Abri has done their best to look after me and mine and I truly appreciate all their hardwork!

records.title: Kevin came to sort out my boiler
records.text: Kevin came to sort out my boiler that had stopped working. He turned up early, he was very helpful and polite. I didn’t realise that my boiler was still under warranty so I should have contacted them instead. Kevin very kindly still sorted the issue out for me so that I didn’t have to go any longer without heating or hot water which I greatly appreciated.

records.title: Toilet repair
records.text: Issue: toilet cistern constantly filling with water. Repair carried out successfully, new filter replaced and issue resolved. Marked down 1 star as I had to ask repair technician to take off his shoes as recently new carpet fitted. Otherwise he was pleasant, friendly and professional.

records.title: Very happy with Abri and staff.
records.text: Spoke to a lady I think Carla was her name.Very polite helpful and reassuring.Sorted my issue with utmost professionalism.A few days later a gentleman called Jack came to see the problem and within half an hour I was very happy.Jack was chatty,sympathetic as I'm disabled and nothing was too much trouble for him. records.title: Frustration and stress in an overly inhumane market
records.text: First of all, you register your interest, you only get a message days later then the flats went available. So, you get on the website, there are few flats left.Then you initiate the process, they tell you 'no problem at all, you're on top of the pile, send any questions and we can proceed '.  You send your questions, they send replies. You get another email a few hours later the flat is unavailable. What's the point in getting into a process if it's so difficult?Not to mention lack of flexibility: they could lower the share for a cheaper less desired flat but we're "required to maximise affordability" for the flat we were interested in.Also, the plans don't show all the dimensions for a place you're supposed to buy without even visiting! Only great marketing in place!Overall, disappointing. Buying a property, shared ownership or not, is very stressful and can be frustrating in so many ways! We don't need Abri making this worse.This is just sad. I think a public institution should supervise their activities closer too.

records.title: Bad communicators
records.text: Bad communicators, low knowledge levels in customer service, (particulary for shared ownership), and high levels of condescension towards its tenants and owners.  These are things I've recognised over 11 years as the shared owner  of an Abri apartment.  Despite frequent phone and online surveys I've taken part in, and even in a Zoom focus group, to try to raise customer opinion of Abri, nothing ever changes.  It's difficult to get fast decisions as there is a steel wall between customer service and the people who make them.  This ensures high levels of frustration and doubt, as you await a last moment decision within in their permitted timescales.  No, timelines aren't generally breached very often, but neither is common sense or compassion appled when a need for speed seems obvious.  Abri is entrenched in its jobsworthy protocols and I am often its victim.My electricity company recognises that at 74 I am considered vulnerable.  My gas company recognises the same thing.  My local council treats me as a vulnerable person on the grounds of my age, and even my phone company does.   Abri, not so much... in fact, not at all.  No consideration is given for age and decline in faculties, at all.  Although years ago, a very frothy piece about the intended care of their more elderly and vulnerable residents appeared on its (then), Radian website, it has failed to change one jot!  Oh if only I could escape my entrapment in shared ownership!  Abri is indeed its own version of Hades.

About Pure Cremation 
 Pure Cremation provides Britain’s most popular funeral plan. Our funeral plan includes everything you need for a dignified, respectful funeral – so there’s nothing else that family need arrange or pay for. A pure cremation means your funeral, your way – guaranteed.
