records.title: I thought the procedure was generally…
records.text: I thought the procedure was generally ok. everything was going well until you started wanting feedback on your performance as a business. I thought it was quite insensitive of you not to enquire what kind of pressure I was/am currently under. I have mental health issues and it didn't occur to you that these might be affecting me at the moment. I really could have done without this 'so-called' reminder about rating you as a business. I am depressed and dealing with my own death -taking the financial pressure off others is bad enough, rather than having to confront my own problems by being reminded of it all by this reminder was very irritating

records.title: Everything was explained in detail and…
records.text: Everything was explained in detail and was easy to understand. In hindsight the price was more expensive than most other similar plans. Probably should have searched more.

records.title: Reasonable price,easy to do online.Took…
records.text: Reasonable price,easy to do online.Took quite a while for paperwork to come and they offer you an argos voucher which they then say its a 6 month wait for it. Bit poor on that one but overall reasonable company.

records.title: Wrong details
records.text: My Certificate arrived with my birth incorrect. My husbands first name spelt wrong.  Twice I have called for both to be corrected.  This hasn’t happened as yet.

records.title: Could not complain we had a good…
records.text: Could not complain we had a good experience with the chap who esplained everything in a courteuos manner. glad we have mad the right decision, Thank you.

records.title: Received documents
records.text: Received documents, wrong DOB. Have not received correct replacement docs at present, so not impressed. Also I was contacted by one of your phone guys contacted myself trying to sell me the funeral plan. I had already payed in full online. I get the impression the right hand do not know what the left hand is doing.

records.title: Not tellers of the truth!
records.text: Been thinking about a plan with them for several weeks.They charge nearly £1900 for basic planSearched the net and found a similar plan for £1500.Informed Pure Cremation and they stated the reason the £1500 plan was so cheap is that 'there was hidden extras'!Found out this wasn't the case.Needless to say I've gone with the Company that charges less!Tell the truth Pure Cremation!

records.title: My husband bought a policy in…
records.text: My husband bought a policy in January,but he has not received his gift card.He emailed them a week ago and they blamed their marketing company and said he would be contacted by email within 7days and to check my spam email as well.I wonder how many other people do not get their gift cards or forget about them as I can see other people on this website are asking the same thing.

records.title: Bombarded with unwanted sales emails…
records.text: Bombarded with unwanted sales emails and phone calls - even after I'd purchased a plan with them! Website clunky and not smooth when trying to purchase a plan, then their customer service took several days to respond to my email requesting help, and their reply didn't even address my concerns! Grrrrr. Hope they're more professional & switched on when dealing with my body when the time comes.

records.title: Still waiting for changes to be…
records.text: Still waiting for changes to be acknowledged by sending me the new paperwork. Keep chasing and requesting what I need,it gets promised, but so far not got them. They need to read communication properly and activate what's been requested. Just want to get on with life and forget about the morbid bits. Fingers crossed it's sorted asap

records.title: Nothing went wrong
records.text: Nothing went wrong, because I haven't needed to use your services yet. I've just started on the 2-year payment plan. When I need to use your service, I really hope that it can all be done quickly, as it is for some religions. I've been to some cremations where the deceased had been kept 'on ice' for several weeks. When I was a child in a village, funerals always used to happen within the week, but not now unless you're a J or a M

records.title: Bit Sketchy
records.text: My mother passed away recently and I found paperwork from various funeral directors etc.  I wasn't sure if she had ever made any arrangements so I did the process of ringing round to check.Spoke with Pure Cremations, they were very helpful, said that my mother had been in touch wanting info and a pack had been sent out but she'd not booked anything.  I said thanks, I'll carry on ringing the others, but that if she hadn't made any arrangements I might call back.A couple of days later, a booklet from Pure Cremations arrived at my mother's house, addressed to her offering a discount.A little bit insensitive to ambulance chase in that way.

records.title: Sensitive? Caring?
records.text: Went online after reading great reviews. Ticked all the boxes, including paying in full, but then decided to think it over a little longer.  Got a response the next day saying if I take up the offer, I would get a double voucher. Unable to speak to me as they're extremely busy. Not the response I wanted or expected for a sensitive decision!

records.title: paid £1895 in 1 installment but wait 6 months for gift card…
records.text: Although I paid the £1895 in 1 installment, they will still keep me waiting for another 6 months before I get my £100 gift voucher. 2 months I can understand as at least you've past the 30 day cooling off period.  Very quick to take your money but very slow in giving back. I hope they don't do this when I'm dead.

description:
Biffa is the leading integrated waste management and recycling company in the UK and the UK's No. 1 for Business Waste.
Our team of more than 10,000 colleagues carry out essential operations every day to support the UK circular economy including waste collection, surplus redistribution, recycling, treatment, disposal and energy generation. Our purpose is to change the way people think about waste and sustainability has been at the heart of our business for many years. 
By investing in plastic recycling and energy from waste, we aim to have net zero carbon emissions by 2050.

records.title: Chole was really helpful and…
records.text: Chole was really helpful and understanding she dealt with my issues with thought and consideration, was thinking of leaving but she convinced me to stay ! She will do well and progress to higher levels quickly Thank you Best of luck Ranjit Dhaliwal Bridgeway Stores Ltd

records.title: Chloe Green was excellent in her…
records.text: Chloe Green was excellent in her assistance to review the prices. It did mean that we had to take out another 12 month contract to do so.

records.title: Samantha was very helpful
records.text: Samantha was very helpful, and gave continuous support even when we faced some IT issues trying to complete our new order.

records.title: Russell very quickly arranged a price…
records.text: Russell very quickly arranged a price we could afford as a charity

records.title: Fantastic service from Zoe Cooney
records.text: Fantastic service from Zoe Cooney, she went above and beyond with a recent issue. She kept me informed about the situation all the way through and made sure the issue was resolved to my satisfaction. I can’t thank her enough for her help. Thank you Zoe.

records.title: Thank you so much Chloe!
records.text: Chloe was so patient and really took her time to answer all my queries in a very professional and prompt manner. I really do appreciate the effort she went through to resolve all my queries, and even followed-up with me to check everything went well! I could tell she is very dedicated and passionate about helping others, a million thank you! - I rarely give feedback, but felt the need to on this occasion as it was sincerely exceptional!!! :D

records.title: Great service
records.text: Biffa have always been extremely good with collecting our bins. I have used other providers and they the best without doubt.We are moving premises so I contacted the head office. Lucy was very friendly and resolved our issues efficiently.

records.title: Excellent Customer Care
records.text: Alfie Sutton and his colleague Nathan were very helpful when I called to enquire about the services Biffa offer, having been let down by our city council. Very happy with their customer care and my query was dealt with very efficiently! Thank you Alfie & Nathan!

records.title: Good customer support and able to fix issue quickly
records.text: I was put in touch with Chloe Green to help with an issue with my account. She was incredibly helpful and dealt with all of my issues professionally and promptly, providing amazing communication and support throughout. Many thanks for your help Chloe!

records.title: Very Helpful
records.text: Helen Bush was very helpful and swift to answer my questions

records.title: I looked online to get a quote
records.text: I looked online to get a quote and not long after I got a quick response from Amelia Allison.  Great service and very polite and sufficient.  Easy to set up the account too.

records.title: Was looking to terminate…..but!
records.text: I called with the intention of terminating my contract. Frank listened to my concerns and offered a mutually agreeable alternative, was efficient and personable. Although I do feel as a long standing customer (and one who runs a not for profit charitable centre) my account should have been monitored and reviewed so it didn’t need to come to decision to terminate or not, this was in no way a reflection of the excellent service I received from Frank Watts.

records.title: Good Experience with Customer Service
records.text: Had a good experience recently with Thomas in Customer Services - I had queried a change in their weight charging for our waste service and although they did not resolve it how I would have liked, an alternative resolution was offered which worked.  Also, one of the few companies that actually call you back, which is pretty rare these days.

records.title: Adele Wilkinson got the job done
records.text: Adele Wilkinson got the job done.  Matters and issues which we have been trying for Months to resolve with Biffa were dealt with by Adele in half an hour.  Thank you and well done.

records.title: Waste Service Query - IG3 8DQ
records.text: After a long and tedious back and forth calling Biffa, today I can say Alfie managed to make all effort to help resolve the situation of an ongoing issue concerning my waste collection. After having been misinformed about who would collect my waste, not to mention each time I called i was given the same response by the majority of the advisors and a very unresponsive sales rep Joanna almost made me consider whether I should continue the contract with Biffa. Perseverance is key as Alfie made right all the wrong and now I am a much satisfied and happy customer. Thank you, Alfie for your help and support today, it was much appreciated.

records.title: Since taking on the contract on Nov 23
records.text: Since taking on the contract on Nov 23, we have had a great service. However, the last couple of skips delivered have been very damaged, but I have an amazing accounts manager (Miranda Parker) who is always polite, gets to the point and gets things done, I can't praise her enough. I'm sure she will get this sorted for me and we will continue to have good service.

records.title: Quotation Process could be improved
records.text: Alfie was great today (five stars) and so was Ashton yesterday.  However your website was misleading as the price quoted was different from what Alfie told me which was different from what Ashton told me yesterday.  It is also confusing as we want a fortnightly collection but your quote either shows the cost for weekly or monthly.  This is confusing as you think you have worked out the price only to find out that there are additional costs in the small print which more than double what your website quote says.  It is very misleading.

records.title: Hassle free service
records.text: As an independent business, I needed to set up a commercial waste account and I was fortunate to get David.He made the whole process hassle free and was very knowledgable to guide me through the various options.He got me a good deal which included free delivery!

records.title: Sales Service from Chloe Marriott.
records.text: Sale support from Chloe Marriott - Chloe was great at helping us with our renewed quotation which was slightly lower.  Chloe really did go an extra mile to help us. However within the BIFFA IT system Chloe could not find a quotation that we had obtained on 11th Nov. on line from BIFFA. But this is obviously BIFFA system issue. Chloe did not provide any other instructions on what I have to do - BUT did request me to eMail back any queries.

records.title: Miranda, our saving grace.
records.text: Biffa is a great company when they do their job. Had a missed services for the better half of a year, still had to pay. But their trash collectors are quite dishonest, they missed our service but always marked it as complete. Thus causing a cascade of problems. But our saving grace was Miranda who helped sort everything out for us. Wonderful customer service from her, she kept us up to date and responded immediately whenever any problem arose. If it wasn’t for Miranda, we would’ve stopped being a customer of Biffa already. All in all, when services take place , it’s a great company. They are thorough and good. Their customer service representatives could use some work though, they aren’t very helpful most of the time. Kudos to Miranda for being awesome through everything we faced.

records.title: Patrick Great support
records.text: Patrick was great at helping me figure out the best options for my business. As a small business it is always important to get the best price and service you require. Patrick has been a great support in understanding this. I feel more confident in the waste system that I have gone with moving forward.

records.title: I have had constant issues with Biffa but…
records.text: I have had constant issues with Biffa and was continually panned off as someone else’s problem, however since getting in touch with Natasha she has not only solved the problems but has kept in regular contact to ensure everything is going smoothly and as it should be. Fingers crossed the rest of Biffa services can live up to her standards!

records.title: Skip & bin provision
records.text: I am in charge of Waste Management for Ely Folk festival.  Biffa not only provided the best price, their service was excellent as well.  Amy Leggett dealt with me from initial enquiry through account creation, agreement of requirements, delivery and collection and was extremely helpful and professional throughout.  The deliveries were on time and as agreed, and although the collections were delayed (not Amy's fault) everything else was a s good as one could have hoped for.

records.title: I m just saying to Frank who is…
records.text: I m just saying to Frank who is discussing on the phone with me , hope we have a nice 12 month spend with your good service

records.title: First Contact
records.text: I spoke to Shannon Storey who was extremely helpful, knowledgeable, professional and friendly. Shannon knew what I was talking about and had an answer for every question I asked. In my opinion she is an asset to your organisation and an excellent first point of contact.

records.title: Reliable Collection
records.text: Overall the collection is good and reliable, just took a bit longer to set up an account than I initially expected in terms of weeks. Their guidelines are fair and clear to understand and payment plans easy to follow.

records.title: Happy existing customer
records.text: Spoke with a professional mannered person, went through clearly what I was getting and what to expect going forward, I'm fully aware of my contract and whats required. in short a very understandable telephone call.

records.title: Helpful
records.text: Biffa, in particular Samantha, have been extremely helpful in dealing with my query, and whilst in the end it could not be resolved, I would recommend their services.

records.title: Biffa agreed to reduce the frequency of…
records.text: Biffa agreed to reduce the frequency of our collections within contract to match our requirements and allow us to reduce costs so I was pleased with that. there were a few internal communication issues regarding the commencement of the new collection frequency but I'm sure that will get resolved soon

records.title: Recently set up a contract with Biffa
records.text: Recently set up a contract with Biffa via Adele Wilkinson. Adele kept me informed at every stage and when the collection schedule wasn't set up properly she intervened and got an interim collection made

records.title: How much do biffa charge you if "…
records.text: How much do biffa charge you if " leaving no bag will incur a wasted journey fee" what is the cost and how do they collect?

records.title: Alicia the agent was very helpful and…
records.text: Alicia the agent was very helpful and resolved our problems.I didn't give Biffa a better score because they don't give direct dial numbers to their employees so it very hard to speak to the relevant person.

records.title: Standard waste collection
records.text: Poor service to start with. Long winded process to resolve simple issues, due to poor internal communication on their part. Once resolved, rubbish collection should follow smoothly

records.title: Poor company knowledge about recycling
records.text: Our school has a recycling contract with Biffa. Rang customer service in June to ask what exactly can be recycled, as the information given to us was very sparse. Staff couldn't answer majority of my questions and hadn't heard of numbered codes on different plastics nor of Tetrapaks. Said they would find out and let me know. They didn't. Rang again in July - again, staff hadn't heard of plastic codes or Tetrapaks. Said they would find out and let me know. They didn't. Rang again in August - staff HAD heard of them (yay!), rang the recycling depot, where staff didn't know what plastic codes they recycled.  If a recycling company literally know nothing about recycling and care so little about it that they don't even know what they recycle, how are the public supposed to know what to recycle? How do I encourage my students to care about proper recycling when Biffa doesn't? How do I give them any hope for the future?On a positive, all staff I spoke to were very polite and friendly.

records.title: Felt ignored
records.text: Countless emails, secure messages and phone calls. I got frustrated and stressed to get one of our bins to be labelled for cardboard and paper recycling as required by regulation in Wales from 6th April 2024.The schedule service on 16th was not done. A label was then placed on just one side of our bin when it should be 2 labels at front and rear sides of the bin. The other bin we use for general waste has not been labelled. This should have been done for ease of identification by the crew when they come to empty the bins.A simple task by Biffa but I got stressed to get them action it. I felt let down by the lack of Biffa's communication. 😔

records.title: Mixture of customer service
records.text: We have contracted Biffa for our service. Unfortunately cannot provide the full service requested, and access issues. We had a mixed customer service with hardly any / prolonged and having to chase the local agent Mr Gulfraz . After having to call Biffa again to see why a email asking for the contract had taken 4 days and still nothing, we had a great service by David Irwin. Understanding, helpful, took the time to listen and find solutions, as well as let us know of options to help fill some of the services issues around recycling which hadnt been mentioned previous. Great service from David, who had us all sorted within 20min phone call, where are Haseeb, taken over 5 weeks!

records.title: Unsure So Far
records.text: Very easy sign up process but very unclear of next steps. I rang the number encouraged by their email but the women on the phone couldn’t give me any information.

records.title: Resolving failed bin collection
records.text: When you have a legitimate problem, how a company responds to it is so important.Following 3 failed collections (no attempts made but rescheduled due to driver issues) the customer service team were exceptional in their endeavours to resolve the situation before 1 week passed from the due collection date. Unfortunately, the depot undertaking collections let them down and didn't see the importance associated with 3 unattempted collections and leaving an additional weeks rubbish to be collected when collections are only fortnightly in any case. Where they expected this additional rubbish to be stored, I really dont know. How they thought is acceptable to store rubbish for 3 weeks, I really dont know.5* goes to the customer service team - they were fantastic1* goes to the local depot for their lack of owning the problem of their making.

records.title: I've only had the initial set up and…
records.text: I've only had the initial set up and bin delivery so far. The office paper work was easy to do and efficient.  Fair price and guided me in the direction for the type of bins I needed for me Business. Unfortunately one of the bins delivered has wet stinking rubbish in the bottom. Could you clean it out before delivering. I know its a bin, for rubbish. But.....sevice?

records.title: I have been with you for many years and…
records.text: I have been with you for many years and my overall satisfaction is tending more to four stars. unfortunately every now and then you slip up on things like missing out on a collection without follow ups. That's very annoying because we are dealing with refuse and recyclables that can constitute serious health hazards. A phone call to ensure the customer that an emergency plan is in place would help a lot to restore confidence.

records.title: I can't really comment on anything yet…
records.text: I can't really comment on anything yet as I haven't had any bins emptied.  I was supposed to get my bins emptied on Thursday 16th September but this didn't happen. I have been told they will be emptied today Monday 20th September. It is too early to make any comment on the service, once we get up and running I will be in a better position to comment.

records.title: My Ben still there for 2weeks
records.text: My Ben still there for 2weeks, and when we called you about changing ownership, we gave you right email but after one week I call back to you, then you find out you typed wrong email which is your fault I didn’t received email from you because you should check email properly.Now we have so much rubbish outside my shopWe taken over the Monday 26/7/2021This week it will be 3 weeks Thanks

records.title: New waste collection service…
records.text: I called up to arrange for a collection service for my waste and all the details were taken and I was told I would receive all details through emeil, nothing came so I called again to chase ans was told the person I spoke to would call me back. this didnt happen so I called back again and spoke to a lady who took control and sent the email across so we could fill it in, no other communication and still have no idea when our waste bin will arrive

records.title: There are good points and not so good…
records.text: There are good points and not so good points 1. Price is really competitive.2. It has been difficult to contact Biffa to discuss the start up of the contract Been on hold for 20-30 mins on some occasions and  I am still not aware of the days my collection will be 3.We have had to wait 3 weeks for any bins to arrive.

records.title: We have been with Biffa for only a few…
records.text: We have been with Biffa for only a few monthsSales team are very helpfulBut collections of waste have been mixed at least a couple of times they have not turned up to collect waste as per contract they have come at a later date but it was us that had to chase them to find out the problem when a phone call to inform us would have been appreciatedOverall not a bad service

records.title: Pain to get signed up
records.text: Pain to get signed up, had to call into the sales department multiple times to get started and felt like it could've been handled quicker. Also had some troubles with the bin getting delivered in the first place. But since we got going the service has been fine and every time you call up the customer service number they are all friendly and helpful.

records.title: Great at getting the quote sorted but…
records.text: Great at getting the quote sorted but it took a while to go through the hoops on credit checks etc where communication was poor spoke to a different person each time.  Had one pick up so far but I am still not clear where I should be leaving my Biffa bin!The portal is quite good so hopefully it will be easy from here on.

records.title: BIFFA, probably going to leave...
records.text: BIFFA have repeated missed our collections. They are up to triple the price of other local waste collection companies. If we are going to pay over the odds then you would expect impeccable customer service.However, The lady I spoke to today was wonderful. She listened. She actioned the points we agreed (good will gesture and price reduction) on the phone and sent an email confirming everything in writing. If only the rest of BIFFA were as good as the lady I spoke to today.

records.title: We have just opened an account with…Biffa Good and Bad
records.text: We have just opened an account with Biffa having dealt with Biffa Before had some issues but we were advised would not happen here so went with Same We have not opened yet and already had issues but have decided because of your Drivers to percivier as the Pandemic has caused a lot of Problems and hopefully we will move forward positively

records.title: If we deal direct with the team on the…
records.text: If we deal direct with the team on the Isle of Wight, everything works brilliantly.If the phone redirects us to head office it’s a nightmare every time.We needed one more glass bin, should be easy, but instead, our full collection got cancelled as they couldn’t find the Agreement form.

records.title: Avoid unable to collect weekly
records.text: We agreed for this service to be collected weekly, however several times you have failed to collect or to inform us why you are failing to come to the site.  The last call we made to your Customer Service department, that person was laughing as he spoke to me, which is not acceptable.  He gave the impression, that is is tough luck that we have not empty your bin and there was nothing he could do.  From a business, if you are offering a service then you need to have a plan in place for situation like vehicle breakdowns or staff sickness, I have to have a plan in place for my business.  Which I pointed out to your customer service rep, for which he said you cant plan for sickness or vehicle breakdowns, sorry but you should as this is what your business needs in order to operate to improve your customer satisfaction.  You dont call back when we have compliants nor do you arrange for additional collections for when you have failed to collect.

records.title: Hopeful this review will change
records.text: Along with other customers, I have found that often drivers will mark a journey as wasted without even attempting to move the waste constrainers. Thankfully we have CCTV covering the whole waste area so have been able to back up our side with evidence.I will say that this seems to be isolated to our DMR collections. I have found customer support representative to be considerate but lack the ability to make corrections to services which would allow issues to be solved. We have been promised repeated collection from the dates of missed disposals which have never arrived each time.

records.title: Biffa - grey bin collection
records.text: Our second grey bin was not emptied last week. It was left with the generic non-recyclable sticker which Wirral Council said Biffa would not return to empty the bin, which was 3/4 full with cardboard. Last time I heard, cardboard is recyclable?! Wirral Council advised this is not their responsibility but that of Biffa.

records.title: Awful customer service
records.text: Awful customer service.  Walked past my bin and ignored contacted green waste club, no apology and said leave bin out and may be collected if it's not can leave 3 bags of garden waste.  Explain this was about a quarter of the bin space, despite admitting fault they just said can only do 3 bags.  So I get penalised and absolutely no apology or flexibility to help.  Shocking service in Tandridge.

records.title: Over 3 months waiting
records.text: I logged a bin that is no longer used and has been left as a ‘rogue bin’ over 3 months ago. Despite emailing multiple times this has still not been removed and is attracting fly tipping. My last email was marked as a complaint and I received no acknowledgement or response.

records.title: Hidden charges
records.text: Hidden charges that were not on the quote. Called to ask why charges were being added and to query the monthly cost being different to be told that I was wrong. Apparently I can't read the email quote properly.It seems that delivery is free but not if you do it online. One consistent offer is all that the customer needs to get a good experience.Cancelled before I got the bins delivered

records.title: Horrible service
records.text: Horrible service. It is impossible to get through to their customer service and the only way to sign up is through phone. Also can't believe in this day and age a company would have a waiting list to enroll paying customers.

records.title: Appalling service
records.text: Prices are reasonable, Collection is regular, overall good service until things go wrong. I would not recommend Biffa because of the way they treat their customers. My direct debit returned back which was because my new electricity company decided to charge a large sum upfront  on unspecified date which fell into the same date so both Direct debit was returned. As soon as I realised what has happened I paid the balance via debit card hoping that would resolve the issue. But alas! Apparently my direct debit mandate was cancelled all together due to one bounce back. Also now I have to speak to customer service, set up a new direct debit and then wait 24 hrs and then I will have to book additional service(paid for) all the while I still have to pay for the service that I haven't received. It's all a bit excessive and heavy handed. If I have known how they treat their customer I would never have used their service. There are plenty of other waste collection services that are priced reasonably and with decent customer service.

records.title: Light tube collection
records.text: The customer service was good on the initial phone calls to book the collection, however I specifically asked that I get some notification at least a couple of hours, but ideally 24 hours, before collection so I could get them to the right place for the driver. Instead, the driver simply turned up and he was about as impressed as I was that we needed to move them around the building first. In addition, if I had also known how the tubes were required, I would have unboxed them before and had them ready, again if I had known when the driver was coming.

records.title: Could not have been more helpful and…

records.title: very friendly engineer would not be…

records.title: Support for young person leaving foster care
records.text: Had first contact with Mark last week relating to my assisting an 18year old girl,  with complex needs and vulnerabilities, into her first flat. records.title: Matthew Mills located at Bromley location
records.text: Matthew MillsIs such a caring supportive person, who goes to any length for my son.My sons needs are very complex and matthew has been so patient with him and has facilitate specialist services to help with his care needs.Although there is plenty of work still be done I feel a sense of security knowing that matthew is looking over my son .  Sabrina Crawford

records.title: Riverside Experience
records.text: The nicest people in customer services. Riverside Housing does offer great locations of apartments for people to live in. If you have an issue they are quick to solve it although it may take time. Some people on the other hand can spoil the environment by fly tipping which is a shame. This is quickly cleaned up. The apartments are a great opportunity for investment. They offer a shared ownership and private sales.

records.title: Their service is good Tbdvheir service is…

records.title: A Heavenly Home, courtesy of Riverside!!!

These calls are always a delight and it's most enjoyable to talk with someone not only caring but also with a good sense of humour.Only negative observations are that contractors doing general upkeep tend to be on a tight budget, so work is not as exacting as if it was paid for privately. Example would be painting of gutter fascias, a 'proper' job would require removing and replacing guttering rather than only painting half way up the fascia.Also, location of the bungalow gives very little light to living and bedroom, it is dark even in midsummer. description:
TrustedCare offers free help & advice to people looking for care for themselves or a loved one. 

 TrustedCare is a leading platform in the healthcare industry that provides comprehensive and reliable information about care homes and home care providers. Our expertise and knowledge in the care industry assists individuals in navigating the complexities of choosing the right care solution. With a strong focus on quality, transparency, and trust, TrustedCare aims to assist individuals and families in finding the best care solutions for their loved ones.  
 

Start your search today 
 Care Homes
 Nursing Homes
 Home Care
 Live-in Care


 TrustedCare also offers personalised support to users through our specialist team of Care Advisers, who can talk you through your options and identify the best services locally to provide the support you require. Our expertise and knowledge in the care industry assists individuals in navigating the complexities of choosing the right care solution. 
 Contact Us Today 

 Our care seekers can explore a wide range of care options tailored to their specific needs, through TrustedCare. Whether it's residential care, nursing homes, dementia care, or assisted living, TrustedCare has options for all. One of the standout features of TrustedCare is our commitment to transparency. Users can access detailed profiles of care providers, including information about facilities, services offered, and user reviews.

records.title: Trusted Care Nursing Home Search.
records.text: Trusted Care researched Nursing Homes on behalf of the family. We needed to find a place for palliative care very quickly. It is very daunting to make so many speculative enquiries.  Repeating over and over again those personal sensitive details of the situation is distressing. It was very helpful to be able to give the information once by deligating this initial task you only have to deal with the shortlist, they supplied within hours. An excellent service with exceptional customer care.

records.title: They were very quick in replying with…the information I needed.
records.text: They were very quick in replying with the homes relevant to the post code request with availability.

records.title: Great support from TrustedCare
records.text: TrustedCare did a great job in supporting us in the difficult and draining task for finding a care home for my mother-in-law. It saved a huge amount of time and emotion to be provided with a single list of suitable care homes in the area that had spare beds. Leigh-anne was kind and supportive - the initial list was provided within a couple of hours and she was always ready to answer further questions. I would not hesitate to use the service again and recommend it highly.

records.title: My experience with trusted care was…
records.text: My experience with trusted care was extremely satisfactory they kept me informed and if I had any questions they would always answer them I would recommend them to anylone

records.title: You took a lot of stress out of finding…
records.text: You took a lot of stress out of finding a nursing home for our Mother.

records.title: We were given advice and guidance all…
records.text: We were given advice and guidance all the way.

records.title: At a time when you need a sympathetic…
records.text: At a time when you need a sympathetic ear, Trusted Care were a great help. They listened & tried their best to find what was needed. Many thanks.

records.title: Agent to source care provider
records.text: I was given Trusted Care's number by someone working in the field.  I found this company to be 'one stop shopping' for the dizzying array of care homes.  They refined our search to a travel radius that I could manage, there and back in one day, and gave me data as to cost, if it was available.  I have selected a care home from this list, it will be the 'sandwich' option in between sending family member to another home offering more social events.  I figured a home should be either very social, or very restful, so I am providing both, on a rota.

records.title: I found TrustedCare excellent
records.text: I found TrustedCare excellent.  Well researched information was available.  They made it much easier to choose several homes to look at and find the best care with my friend.  It was easy to forward information to other members of her family.  Communication with the Homes was perfect and all called back when requested.

records.title: Help and advice
records.text: Very grateful for all the information we were given. Helped us to get a better idea of options available.

records.title: Know your options for loved ones
records.text: It is just so helpful to have a greater number of options when considering  Nursing or Care homes for the elderly.Within no time at all, those options increased,helped by your network, with more information available.

records.title: It was of great help to use this…
records.text: It was of great help to use this service of which I had no previous knowledge. Katie was helpful in her approach and knowledge and I was relieved to only be required to give my mum's personal details & medical history once in order for her to do the research for care homes on my behalf.The only small critism I have is that I believed I was contacting a care home directly the first time I dialled the advertised telephoned number so was  initially confused and unprepared for all the questions asked at that time. Having said that, it is a handy service to use.

records.title: Clear communication and helpful member…
records.text: Clear communication and helpful member of your team.

records.title: Trusted Care exceptional support for securing care home viewings
records.text: Trusted Care made it easy to view several homes on the same day, which was beneficial to be able to compare homes and remember each one.  They  secured all the appointments I required at the exact times I asked for in a timely, efficient and friendly manner.  It was very helpful having a one stop shop.

records.title: This is a great free service
records.text: Staff are helpful, reliable and polite.  It's a great service that supports you when you need it as they locate appropriate Care Homes and send relevant info to them letting you know who they've contacted and asking the Care Home to contact you if they have available space.  This has saved me time and energy at a stressful time with my mother in hospital.

records.title: Request for information re respite care
records.text: my needs were listened to attentively and I did not wait long for a positive response.

records.title: Whilst looking for respite for my mother…
records.text: Whilst looking for respite for my mother at short notice, a live chat popped up asking if i needed help. A very helpful lady on other end found me several options, one of which was perfect, and my mother is very happy there , so if u are looking for care or respite i would def give trusted care a call or look them up.

records.title: A nice surprise!
records.text: I was surprised when Trusted Care got in touch after I had filled in a form on line asking for more information about a local care home, I thought I was emailing the home directly! However, Trusted Care were very helpful and asked local homes to contact me directly. Not all were in the right area but nevertheless one which I had not known about, was very close by and has proved very good. I am very grateful for their help which was so useful in the difficult circumstances I found myself.

records.title: Very polite ,and eager to help
records.text: Very polite ,and eager to help. Called back when they said they would, they didnt find a carehome suitable for us ,although we did look at a couple on the list, its very difficult to find nursing homes for complex needs for under 65 years of age.

records.title: The Search for Repite
records.text: Almost completely in the dark, I was trying to find a local, good Care Home for my husband so that, after a solid 4 year's caring I could take a short holiday.  A list was provided, I did some visiting and meanwhile Trusted Care followed up with a courteous enquiry and offer of addititions to the list if needed.  It wasn't, we have been suited and I am relieved and grateful.

records.title: Great Support.   I spoke with Trusted Care when looking…
records.text: I spoke with Trusted Care when looking for a suitable local care home for my elderly aunt. It is such a stressful time for families and we felt under pressure from Social Services to make a quick decision. In the course of my research I contacted Trusted Care, who could not have been more understanding about our needs. Ultimately, they didn’t actually place my aunt, as my number one choice of home came through independently with an offer right out of the blue. However, when things were difficult Trusted Care gave me great help and support. Only reason I didn’t give 5 stars was because the final result came from another source.

records.title: Very helpful kind response
records.text: Very helpful kind response, my request was quite specific and so no facilities that met our needs in the area that I was looking at, but would use TrustedCare again if required.They did what they said they would do and very effectively

records.title: Highly recommend, great service
records.text: I hadn't heard of TrustedCare. A Bupa nursing home sent me their telephone number when they were unable to help. My experience of TrustedCare was that they were very compassionate and helpful to my Dad's needs. They sent me a list of relevant nursing homes in the area I was looking for, and followed up on this on a few occasions. My only negative was that a few of the homes on the list that hadn't got availability, but I'm not sure if that was the homes not telling the truth to TrustedCare, or if it was lack of research. Overall though I would recommend them to anyone who is looking to find a placement.

records.title: A helpful experience
records.text: I had a useful experience using trustedcare. They were able to suggest several places, some in suitable areas and some just a bit too far away, and only a few with the services I needed on offer. It was a difficult time for me to be looking with several care homes having waiting lists. The information available for each was very helpful, and my search was followed up by some individual homes which had been suggested, and by trustedcare themselves.

records.title: Polite & friendly Team
records.text: From mid-October to end November 2023, have had good response from a friendly and helpful team.All questions answered with relevant advice to situation given along other additional information, that we had not thought of! Very helpful.Appreciated the follow-up calls/emails to check on progress and offer of further information/advice.

records.title: Quick and relevant response to my request for help.
records.text: Matthew responded quickly to my initial request by providing contact information to two care homes which had vacancies.  He kept in contact and followed up after my exploratory visits.Although, in the end, neither home was selected his information was useful.

records.title: In searching for a very specific set of…
records.text: In searching for a very specific set of needs to help my mother in this phase of life, they did a great job of offering a good range options tailored to our requirements.

records.title: Compassionate company
records.text: The company representatives are extremely polite and courteous and show a level of compassion that is welcomed at a time when people and families may be vulnerable and emotional with their endeavor.   The communication was of a high standard.

records.title: The service was excellent
records.text: The service was excellent. I spoke with a person who understood the urgent need to find care, and the care provider chosen managed the process excellently

records.title: Understanding people
records.text: Care homes were completely unfamiliar to us, however trustedcare listen to our needs, made recommendations and contacted care homes on our behalf. A very helpful experience.

records.title: Efficient free service
records.text: Good detailed history taking on initial contact call, email response same day with search results and two subsequent follow-up calls received to check on progress.Sadly care homes generated not suitable. Geographical search way too wide so two homes were immediately ruled out based on location.  One home I'd already contacted had an admission restriction of 65+ (husband 62yr!) and all had a minimum respite period ranging from 10 days to 4 weeks - I wanted 6 days!! Overall though efficient service, great it is free and definitely would be helpful for those finding the search for suitable care facilities quite daunting.

records.title: Care home service
records.text: This company provided details of care homes that had bed vancancies for me to consider for my Father.  Some I was already aware of and others were either not in the right location or had no beds free.  Didn't realise during the initial conversation that I had "signed" up for an actual service per se so was suprised at getting calls asking about progress.  To be fair, I done all the leg work by myself!

records.title: Ann was friendly and provided…
records.text: Ann was friendly and provided suggestions but she was not transparent about the fact TrustedCare was linked to the care home we eventually decided to go for. I only discovered this by calling the home and getting Ann on the other line

records.title: Quick helpful service,
records.text: Date of experience: 17 March 2022

records.title: TrustedCare is advertising care homes…
records.text: TrustedCare is advertising care homes that have been inspected, in may cases, several times and have been judged as inadaquate or requiring improvement particulalry in the area of residents safety. While the CQC ratings are shown, I find it hard to understand why any company would then choose to promote such places. When looking for a care or nursing home, don't rely on companies like this. The CQC reports tell you far more than any reviews. PLEASE read the reports in full before submitting to loved one to any home.

description:
For anyone, the process of buying a home in London, is a series of trade-offs.
It can lead to scenarios you never dreamt you’d consider – forget the second bedroom, consider an unknown neighbourhood or even leave the city altogether.
NHG Homes is the partner you’ve been looking for to help you navigate the array of choices, make compromises you’re comfortable with and find a home you deserve in the city you love.
Our homes and developments are designed to a high specification, made achievable through the wide range of financial options we offer – from shared
through to outright ownership.
Always within reach of the city centre, reflecting the unique neighbourhoods they are part of and built for the people who make this amazing city what it is.
It’s our home and we want it to be yours too.
With NHG Homes, it can be. Choose London.

Notting Hill Genesis is one of London's leading housing associations, managing over 66,000 homes across the capital and building thousands more our vision is a to provide homes that build a better place for all.

The profits of homes sold by NHG Homes are invested back into the community, supporting services and developing more homes.

records.title: Flat in Woodberry Down
records.text: I recently purchased a flat in Woodberry Down. From start to finish, NHG team was professional, supportive and efficient. The process was smooth and the team guided me through every step, answering all my questions promptly and ensuring I understood everything. When things did not go as planned, the team was ready to step and find a viable solution. A special mention to Jack Cairns for going above and beyond to address any concerns I had, for keeping the process on track, and for being flexible.

records.title: Thank you Jack Cairns!
records.text: I recently purchased a shared ownership home with NHG. The process was generally pretty smooth and all of my questions were answered. I ran into some issues during my purchase, due to factors outside of NHGs control, and Jack Cairns went absolutely above and beyond to help me sort these out.I can't thank him enough for going the extra mile and being a constant reassuring voice during the whole process. Not only did he proactively reach out to keep me in the loop but any time I had a concern or was struggling to get information from NHG or my solicitor, Jack was able to chase things up and get answers for me very quickly.

records.title: Jack Cairns at NHG Homes was absolutely…
records.text: Jack Cairns at NHG Homes was absolutely fantastic in helping us finalize the purchase of our property and making our move-in process smooth and stress-free. From start to finish, Jack was professional, approachable, and incredibly supportive.He took the time to explain every detail clearly and was always available to answer our questions, no matter how small. His dedication and efficiency ensured that everything stayed on track, and he went above and beyond to make sure we felt confident and informed every step of the way.Thanks to Jack, what could have been a daunting process turned into an exciting and seamless experience. We highly recommend him to anyone looking for excellent service and support when buying a home. Thank you, Jack!

records.title: Supportive rep
records.text: My rep Jack was very helpful throughout the moving process, providing all the information we needed

records.title: Amazing service from Steven and Samuel
records.text: Amazing service from Steven and Samuel in the sales team. They have been patient to wait for decisions and actions on my side, supportive when I needed some ideas bounced off of them and helped me to push though everything from making an offer to exchange of contracts within 8 weeks. The broker and the conveyancing firm they recommended have been excellent at making the process smooth and reasonably painless.I felt the delay with the handover has been communicated well. It is never nice to be told there are delays, especially if they are measured in months instead of days. With the information Steven provided, I felt I know where I am in the process and I was able to take timely action when it was needed. Overall a great experience to buy with them.

records.title: It was an absolute pleasure working…
records.text: It was an absolute pleasure working with Steven Lam, he made sure everything was in place and I only ever had positive interactions with him. Also on the day of completion he made sure everything was in place for me. Thank you NHG homes.

records.title: Excellent Service from Steven and His Team
records.text: Steven Lam and his team made the process of buying our first home smooth and stress-free. From start to finish, Steven guided us with professionalism, clear communication, and a genuine understanding of our needs.  His team was organised, responsive, and supportive, ensuring everything was handled seamlessly. Steven’s knowledge of the market and his calm, approachable manner gave us confidence throughout the journey.  Thanks to their efforts, we now have our dream home. We highly recommend Steven Lam and his team to anyone looking for a reliable and skilled property expert. Thank you, Steven!

records.title: Steven - spectacular
records.text: Absolutely flawless experience from NHG and Steven particularly who has been incredibly supportive every step of the way. The flat has very lovely fishes however Steven informed me to communicate a couple of little defects which I am waiting to be contacted about. Overall a great experience

records.title: Supportive Team
records.text: Throughout this experience, Steven and the rest of the team have been so helpful, supportive and understanding. In a process such as this one, it helps when a supportive team can alleviate stresses and reassure you with clarity and kindness. A big thanks to the Team.

records.title: The whole team has been so helpful!!
records.text: The whole team has been so helpful! Steven, Jack, Daniel, so many great people that made my move in process as smooth as possible. Managed to turn round purchasing a shared ownership property in a month - lovely area and great building, if you're on the fence take that leap! :)

records.title: “Overcoming Challenges in My First UK Property Purchase”
records.text: When purchasing a property in the UK for the first time, I encountered many complex issues, especially with numerous legal terms I didn’t understand. Although the solicitor wasn’t particularly helpful, I’m grateful for Jack’s assistance in resolving many problems, allowing me to successfully obtain the keys and move into my new home. Jack is highly knowledgeable and has excellent problem-solving skills. I truly appreciate his help.

records.title: I don’t have experience to make a valid…
records.text: I don’t have experience to make a valid comparison but they helped me with my first mortgage. The Sale Consultant and Manager were diligent at moving the process along which began in August and ended just before Christmas. Although, I am grateful for their above and beyond service I do have a one grievance. The contracts were exchanged just before the Christmas break so I’ve had to until the 4th January 2022 to collect my keys. Fortunately, I’ve been lucky to be living with family who haven’t minded me staying a couple extra weeks.

records.title: We had such an amazing sales support…
records.text: We had such an amazing sales support from NHG with Alastair. Before him, experience wasn't amazing and didn't really talk us though what we needed to know in terms of next steps or didn't always give us the correct information. However, once our development had been passed to Alastair, he was absolutely amazing. So responsive throughout the whole sales process, happy to accommodate our multiple viewing requests, and happy to follow up and chase NHG solicitors where needed. We knew we could always reach out to Alastair for help if there were difficulties.

records.title: I have been reasonably happy to buy…
records.text: I have been reasonably happy to buy from NHG and on the whole have found them to be efficient and nice to deal with. There’s always going to be one or two snags with the process of buying a leasehold property and I think in my case I had to resend some info twice. But other than that and them robustly pushing things forward, they’ve been great. Housing Associations do get a bad rep, so my expectations were pretty low, but I have been pleasantly surprised.  Sales is very different to maintenance though, so we’ll see how they fair going forward.

records.title: The sales staff were always so friendly…
records.text: The sales staff were always so friendly and helpful. Special shout out to Alastair for helping me all the way through the process. I am so happy with my shared ownership apartment. The size and quality are great. Really good attention to detail in the design of the development.I would definitely recommend Notting Hill Gensis.Thank you!

records.title: Once I was in contact with NHG
records.text: Once I was in contact with NHG, everything was made very easy in terms of my assessment and actually purchasing the property. However, it was initially quite difficult to get a response from NHG to book viewings and get information. Also, I was told in the initial assessment that the process should only take a month until I was actually in the property. This seemed a very short time for everything to go through and, as it turns out, it took several months. The actual time wasn't a problem - it seems standard, in fact fairly quick... I just don't know why the agent from NHG had given me an unrealistic time-frame at the start.

records.title: Steven Lam from sales progression team
records.text: Not had the most smooth exchange process (delay in exchange; service charge went up) but Steven has been very helpful and always quick to response.Hope the exchange to legal completion process will be hassle-free.

records.title: Not perfect but great still
records.text: I had a great experience with the sales team and in particular Steven L when I visited and got my shared-ownership property. He was very helpful, friendly and easily reachable on the phone or emails.The latest is not always the case for other members of the office staff.But overall it is a great experience with NHG.

records.title: Very good
records.text: I was kept updated throughout the purchase process and completion happened very quickly once we had exchanged.  Since I moved in the team have been very helpful in answering any questions I have and my new flat is lovely.

records.title: beyond average
records.text: Sales team was very friendly and helpful. I slightly tricky case as in order to get the discount that was announced for March the sale should be completed in 26 days which according to statistic hard to do. Despite the fact that sales manager that I was initially worked with had a short holiday I was carefully hand over to her colleague that started the process to me and gave me first guide how to act. Can estimate sales team action definitely beyond average, however there's still some few things that prevent me from giving 5 stars - during flat review process for the bank one day was wasted as the documents wasn't provide to the 3rd party company as sales manager has a day off ( this easily could be done by anyone else in the team )

records.title: Thank You Steven!
records.text: Three months ago I went for my viewing appointment with Steven Lam. I loved the property and reserved it on my very first viewing. I have moved in last week! Steven was there to support every step of the way and he is an expert in his field. There were few hiccups especially towards the end but with Steven’s help and reassurance, we got there.

records.title: Thank you!
records.text: Thank you!People from Notting Hill Genesis were extremely helpful during the entire process of checking the property and all the way until the completion of the purchase. Especially Iram Malik, she made our experience wonderful and was always available when we needed help or advice.

records.title: Smooth process
records.text: We started the process at the end of October and will be moving in end of February. Good communication throughout the process, allowed us to measure up before completion date. Will attend a home tour before we move in too.

records.title: Contact Throughout
records.text: Some small issues at the start of the process with change in service fee that were very different to what was originally shown - but everything to sort this out went smoothly and was always kept in contact with a member of NHG throughout.

records.title: The sales team were great shame about the appointed financial advisor.
records.text: The sales team were great, managed to book viewings and get all the information I needed. Always answered the phone and replied to emails. When I moved in there was a lot of information provided for me so I knew the processes and locations for everything even during COVID-19.The only reason I have knocked a star off is because I had a horrendous experience with the financial advisor who NHG appointed to carry out my financial assessment, they were unprofessional and unethical. The financial advisor created a situation which delayed my moving in by 3 months. If you try buying a house with NHG be careful about what the financial advisors tell you because they tried to sell me a really expensive mortgage multiple times, offering up more shares for me to buy as leverage, but without checking that the mortgage would fit my needs. Eventually they realised they were not going to make enough money from selling me a mortgage and called me to say I would never get a mortgage and hung up.It was a real shame because the sales team were great and if I had been provided with a honest financial advisor the whole process would have been fast and simple.

records.title: We had a good experience with Notting…
records.text: We had a good experience with Notting Hill Genesis. All communication was clear and efficient and made the process of buying a flat stress free and simple.

records.title: Knowledgeable
records.text: Knowledgeable and tried to point me in the right direction in terms of getting on the property ladder

records.title: Helpful
records.text: Sofiane was helpful and answered my questions as fully as possible and directed me to where I could find more information on the website and followed up with e-mailing me some more information.

records.title: Beautifully Property
records.text: Beautifully designed property in a great location. The developer was very flexible and supportive during the purchase process.

records.title: They did well
records.text: They did well, just took sooooooo much time. Otherwise, great!

records.title: Smooth process with terribly bad recommended solicitor
records.text: Smooth process so far with supportive agents and clear moving-in guidance to Royal Albert Wharf but they introduced to me a disappointingly bad law firm (Prosperity Law Ltd) with a solicitor that kept blaming on clients when it comes to delay. Solicitor and conveyance is a crucial part of house purchase so hopefully they will carefully choose their partners before introducing to clients.

records.title: Average
records.text: It’s ok. Not bad

records.title: I’ve got a viewing today managed by…
records.text: I’ve got a viewing today managed by Mr John Vincent, basically I visited a flat for handicapped people but I’m not,The building is new but by the entrance is full of damage and dirty  The finishing of the flat is VERY bad, the painting is already getting off, there’s space hole between doors and wall,Quality of the carpet is extremely basic, The location of the building is in toxicomane/punky place

records.title: Poor pos sale
records.text: Poor pos sale !! No support !!!

records.title: Buying process was OK, build-quality isn't great!
records.text: No complaints about the process in general.There were a couple glitches where the information provided by the sales office, the sales guy and on the actual documents was different.It was a bit disappointing to deal with incomplete & incorrect information when we were dealing with something that costs a couple of hundred thousands grands.The bigger issue is the cheaper build-quality of our apartment in London.We moved in about 3 weeks back into a newly-built property. One of the doors doesn't close, there are a couple cracks, the floor is a little uneven etc.Of course, we are under the defects period and hopefully, it will be resolved but it is a shame to have deal with these issues when you are buying a new apartments instead of just enjoying our new place.

records.title: no clear process to resolve defect and no clear point of contact
records.text: NHG lawyers were very slow. Outstanding issues detected during the handover process takes months. Sales team is very slow and don’t show much interest in resolving problems.There is no clear point of contact. Struggle to find out the relevant person. If found unable to reach them and no reply from the relevant person for many weeks. Property sold as new build but found at the last minute after completion that the building was constructed 2 years ago. As the mortgage was applied based on new build so I paid high interest rates.

records.title: Nice home, bad process
records.text: We love our new home but NHG’s communication is very poor. I have sent both emails and voicemails that have gone unanswered. Also pay very little attention to their promotions as they too have ignored what we should have been offered. They also took weeks to sign the engrossment documents which affected one of the promotion offers.

records.title: NHG have not responded to the majority…
records.text: NHG have not responded to the majority of my emails. No one is proactive at ever calling us to resolve our issues. Your SLA's are not even close to being met. Durkan have done a terrible job on certain parts of the apartments which require fixing and I expect this would be done within 6 months of moving in. Might be even better if NHG sent one staff member with a Durkan staff member to each apartment to sort out their specific issues. We ALL have some problem and many people would like their places checked after 3 apartments have now flooded.

records.title: Sold a dream, but in reality, we would have been better off continuing to private rent elsewhere.
records.text: Really poor, we purchased a flat with shared ownership. We have no hot water or heating every week, this is not an exaggeration and now 29 flats have been given to the the housing association, we were told that only one block was for housing and that all the other properties would be share to buy...this isn’t the case and it definitely makes a difference. There was meant to a coffee shop on location, this hasn’t happened either, due to ‘brexit’ apparently.Locks in the bathroom doors not working, faulty plug sockets, drafts coming in from the windows. We couldn’t believe we had finally owned purchased our first property as a family, we felt so lucky and now we feel duped.  We are really disappointed with the decision we made and if we had known of the issues we would be facing we wouldn’t have made it.

records.title: There is a lack of transparency and customer service
records.text: There is a lack of transparency and customer service. Not enough meticulousness taken in documents, several mistakes were found. Lack of confidence in their ability to deliver constantly moving timelines with no explanation. Everything was a struggle and now moved in and still a struggle.

records.title: Not great for Shared Owners
records.text: Not great for Shared Owners - bad at sharing info and I don't feel like they help you in any way. The Welcome pack given for appliances and info was out of date and with incorrect info. I had to google a lot of it. I still have lots of defects with my flat which I have had to chase them to get fixed. There is a distinct lack of taking ownership of mistakes, and although people are polite via email, it's often passing blame or making excuses. More action and less excuses. The most infuriating thing is there constant over promising and under delivering. Just be honest of when you'll get back to customers. I don't really care too much if it's going to take a week - just tell me that! There only saving grace is their maintenance people who actually attend jobs, they are polite and courteous and really want to fix the problem for you. Just office staff and NHG that cause the issues. Listen to your customers more and try and be a bit more human with your approach.

records.title: The purchase of my property was difficult
records.text: The purchase of my property was unacceptable upon completion - the sales team ‘misplaced’ my keys and I therefore could not move in until two weeks after completion. I insisted on the locks being changed as a matter of safety - anyone could have had those keys - but this really should have been NHGs suggestion as the issue went on for so long.I never received a walk through of my property upon exchange/completion which should have happened, and after speaking to my neighbours they didn’t have a walk through either. When snagging issues are flagged up I’m often asked if this was noticed on the walk through which I have to keep explaining I never had.We as a building never receive updates for snagging issues in the community areas as a whole, we have to individually keep emailing about them and waiting on a response rather than nhg just sending out email updates for what is happening, for example with the leaks on the 4th floor landing, the leak on the second floor outside the lift, the water turning off completely for the whole block, the water/heating being cold for some flats over the last week. The lack of communication and organisation in NHG is appalling, both within the company it seems as well as to the residents.

description:
Clarion is the UK’s largest housing association: 350,000 people call a Clarion home their home. We also offer financial help and guidance, as well as supporting people through jobs, skills, training and apprenticeship schemes.
Online services 24/7
As a Clarion resident, you can use our online services to manage your home on the move, 24/7, 365 days a year. Your online account enables you to request repairs, contact us and make secure online payments quickly and easily.
And you can use our live chat service to quickly talk to our customer service team during opening hours.
Sign up for your online account
Online account guide

records.title: Your a star Katie
records.text: Absolutely brilliant service from Katie, she helped me reschedule an appointment few minutes before closing, and she still helped didn’t rush and cut me of at any point. Really happy with Katie’s help and service.

records.title: My query was answered in a timely…
records.text: My query was answered in a timely manner by Katie, who efficiently and quickly responded and sorted my garden fence problem

records.title: Repair booking via Live chat
records.text: Teresa (Clarion customer service operative) was kind and efficient and book our repairs as needed. Thank you Teresa

records.title: Taiwo was helpful and polite
records.text: Taiwo was helpful and polite, explained what they were going to do and also explained how long it may take etc. Very good customer service.

records.title: Very efficient young man
records.text: Very efficient young man.  Asked relevant questions about my heater:  gas or electric.  Had no idea because we're not told this vital information  by our so-called "Smart" Scheme Managers. I was able to ascertain name of my heating supplier and the relevant details from the information provided today.  Having been without bathroom heating for one year, it is important I get the heater mended as weather is getting colder again.

records.title: Lucy managed to settle all my issues…
records.text: Lucy managed to settle all my issues and answer my queries efficiently. Thank you for you help Lucy

records.title: Clarion Housing Live Chat…
records.text: I have used various 'Live Chat' services in the past. None are as efficient and helpful as Clarion Housing's in my experience. I spoke with two representatives, Julia and Teresa and they were both extremely helpful.

records.title: Listened to my concern about vulnerable resident
records.text: Listened to my concerns about my mum's heating as a vulnerable resident

records.title: Jill was quick and helpful
records.text: Jill was quick and helpful. Easy to connect to the live chat too. Didn't have to wait ages with a bot.

records.title: Taiwo was very helpful
records.text: Taiwo was very helpful, all my query /complaint has been resolved.

records.title: I appreciate having the rent statements…
records.text: I appreciate having the rent statements arranged to be sent via 2nd class postage.

records.title: Agent was very helpful despite the…
records.text: Agent was very helpful despite the circumstances (changed appointment time, but was not informed of the change, so waiting in for nothing!).

records.title: Job done but took too long
records.text: Jill, on live chat did the job I needed her to do. She added some notes to my account. It was annoying that after security questions (no problem with these) I then was asked to confirm to her what information was on my account about me which had nothing to do with why I was messaging. The job got done in the end but a 5minute job ended up being 25mins unnecessarily.

records.title: Patience is a virtue
records.text: Janice took the time to let me answer her questions. The other person which I believe I spoke to last week was terrible. Always interrupting midway while I was writing.

records.title: Repair
records.text: It is an easy system to use, it would be helpful if there’s an repair that the person who you talk to can book a repair for you ,rather than waiting up to 10 days for someone to call you back . I was dealt with professionally and quickly by Charlie

records.title: Helpful and friendly
records.text: Helpful and friendly

records.title: The caller tried to help as much as…
records.text: The caller tried to help as much as they could.

records.title: Representative was very helpful but others at Clarion less so
records.text: Charlie was very helpful.  Unfortunately, the previous experiences I have had with Clarion sour this somewhat.  Charlie gets top marks but I can't give more than 4 after the lack of communication and the previous cancellation of my repair, without letting me know.

records.title: Helpful live chat staff to try to sort…
records.text: Helpful live chat staff to try to sort issues

records.title: Communications could be better......
records.text: An emergency attendance has been scheduled for me within the next 24 hours. However, in order to avoid having it downgraded to a routine appointment (within the next few weeks), I am expected to remain at home for the whole of that 24 hours, without the courtesy of being told when the attendance would be. I requested that someone contact me when the visit has been scheduled. It has not been possible for me to be given that assurance.

records.title: Tony the caretaker
records.text: Clarion gets a good review all thanks to our caretaker Tony. He is a lovely man who always greets me and my family whenever he can. He is always grafting and going the extra mile in keeping our block as clean and tidy as possible. Apart from Tony and the other workmen clarion are okay and could be better with communications.

records.title: had a log in problem
records.text: had a log in problem.  All checked and no problems now.  Also reported repair to bathroom tap at the same time - tap very difficult to turn on and off.  got to wait five weeks for appt!  That I don't particularly mind, but when I asked what to do should the tap become unusable I was told to call them back.  Unfortunately previous experience tells me that I'm unlikely to get any assistance from them prior to the appt date. Will edit review if we have to contact them again.

records.title: I honestly can not complain about…
records.text: I honestly can not complain about talking to someone online to someone as it's so much easier for me. As I am hard of hearing and struggle talking on the phone, as I get things mixed up. And get confused so writing it is so much easier

records.title: Live chat
records.text: I couldn’t raise a repair on the website. I contacted clarion through their live chat system and a repair appointment was scheduled within 5 minutes. Much easier than ringing and easy enough for anyone to use.

records.title: I was able to have a live chat with…
records.text: I was able to have a live chat with Yasmin today regarding a problem with my shower.  I provided Yasmin with as much information as I felt necessary.  Yasmin advised me she would be emailing the Area Manager and I was to await their response - usually within a 48 hour period, however, may hear by the end of the day, but could not confirm.

records.title: So far so good
records.text: So far so good - online chat quite easily transferred to a human (when I said the word 'human') and was given an initial answer by Taiwo who was helpful and quickly raised a report to the relevant team. All done in 10 mins or so. Time will tell whether this translates into action, hence 4 rather than 5 stars.

records.title: Live chat
records.text: The live chat agent was super helpful and informed me of the stage of my enquiries, raised a couple of new enquiries, and provided reference numbers, etc.. Let's hope my enquiries are going to get resolved as well.

records.title: to be fair i've lived here 6 months now…
records.text: to be fair i've lived here6 months now and clarion have been responsive everytime i've reached out please keep this up!!! we do have an ongoing issue with there not being enough bins i'm keeping my fingers crossed they do the right thing and hoping this positive feedback nudges them in the right direction!

records.title: Katie was quick to reply
records.text: Katie was quick to reply, helpful and accurate. Much appreciated.Would still like an email and full name, as it was before Clarion took over and retreated into a form of secrecy that is unhelpful for both staff and clients. If I miss a call, I can't call back directly but have to use a generic number with maybe 60 people waiting to speak...or a generic call centre. It is building inefficiency into the system.

records.title: Helpful staff, ok tech
records.text: Helpful staff, explained fully the information and helped get an additional appointment booked. Live chat not phone friendly, accidentally quit the conversation twice and had to scrabble to get back in. Good staff, ok tech. Appreciate being able to talk to a person.

records.title: Feels pretty ludicrous that boundary…
records.text: Feels pretty ludicrous that boundary fences and pollarding trees are the responsibility of the tenant. As a landlord I'm guessing you have contractors that could do this and more knowledge of how / where to go...

records.title: Leak
records.text: Every time I ask for an update on my leak I get told someone will get back to me. Never any information to hand, this is not my first leak either.

records.title: Feel Sorry For Them
records.text: Waste of time to be honest.The chat advisers seem like they are on the ball to get things sorted and try their best to be helpful but Clarion don't actually DO anything about the issues.

records.title: poor follow up to outstanding repairs
records.text: we're waiting on a number of callbacks from the planning team.they dont always callback. we have confirmed a date today for upcoming which we werent aware of.thankfuklly we can accomodate the date weve been offered
