records.title: No Emergency service over the weekend!!
records.text: Spent the weekend trying to get an Emergency repair done to leaking hole in tenants bedroom ceiling, that was cracked and drooping. Had to evacuate her to another property. Constantly told that 'someone' would be coming and no-one did. Definitely get the feeling that they didn't want to pay 'Out-of-hours' contractor fees over the weekend. Clarion plumbers came on Monday, after having to chase Repairs again. Fabulous men. Very helpful, repaired the leak, pulled down the damaged area of ceiling and made the room safe. Fed up with not being able to talk to a 'person' who knows the property, area and more importantly the Supported Living tenants that we care for. We used to have designated housing officers!!

records.title: No resolution
records.text: The customer service agent Andreas was helpful, but my problem wasn’t resolved as Clarion doesn’t replace light bulbs - even though I can’t climb a ladder.

records.title: Clarions contractors letting them and customers down.
records.text: Sandra came across quite angry and a little rude. But that's the problem with reading text, how it's read in the receivers mind isn't always how it reads in the senders mind. They referred my case to Ark pest control who should have contacted me but haven't. So they have let Clarion down which is a shame because it tarnishes Clarions reputation.

records.title: Awful
records.text: I disliked that fact that I had diffficulty in finding the chat.  I like the responses I got from Peter W apart from that I could not report the repair without joining yet another queue for the repairs team.  I had already given all to the vitrual chat, then to Peter W and then I was going to have to repeat it all to the repairs team.  No way!  Why such an unnecessarily elaborate procedure,

records.title: slower than slow
records.text: dislike waiting a long time for my back door to be sorted out. 3 electricians later and still i have no key switch  on my back door. unable still to open door and leave it open. totally fed up with this. and still waiting for cooker to be repaired .only had a year to do the repair to the oven , i cannot use it every time i turn the oven on the grill comes on as well and burns the food.

records.title: I've had to speak to 3 different people…
records.text: Regarding BSW.I've had to speak to 3 different people from 3 different departments and still not found any one to log a simple 'non attendance' of BSW gas engineer.I had to call and report as a few times in the past BSW engineers don't turn up and still have reported that we didn't allow access, even though we were at home. It was quite frustrating.We have been at home, but no engineer, nor any updates.

records.title: Not a bad housing group as long as you only need minor repairs!
records.text: The man on the web chat was a great help but an appointment time of 4wks to have your shower up and working again when you are disabled and cannot get in and out of the bath is a little to long if im honest, he did however say that he will see if they can bring app forward at all. Now to wait for the inspector to come out about the state of my bathroom, I wont hold my breath on it being sorted properly though as it's been like it for over 10yrs now!

records.title: I was offered a property on the 9…
records.text: I was offered a property on the 9 December. I was told that the property needed repairs which would be completed by 6 January. I have phoned numerous times and been told that they are awaiting an email to state the work is completed. I have driven past the property and changes have been done . There is no ongoing work being completed. I am now forced to live in my car with as many personal items I could fit in. Needless to say I am extremely worried.

records.title: Tried phoning Clarion Housing first to…
records.text: Tried phoning Clarion Housing first to find out if there was any update on the repair issue with regards to the Lift but was in a very long queue (94!). Then logged into my account for a live chat, eventually chatted to someone but they we're getting any response from person responsible (Lift Surveyor) therefore now awaiting a phone call back from Clarion Housing. Tried for one-and-a-half hours but got nowhere so left feeling frustrated at the lack of response.

records.title: Quick and responsive
records.text: I was connected quickly to Lori who answered all of my questions regarding the home alterations application form. Five weeks on and I'm still waiting for someone to call me back so I can order additional fob keys. Why isn't there an order form online or something? I've requested a call 3 times now.

records.title: Repair
records.text: Been chasing up a repair got a month now with unrealistic time frames being given to me all the time. Literally calling up every week and been told lies. Spoke to Dominic today and was very helpful and truthful. Absolutely lovely gentleman, took the time out to answer all my questions, customer service was brilliant, explained the process to me in detail and gave me a realistic timeframe. Very empathetic and understood my issue. Very rare for a clarion employee to be so helpful, absolute star!

records.title: Appointment times were conflicted
records.text: Appointment times were conflicted, was sent one confirmation appointment time but was booked in for a completely different time. Had to rearrange my working day to accommodate original time, only to then lose a day's work completely. Very frustrating 😕 But must say how helpful Jennifer was on the Clarion online chat help. Thank you Jennifer.

records.title: Phone Tech issues - problem sorted in Chat
records.text: The phone lines were not working when calling for a repair, I called twice and was hung up on both times due to a technical issue on their end. I then called reception and I was told to try the online chat instead.I tried the Online chat where I spoke to Jane, who was very friendly and helped with my enquiries quickly and efficiently. Contact via the online chat is far better than calling, I won't be using the phone again as I have had too many bad experiences with Clarion call centre in the past.

records.title: The online chatbot is useless, People are better
records.text: The online chatbot is useless, asks to many questions about you , the real person was helpful & sorted the problem out quickly, still took 30 minutes of my life ( I am not a tenant but had to report an emergency on a vacant property)The phone system had me as number 30 in the queue is quite hopeless.

records.title: Roof Gutter clearing - delay
records.text: The repair that I requested is taking too long to be achieved. It is simply clearing guttering, which should be done on a regular basis by Clarion. The delay in clearing guttering when we are experiencing a large amount of rain, can only cause damage to the exterior and interior of properties. Causing damp and possible further repairs required. Clarion is a large organisation, and should have more trades people to make simple repairs.

records.title: False promises!
records.text: Everyone I speak to at Clarion are so helpful, it’s almost like they tell you what you want to hear. Then nothing ever gets resolved. This issue with the banging in our block has been going on for two years and nothing has been done. Everyone accusing everyone else, causing arguments with neighbours. Whom most of which are on drugs anyway. So there lies the answer! Everyone on drugs people getting away with anti social behaviour!!!!! Clarion does nothing. Don’t get be started on the caretaker services🤣what a joke that is.

records.title: Laura was very polite
records.text: The online chat handler Laura was very polite and empathetic. Clarion are still appalling with their service and unfortunately the customer facing staff are at the brunt of it. I gave 2 stars because Laura tried but her hands are tied so she could not resolve. Hopefully this won’t take 3 years and left practically homeless before an outcome.

records.title: Still not resolved the rat problem I…
records.text: Still not resolved the rat problem I first reported almost 2 months ago. Chased for the third time today, only to be told that the info only got passed to pest control 2 days ago?! No resolution given, just information about where the issue has got to in the system. No apology for the shocking service. No offer to chase it up.

records.title: I received a letter from your accounts…
records.text: I received a letter from your accounts team asking my to contact the Live Chat line. However the very helpful (no sarcasm) lady who was my contact could not help with the problem as my contact letter had no indication what the problem was or what I needed to do. A really pointless exercise

records.title: Rescheduling Appointments Without Telling Tenants
records.text: Received a text message from Clarion saying they had cancelled my appointment as requested. I did NOT request to cancel OR rearrange my appointment. Went to Live Chat & even the staff member could not see why it had been cancelled but could see the appointment had been rearranged by Clarion for the day after the original date (not message to myself to say this was the case so had I not done Live Chat I would not have known). Surely Clarion should be checking the convenience of appointments with tenants rather than just taking it upon themselves to cancel and rearrange without even notifying the tenants? This is the fifth time I have called about this issue and all they keep doing is taking photos and saying they will sort it out.

records.title: Sam R at Clarion; good. Swale Heating: BAD
records.text: Sam R at Clarion was very helpful, but Swale Heating were not. Told her to fill in an escalation form which would take five working days to respond to - even though I’ve been calling them all week. Waiting so long for boiler repair is unacceptable - I have pulmonary arterial hypertension and getting a bronchial infection could literally kill me. The flat is FREEZING!

records.title: Poor message response time
records.text: Couldn’t read my earlier message. Asked for my details even though I’d already sent. Was almost 20 minutes waiting between messages - I understand if you’re looking in to my issue Chris but say that so I’m not left wondering if he’s no longer on the chat as no one is talking for 20 minutes!

records.title: Totally unprofessional...
records.text: Booked to get repair a leak in my sink. Failed to arrive on the day of the appointment and without any communications for the reason for no show. Turned up few days later fixed the problem only to have the same fault occur again. So spent another 40mins on Chat messaging to book another appointment. Vey poor service indeed.

records.title: Online service with Rosie  is highly recommended…
records.text: Online service is highly recommended and more sufficient than any other,if I am honest. Rosie completed our enquiry in the most timely and professional manner , which obviously made our life much easier  after Clarion's contractors , EQUANS,failed to attend their scheduled appointment with us. Calling Clarion , nowadays,  makes people be put in a long queue of being mostly number 49 or so , which seems to be unreasonable considering the fact that Clarion is one of the biggest company in the country.

records.title: It's not the adviser's fault
records.text: It's not the adviser's fault; she tried her best to assist me. But, I genuinely don't understand why Clarion constantly advises their tenants to report anything online, just to be ignored if it isn't an emergency repair. What is the purpose. Repair is repairing. When I went to call Clarion, I was informed that I was caller number 65! I mean, really?

records.title: Milby Court power loss update
records.text: Friday 31st March. Power loss at Milby Court update. Contacted Clarion Housing today. Spoke to a very helpful lady called Clare(hope spelling ok). Without boring you with all the details ended up with the information I  required. Not good news. Looks like it's going to be longer than expected. Also had a call from our Liaison Officer. Still not happy with the situation but at least I know things are happening behind the scenes. A bit faster would be appreciated.

description:
Audley Villages develop and operate award-winning luxury retirement villages in the UK. A homeowner purchases a beautiful retirement home (one, two and three bedroom apartments and cottages available) in a beautiful and secure environment, with exceptional facilities like a health club, restaurant and library at the heart of the village. Properties and village grounds are maintained by Audley and homeowners are free to sell their property at any stage, on the open market. A monthly management fee and deferred management charge apply to the sale of all properties. Full details are available on the website and in person from the village team.

If you do not own a property at an Audley village and wish to leave a restaurant or club review, please submit a review for the particular venue on Google.

records.title: All the Audley Village staff were very…
records.text: All the Audley Village staff were very pleasant and helpful. We were met and offered refreshments upon our arrival, taken to our suite to deposit our overnight cases, and shown around the facilities. Dinner and breakfast were provided, the facilities were clean, and every effort was made to make our stay as comfortable as possible. We were taken to view several units, and nothing was too much trouble. All our queries and requests for information were provided within the time frame promised. We cannot praise the Audley staff enough.

records.title: The visit was very informative and very…
records.text: The visit was very informative and very helpful. We came home with all the information we needed. We are now processing all the information. We enjoyed our look round the properties for sale and now need to make decisions. We thought the sales manager Jennifer Gregory was very professional and very thorough.

records.title: Very interesting and lovely location…
records.text: Very interesting and lovely location and we were made very welcome

records.title: The atmosphere was was very welcoming…
records.text: The atmosphere was was very welcoming staff very friendly especially William and Elle, apartment very tasteful, thank you very much for a excellent lunch , kind regards Mary & Richard Bailey x

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: The overall impression of Audley Redwood was excellent. The moment you walk in you get a good feeling. The team without doubt were very professional and so friendly. Very reassuring for a potential new buyer. Samantha the sales manager was just amazing. Making what can be a difficult decision so much easier with her smile and warmth.

records.title: Especially Louise
records.text: Especially Louise, and also staff and residents made us and our 2 little dogs so welcome and feel at home . We are so excited to come again and stay over and how exciting Louise has invited us to various events which we are looking forward to coming the facilities are amazing and we can see we could be happy with you all Thank you Elizabeth and Kelvin Ryland

records.title: A very happy experience
records.text: Very friendly welcome with a highly professional consultant. We were never made to feel rushed or that any questions we had were avoided. Much valuable information was provided and we were able to visit 3 apartments which enabled us to consider different aspects of life in the community. Nothing was too much trouble. Thank you Gemma, who also made our dog most welcome.

records.title: We had an appointment with Amy Wood…
records.text: We had an appointment with Amy Wood wood for a show round on Wednesday 18 th September. And from the moment we arrived pulling in to the reserved parking bay , the experience was seamless Amy’s knowledge & professionalism was first glass . She answers all our questions & more . Amy is areal credit to Audley Village Sunningdale park , so much we’ve passed her name on to some of our friends

records.title: A full guided and informative tour with…
records.text: A full guided and informative tour with no hard sale....it doesnt need it...it sales itself. Spacious, high finish properties, sat in parkland, but with central hub, within easy access from own properties, facilites of high class hotel. Staff friendly and efficient, and treat you as friends, in on the secret of this lifestyle opportunity.

records.title: My first impression of a village like Audley and its surroundings
records.text: I was greeted by a very nice lady, Amy, who was not out for a hard sale. Amy took me around the wonderful surroundings including the 2 & 3 bedroom apartments. I explained to Amy that having a wife who was paralysed from the chest down, 2 years ago, that my visit was planning for the future as care cover is required 12 hours per day and these villages provide that. Amy was wonderful, fully understanding where I was coming from, NO HARD SALE!!

records.title: Very welcoming staff and a lovely…
records.text: Very welcoming staff and a lovely building. Just demoted one star because the decor in the communal areas seems a little old-fashioned. It used to be more modern and stylish.  Design by committee is rarely successful.

records.title: Lovely place but traffic an issue
records.text: Apart from the traffic congestion and the difficulty in parking, once inside, we were made to feel very welcome.  We were very impressed by all the facilities offered .   The whole place was immaculate and the flat we were shown was very modern and spacious.

records.title: Personal thoughts
records.text: Standard of accommodation Friendly and thoughtful sales meeting

records.title: Very useful and enjoyable visit.
records.text: My family and I were immediately made welcome with refreshments until Samantha was ready.  She explained the ethos of the village very well and answered all our questions fully.  Interior decor throughout very impressive, grounds very well kept.  But what a pity the exteriors look so run down and uninviting!  Also lack of nursing facilities rather off-putting.

records.title: We were welcomed to our visit by Sam…
records.text: We were welcomed to our visit by Sam who went through all the elements of the village in clear detail. We were then shown around the site and to one of the show apartments which we found most helpful. We have relayed all the information to our parents for consideration. We have not yet received our restaurant voucher which was offered under our invitation and look forward to receiving this shortly.Many thanksJ Lewis & A Partington 11am visit 16/5/23

records.title: Taster visit
records.text: Gemma, our guide, was very pleasant and informative.  She took notice of our interests and preferences and showed us areas of interest to us.  We were impressed with the accommodation and the layout of the village, particularly the grounds.  We also very much liked the original features of the old Manor House and restaurant area, as well as the spa block.

records.title: Impressed, but not just yet for us.
records.text: We were impressed by the generally high standard of design and finish throughout the areas we visited. The person (Samantha) who showed us round the village was very helpful and sympathetic, and not at all ‘pushy’, which was a relief.We were daunted by the prospect of having to downsize from a large four bedrooms house to a very much smaller two bedroom apartment, where all the rooms seemed small to us and there was very limited storage space.We were rather disappointed not to be shown an apartment with an East facing view over the valley.Overall, we thought that such a property might suit as at some future time, but not immediately. However, we were pleased to have had the opportunity to view the village.

records.title: Lovely Village but Costly
records.text: Gemma was an excellent agent and gave us a most comprehensive tour of the village and 3 different  style accommodations, one of which (a 3 bed-roomed apartment) was suitable for our requirements. However, my disabled wife and I are not yet convinced that a move from our lovely home with living-in care into the village is right for us. I was put off most by the £25,000 annual maintenance charge, and I also felt that the £1m capital cost of the third floor apartment  situated several hundred yards from the Club was high.

records.title: Excellent Audley Village Cobham
records.text: Audley Village in Cobham is one of the most luxurious and beautiful venues I have ever seen.  The private apartments ae generous in size and fitted with the most up to date equipment.  The public areas are designed and furnished in a style equivalent or if not better than most 4 star hotels in London. The Sales Manager who showed me round deserves special praise for her informative manner and knowledge of the villages amenities.

records.title: It was an excellent experience
records.text: It was an excellent experience.  Tony was a great guide. I enjoyed seeing this beautiful house and environment and the facilities.  Very well done.   Only disappointment was the relatively large sizes of bedrooms and bathrooms compared to the open plan kitchen diner which is where you spend most of your time.  Better use of space.needed?Maybe you need to ask and probe and be clear what if anything they will and won’t compromiseAnd any particular difficulties such as mobilityI really loved the flat with the open landscape view.Open plan area was rather small.   Bedroom big!I should like to visit Windsor or see a short film as I don’t know the area

records.title: An interesting visit
records.text: I was given a comprehensive tour of the building and was able to view several apartments and facilities such as the pool and cinema. Ralph Haddon was very thorough in explaining all the facilities and also in asking me about my needs. However, this is not a 'retirement village', just a block of quite expensive apartments. The 'village' garden is more or less a paved area down one side of the building with some shrubs. I can see that if you are on your own and  want to downsize to somewhere where there is a level of support available, then this could be a good place for you. But it is not for me - aged 75 I just did not feel old enough for it yet!

records.title: Recent visit
records.text: Fabulous retirement village, sales person Gemma was knowledgable and friendly and obviously proud of the development. Viewed a house and an apartment and the presentation of both was poor which was disappointing. I would have expected them to be ready to present or not have shown them to potential purchasers. I appreciate that they were in progress but it didn’t give the best impression.

records.title: For me,it was a pleasant experience but…
records.text: For me,it was a pleasant experience but the staff did not seem to be aware of my visit and had I not been on a previous afternoon visit and 'knew the ropes' to some extent, I would have felt a bit neglected. I was advised by Nightingale staff  ' not to forget my swimming costume ' but in the room was only a form detailing costs of joining the gym etc. No mention was made of meal times etc. I suggest that for future reference, a 'meet and greet' member of staff would be most welcome. But, that said, there is no doubt that this Audley Village is delightful !

records.title: An eye-opener
records.text: An excellent tour and we were pleasantly surprised at how lovely the place was. Also slightly shocked at the cumulative charges paid when a flat is sold. Doing our sums!

records.title: The whole concept of the village is…
records.text: The whole concept of the village is good,although we felt Scarcroft  area is rather isolated.The quality of the building was excellent,kitchen and bathroom fitting good and practical.14 July 2023 Mrs B Balmer

records.title: Audley Fairmile…
records.text: We were well received by the Fairmile Village representative, Karolina Harvey, who gave us a very clear and informative summary of Audley and of the Village facilities. This was followed by a tour round the communal areas and facilities and one of the apartments.The communal facilities cover a wide range of activities. We found these to be well outfitted to high and tasteful standards. The layout of the apartments is well thought out with some flexibility of purpose. Fittings appeared to be of a high standard. Although we might consider acquisition at some later point in our lives, it is unlikely that we will follow through on a purchase at this point. Simply too small and restrictive

records.title: Very impressive quality of communal…
records.text: Very impressive quality of communal space and facilities. Had rather the feel of concentrating on care rather than on activities. Not sure that the limited number of residents (when all apartments are occupied) will be sufficient to run many activities.A pity that some basic extras (like parking space, cleaning, and laundry) are not included in the monthly fee.

records.title: Very worthwhile to hold an initial exploratory discussion.
records.text: The level of interest shown by the Fairmile Sales Manager was exemplary, and very painless to explore the reasons behind my interest in the Audley village. The amount of time taken to both hold a discussion and  be able to see the typical accommodation was just right - not too long, not too short.

records.title: Great product, admin not quite so good!
records.text: Product great, sales rep charming but arrival at reception bit shambolic (didn't have record of my appointment and had to scurry around to sort).  That aside, in due time and if a suitable flat were available would seriously consider purchase.

records.title: Overall experience was good but…
records.text: Overall experience was good but dissappointed to hear at the end of the tour from our host that the restaurant was not serving lunch because the chef was unwell and unable to cook especially when we felt exhausted after the visit.Dr & Mrs Raj Premkumar.

records.title: Coopers Hill quality residence but lacking practical details
records.text: I visited my elderly friend in Audley Coopers Hill village recently. My friend has given me a nice tour of the village as well as their flat. While I was quite impressed with the beauty of the grounds, the facilities, safety elements and the quality of the development, I found some elements in the flat designed with limited consideration to life style or capabilities of a senior person. Those are the things you'd only care when you start living in the place, of course... For example, doors and windows are quite heavy to pull ( they are well quality and secure, for sure); ensuite shower glass is too narrow to block the water from the shower splashing into the bathroom (which means extra mess and cleaning after use); bathtub in the 2nd bathroom is too high to get in or out; nice kitchen but deep / hard to reach cupboards below the counter, etc... In the overall, I thought Audley Coopers Hill could have done better if they paid attention to such practical details from a perspective of a resident that is not in need of a full-time carer and is fairly independent.

records.title: Viewing
records.text: Booked a visit on line. When we turned up we were not expected, so arranged another time. When we arrived again, we were kept waiting quite a while.Found the site cramped, with little outside space. The apartments that we were shown were quite spacious and well thought out.

records.title: These are not reviews.
records.text: What is the point of reviews based upon a 'visit'. Such reviews have clearly been canvassed and don't really tell prospective punters anything at all. If the whole Audley experience is a tour and afternoon tea then fabulous, these reviews will help. But if you want to know what it is like finalising a deal, moving in, paying service charges, getting maintenance issued addressed, meeting new neighbours, enjoy the facilities, reporting problems, accessing care, being a care receiver, dealing with relatives that have passed, stomaching losing 28% of the value of the apartment. Etc etc etc.So PLEASE, if you have experience of Audley, let's hear it. But if all you had was tea and cake with a tour around a flat for sale, save your 'review' until you've lived there 3 years.

records.title: First impression, buildings look ok but quite close together and little green communal area.
records.text: First impression, looks pleasant but where to go:Lizzie, our guide, was very charming and informative.As for the rest……..Kitchen areas very small Most spacious flay had a really unpleasant roof view looking directly into next flat.Communal grounds not large enough.Thought the bistro would be a good place to meet other residents for lunch but think the pricing was wrong , certainly not an everyday event.Finally, deferred fees? I really do not want to give this company 30% of the selling price!

records.title: Excellent introduction
records.text: Excellent introduction, tour and explanation of fees etc. Disappointed in presentation of apartments eg bare light bulbs hanging down, rooms not dressed as you would expect for prospective buyers. Lovely pool and fitness centre. Monthly charges extremely high as is the 1 or 2% charge  per annum when you leave the property.

records.title: Disappointment
records.text: I did write a review so do not understand that you haven't received it.Jennifer, the lady who showed me the apartment, was very helpful and understood my concerns about the one I was viewing.    I found it disappointing as I expected something more luxurious.    It had very low ceilings and had an air of depression about it.    She suggested that perhaps one in the main building might be more to my liking and promised to keep me informed should one become available.

records.title: It was difficult to get a feeling for…
records.text: It was difficult to get a feeling for the whole estate as it is still under construction.  The whole idea depends on how one utilises the communal parts which is currently difficult to assess.   I thought each apartment would be like a terrace property and was surprised access was more like a hotel.The representative was very nice and we had a good discussion

records.title: Loved the location and grounds
records.text: Loved the location and grounds and the properties are well presented but rather expensive in relation to similar on the open market. Rather surprised that despite paying management fees up to 30% of sale price, if you sell, is also payable.  Bit disappointed that parking is not always going to be near your property. Although there is a gym and pool these are open to public members so I would question the availability to owners at busy times.  There seems to be some confusion re shuttle bus into Romsey, we were told it was weekly another couple viewing at same time as us were told daily.  Also other couple had a parking space reserved for them by main entrance, there was none reserved for us. First impressions count.  This is the first "accommodation" of this type we have seen so cannot make a true comparison re prices and fees etc

records.title: Management fee plus 2% of purchase…
records.text: Management fee plus 2% of purchase value per month make this place very expensive. Cottages are well designed. DR Alexander

records.title: Nice  bur expensive properties,very…
records.text: Nice  bur expensive properties,very small kitchens,not good situation if you don't have a car, massive service charges! Gymnasium for over 70s but no Jaccuzzi which we like.Not good value for money!

records.title: There was nothing we disliked about the development but it lacked some essential facilities for us.
records.text: There was nothing we disliked about the development but  unfortunately the development did not cover a few of our  go/no go requirements. To expand on this we need a 3 bed property, no stairs and some form of DIY workshop facility ( I am a chartered engineer).Dispute the best efforts of Vicki, who we thought a first class salesperson, it became clear to us that we would be unable to convert to the living style on offer.

records.title: Food for thought
records.text: I think it is a brilliant concept - I am in my early 60s and planning for the future. Apart from the fact that construction is ongoing the village is well laid out and aesthetically pleasing. I was suprised the average age was 75-85. (Maybe there should be some for 60 +)The grounds are stunning and would be lovely to relax in. I do wonder how much use the gym, sauna, pool & steam room get.The concept of the owners lounge is very nice and once again beautifully appointed but is it really used? I was also suprised about the kitchens they are absolutely beautiful but are they purpose built. Are you going to get value out of double ovens , dishwashers etc - when purportedly you are trying to reduce menial chores that you do and there are great restaurants on site. Most people of that age are not going to be cooking a family roast each week. The kitchens were the focal point , in my opinion taking space that could have been better used as living space as some of the living areas are small. Whilst on site parking is provided it’s not directly near the houses in all cases. If you didn’t drive I think you would be quite isolated as there are not many amenities close by. A great concept to encourage a sense of community participation by allowing the wider community to have use of the facilities this should help create a positive vibe. As I said in the title it’s food for thought

records.title: Lovely, if you can afford it
records.text: Our representative, Claire, was delightful—friendly, knowledgeable, and impeccably professional. Her assistance in addressing all our inquiries was invaluable.While the site is still primarily under construction, it’s easy to imagine the beauty of the village upon completion. The main complex is a beautiful listed building, although we had hoped the new houses would have been designed to harmonise with it. Nonetheless, the completed cottages are tastefully presented with charming potted plants adorning the petite front gardens and a cosy shared patio at the rear. Despite our expectation of seeing solar panels on the new buildings, we were informed that some would be placed atop the main building.The show house boasted exquisite decor and impeccable taste. The square rooms were generously sized, though storage space was notably limited. Underfloor heating is provided via heat pumps, and the well-appointed kitchen includes a washer-dryer. Interestingly, hanging out washing is discouraged, presumably to maintain the ambiance.The price tag, admittedly, was quite substantial. While one might naturally expect to pay for certain services within a gated community, the leasehold price for the house we viewed was substantially higher than we expected. Additionally, the monthly service charge was astonishing, with utilities and council tax excluded. Parking charges of £600 annually, limited to one car per residence, further added to the financial considerations. Personal assistance is available but comes at a cost. Ultimately, upon property sale, Audley retains nearly 30%.In conclusion, this holds the potential to be an exceptional place to reside, offering a wealth of amenities, activities, and social opportunities, provided that financial considerations are not a primary concern.

records.title: A problem with an Audley purchase …
records.text: I was about to buy a 3 bedroom  apartment at Wycliffe one of Audley  Villages and had even paid a £1000 deposit, when I encountered a problem.I have an electric car a Tesla and also a villa in Cyprus,I requested an allocated charger as we go away for long periods and Tesla recommend that the car is left on trickle charge to preserve the battery.Although the site was still under construction and the purchase was off plan, this was still not possible.I was very impressed with Audley and all it has to offer and one of the reasons for the purchase was to be able to go away for long periods and lock up and leave. This was no longer possible with the Tesla, it was either give up the car and go back to petrol/ diesal cars, or give up Audley. I gave up Audley.However I did not let the issue rest as I believe it important for the future and for Audey particularly after 2030I wrote to the CEO and founder Nick Sanderson  and also Paul Morgan Managering Director with the problem's and my thoughts for future policy on builds in the futureThat was 4 Months ago and I have not received any reply from anybody in the Company.This surprises me as most senior Directors take an interest in these sort of issues to be able to set future policy particularly if they want growth.I still believe in the Audley concept and wold buy a property if I could keep my Tesla or come to some arrangement on a site, which not one of the salesmen even considered.Lets hope this review makes them think and I get some sort of response. David Summers

records.title: Although all questions answered fully a…
records.text: Although all questions answered fully a show flat was not yet completed and could not be viewed!  Amazed that everyone's time largely wasted in this way

records.title: Nice
records.text: Lovely flats but miles from anywhere & it is also open to non residence

records.title: Afternoon tea standard is not as good…
records.text: Afternoon tea standard is not as good as previously.

records.title: I’ve received a lot of information from…
records.text: I’ve received a lot of information from Audley Villages, usually asking me to attend one of their open days.  As the closest village is some distance I’d like to know what the monthly charges cover before I go any further.  £975 a month is quite a lot and when I phoned I just wanted to know if that included council tax. However you  can’t be privy to that information unless you’re transferred to a sales person who wants to ask more questions before answering mine.Just a yes or no would have sufficed and it must be a frequently asked question anyway.

records.title: Price versus value
records.text: I looked at the literature on Audley's Sunningdale Park retirement homes but the homes are very expensive compared to the Lynwood Retirement Village with same facilities and just 500 metres away.

records.title: Not Impressed
records.text: My parents moved to Audley Redwood in 2020 and the management has been disorganised and chaotic. The apartment has had a heating fault for months - still unresolved.  Three managers have now come and gone. The last one was managing two villages and was clearly not up to it. My mum died in March and he couldn’t even be bothered to send condolences. I am not impressed.

records.title: Extortionate fees
records.text: Unfortunately the village was in the early stages of construction so we could not get a feel for the finished product.The sales consultant was efficient and was able to answer most of our questions.The prices of the properties were high, but the really off putting aspect was the high fees, especially the deferred fees

records.title: Review actual costs closely
records.text: We visited Audley site and was very impressed with all the facilities on site and the staff we met.however, the cost of living was seen to be very high. Not only did you pay monthly management charges you also had a deferred management charge payable up to 15 years. When I did the maths I really could not comprehend the total charges required.On top of these charges you had council taxes which seemed to double up charges for refuse and road  maintenance. You also paid an annual car park fee and on selling your property the estate charged for home viewing. It was also a rather high percent if Audley acted as your estate agent. As I said earlier. The site is lovely but do look at actual  charges with a calculator before making any decisions.

records.title: Experience of Audley Villages
records.text: We viewed your new development near Romsey & also the existing one at Chalfont.As we noted to you following our visits the standard of individual properties especially the kitchens were poor considering the prices required.The standard of general leisure services is very high,in fact far too high compared to the individual properties.

records.title: Disappointed by the whole experience
records.text: Disappointed by the whole experience. The apartment shown was small, dark, and depressing. The whole place was uninspiring. Sorry.

records.title: I worked for the Redwood site.
records.text: I worked for the Redwood site.The people who own at that site are lovely.I had to leave my job when I felt I was having to lie to the owners. The staff were told to say 1 thing, whilst the truth was something else. Senior management were incredibly unfriendly and at times their behaviour bordered on bullying. I cried at one point after an incredibly aggressive interaction with my senior manager because he was so belittling.

records.title: Untrustworthy senior management
records.text: I was employed by this company to manage the leisure club at their Bristol site (Redwood). The company used a forged document, exaggerated claims regarding my conduct and an inadequate investigation to dismiss me. This was due solely to the fact I had submitted a complaint about one of the general mangers.The company were found guilty of victimising me at an employment tribunal. The judge found that senior officers of the company had been dishonest and acted inappropriately. The company was ordered to pay me in excess of £16000 in compensation.If you would like to read the full judgement, search for Employment Tribunal 6001020/2023Specific criticisms of the company are in paragraphs 28, 41, 43, 60,61, 62, 80, 85, 98, 99, 102, 115, 117, 120, 121, 155, 157, 158, 173, 176, 178, 180 of the full judgement.*edit* The company has responded claiming that their actions were necessary (this response was submitted after they had reported my review to Trustpilot in a failed attempt to get it removed). The judge found that they exaggerated claims and carried out an inadequate investigation.  The judge also found that, if I'd  had 2 years service there is little doubt the tribunal would have found that I was unfairly dismissed. The manager who dismissed me stated in court that had she know the facts, she would not have dismissed me.*

records.title: Langon's restaurant at Audley village
records.text: 3 weeks ago I went to the Langton's restaurant at Audley Villages Luxury Cooper Hill complex....where I also wrote the previous review that it was a disaster.... I received an email from restauran represent, following the feedback given and she asked me what I liked, what satisfied me so that she could raise the standard from the neighborhood pub to what they claim to be...Yesterday, I went again to see what had changed... nothing, the tables with the glass still unwashed, the expresso coffee... no comment, the mirror where the glasses are kept full of fingers (not current), the mirror at the bar full of water drops not current...a pleasant surprise, like the last time there were bathrooms... you can serve there because it's much cleaner.... I don't know....

description: Trusted with rubbish removal for over 15 years. Services include HIPPOBAG, skip and Man & Van services.

records.title: Excellent service, great value
records.text: Excellent service. Much cheaper and easier than a standard skip. The hippo material is strong and unless one is very careless it'll take virtually all material that a householder needs to dispose of- although do read the exclusions such as partially full paint tins .No downside . I arranged the pickup and was surprised to find it taken without even hearing the lorry! Great service definitely will use them in the future - one tip , if you collect the bag from the list of suppliers there's no delivery fee - although I considered it was worth driving five miles to avoid the postage fee

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Great experience. I was worried about the collection more than anything as I can’t guarantee no parking outside my house. This wasn’t a problem. I booked the collection and the bag disappeared early one morning. Didn’t even hear it being done. Great service thank you ☺️

records.title: Seamless service
records.text: Seamless service, didn't even notice the person come to collect the bag it was just gone, no hassle!

records.title: We've had many Hippobags over the…
records.text: We've had many Hippobags over the years, it's always easy and straightforward. We have a lovely driver who always picks up (North Devon) and always remembers us if we're outside when he gets here, we always enjoy saying hello if we're in.

records.title: The bag kept the job tidy
records.text: The bag kept the job tidy and was removed on time. driver very friendly and helpful.We were un able to get a skip on the job but the megabag was big enough and was easily  removed by the arm on the lorry.

records.title: Great service as always
records.text: Great service as always, we highly recommend hippo waste services.

records.title: Worth every penny!
records.text: We got a Hippobag to clear out two decades worth of junk from our loft and cupboards.  It was really easy, we just filled the bag, booked a collection, and it was gone 48 hours later.  The truck seemed to have no problem with our narrow residential street full of parked cars, which I had been a bit worried about.It's fairly expensive but I'm so glad we did it as we have a lot more room to enjoy our house now without all the clutter everywhere.  Planning to do it once a year from now on!

records.title: The website was very easy to use and…
records.text: The website was very easy to use and informative. Booking was straightforward and delivery quick. Collection was made very easy with no need for me to be present. It's such a good, useful service. Thank you.

records.title: Such an easy process
records.text: Such an easy process. Hippobag arrived swiftly to our house. Once we had filled it, we were able to go online and simply request collection.  The bag was collected within a few days by friendly worker.Only one suggestion for online collection form, we needed to click more than thing for what the hippobag contained and couldn't.  So if it's important for the collector to know in advance,  maybe add "other" on the form.

records.title: Fabulous service!
records.text: Our bathroom fitter recommended Hippo to get rid of building waste, such an easy experience! Ordered online, arrived at home, filled it up, asked for a collection, lorry arrived, took it away!! A very clean way to dispose of household waste. Absolutely would recommend and will use again!

records.title: Not quite 5 stars
records.text: Process from start to finish generally quite easy. Not 5 stars as I'm still waiting for a response from customer service about something I asked when I bought the bag

records.title: Hippobags good to use
records.text: Hippobags are a quick and easy way to get rid of waste such as soil etc. The process is easy to understand when ordering and using the bag. The collection is very efficient and doesn't impact on your plans as they quietly and effectively remove the bag without you knowing.

records.title: Excellent service!
records.text: Excellent service! Didn't even realise the bag had been collected until I received their email.A little pricey but given the cost of skips nowadays the additional flexibility and ease is worth it.

records.title: Good service but disappointed not to…
records.text: Good service but disappointed not to get Black Friday discount for collection only, which was available. Saying that service was good and bag collected earlier than expected which was good.

records.title: Easy to order and easy to use and no time limit.
records.text: Easy to order and easy to use and you can do things at your own pace as there is no time limit. It does seem a bit  expensive but when you consider the alternative - lugging the rubbish to the tip and climbing the stairs to empty it into the separate bins - I feel it's worthwhile.

records.title: This service is very easy to use
records.text: This service is very easy to use.  I underestimated how big a bag I would need but that was my own fault.  Hippo did exactly what they said they would do.  The empty bag arrived within 24 hours and the full bag was removed within 48 hours of being notified.

records.title: Excellent service that was easy
records.text: Excellent service that was easy, prompt and efficient. Collected v quickly too.Would be 5 stars but for price which was on the higher side

records.title: Good Experience
records.text: A good experience in terms of product and collection. However, I made a mistake not realising that a 20% off deal required the purchasing of a hippo bag directly from the company. I thought I was saving time by purchasing the bag from my local Screwfix. I am not sure what Hippo gain from penalising people who buy the bag from a DIY store rather than them, but I did feel a bit hard done by ...so 4 stars this time around.

records.title: Does what it says
records.text: Does what it says. Placed order for bag with collection, when ready for collection called customer services and a really pleasant agent booked the pick-up. Very quick pick up driver was really pleasant also. 👌

records.title: I pre ordered my hippo bag and…
records.text: I pre ordered my hippo bag and collection in advance at the end of June. The bag arrived the next day. Very efficient, with 6 months to fill it along with a collection code . I phoned a few days  before 8/11 to say it was ready for collection. The person on the phone was polite and helpful and went through what was in the bag. Two days later (preceded by a text) the bag was collected without fuss. Excellent service, would recommend to any one. Thank you

records.title: It was easy from start to finish.
records.text: It was easy from start to finish.The only thing was the cost, they were more than a standard skip if the price was around about the same cost I would use them more.Thanks

records.title: Good but expensive
records.text: Although the delivery and pick up has gone without a hitch, I do think for the size of the bag, this is an expensive service. I would definitely do it again if it were cheaper but I will seek alternatives first because of the cost.

records.title: Colllection
records.text: all was fine, just a bit long winded to get the collection booked in. we have got more and will be using the service again and see what happens.

records.title: Read all the rules before ordering
records.text: Good experience as delivered and collected within time line Hippowaste gave.  However, I also found quite stressful as a long list of items that you can’t include and many rules. Ordered for removal of an old kitchen and spent a lot of time policing trades who wanted to chuck everything in there. Not accepting parcel board was annoying as I kept having to remove to take to the tip myself. Not sure I would use again.

records.title: Very convenient alternative to a skip…
records.text: Very convenient alternative to a skip with the added advantage of a long loan period. Not as roomy as I’d hoped but still surprising how much you can fit into it. The price didn’t compare favourably to the skips I’ve used but factoring the longer loan period makes up for it.The telephone staff to arrange pick up were very pleasant.

records.title: The actual service was fantastic
records.text: The actual service was fantastic, from Darrell, 100%. Only four stars for Hippo overall though because of the needlessly worrying caveats they only tell you about after placing the order.

records.title: Love the convenience of the hippobags
records.text: Love the convenience of the hippobags.  Pick up driver was amazing.When ordering second bag, your operative wasn't going to give me the discount as I had bought bag from B&Q which was annoying, but did eventually 'as I had brought it up'. Thought this was strange.

records.title: The skip sized bag
records.text: The skip sized bag was delivered promptly. It’s a bit fiddly until it’s got several items in it to hold it in place, but then very good. The capacity really is on parr with a small skip. The only issue I had was with the website, hence the 4 stars. When ordering the bag and when booking the collection, the web page showed the flashing processing symbol and never actually showed the transaction as completed, but on both occasions, when I checked my emails, I had already received confirmation whilst this was happening, so I closed the page.

records.title: Overall the experience was good
records.text: Overall the experience was good. We were moving home. Called hippo and arranged a bag, they also arranged a pick up. Unfortunately the bag took a little longer to arrive so rearranged the pickup. Sadly this wasn't done and the bag stayed on our drive longer than needed. Was able to finally arrange and get sorted. The only down side was the miss ordering of the pick up. Otherwise 5*.

records.title: i cannot fault HIPPO at all
records.text: i cannot fault HIPPO at all, the thing is - and i humbly offer this as advice to any impulsive people like myself: i should have thought more about this , ordered a larger size bag, chopped everything up ( leylandii tree waste ) that was to go in the bag beforehand, packed the bag better, and not tried to do all this during the hottest week of the year. fair play to the collection driver, this is an awkward cul de sac. anyway- a lesson learnt - will probably use again due to the convenience.

records.title: Price advertised on leaflet is not the true price
records.text: I've used Hippo bag service 20 years ago and recall being impressed by the concept and quality of the service and the quality of the of the bags. I also recall however (perhaps wrongly) that the cost of the uplift / collection was included in the price of the bag. On this occasion when I seen the Hippo bag in B&Q I had no hesitation in opting for this when helping my brother with a home improvement project. I did pick up a Hippo bag leaflet from B&Q to give to my brother at the time. On it was explained the process. This included the additional cost of booking a collection at £130. This was an oversight on my part but made more unpalatable when I went to arrange the collection to find the actual cost was £183.99I can accept the cost of the collectio service being split from the initial purchase and that I didn't spot that it no longer was included in the purchase price. However, to find an addition £50 price hike from that advertised is unacceptable. Its the nature of how unclear the true cost is that displeases me.The concept remains brilliant and is a flexible alternative to skip hire. I chose it on this occasion due to the narrow driveway at the location which could otherwise not accommodate a skip without completely blocking access to the property.The website was relatively straight forward.Albeit a shock to learn the true cost as opposed to that advertised in the Hippo bag leaflet obtained from B&Q at point of purchase. The booking website also has a section to add any comments or instructions free text for the collection driver...this is a good feature and proved useful.The bags are of excellent quality and a good range of sizes. I used a midi and was pleased by how much it held and by how deep it was.The collection was timely and notified via email once done, which I particularly liked as it provided reassurance all went well with no snags. One small thing that might improve the bags is incorporating a lid to help stop rain affecting the contents or load.Not a small thing that needs improveing is the pricing on the advertising leaflet...it is misleading!I would recommend Hippo bag service but warn people to be wary of the cost advertised and check on line before buying in the shop.

records.title: I was disappointed
records.text: I was disappointed by the size of the bag (my fault for not looking closely at measurements). The ‘mega bag’ really didn’t hold much and worked out being so much more expensive pound for pound than the skip I eventually had to get as well. I wasn’t misled, but advise others to do calcs very carefully!

records.title: Great but pricy
records.text: The idea and service is great but too expensive compared to other skip hire services. It's great for getting up and running quickly to start collecting water but you get much better value if you plan properly and arrange a true skip with a local hire company.

records.title: Expensive
records.text: I find these very expensive compared to our other local company. I only use these when I have too as they are £100 more to collect the mid size bag than my regular people. Service is ok, nothing special.

records.title: Does what needed but expensive and thought would be bigger
records.text: Hippobag was good but the delivery a little slow. Ordered at 5pm on Mon but didn't arrive until Wed evening as we'd missed the next day delivery which is fine but was expecting it to arrive at least the next morning. The bag does what it says but is a lot smaller than expected (yes there is measurements) but considering how expensive it is I was expecting a lot more. Did a garden tidy and completely filled 1 mega bag, honestly would need at least 2 or more but wishing we brought a skip which would have been cheaper. The ease of use was good though and the collection was quick.

records.title: The system works - but…
records.text: The system works exactly as it is supposed to, so well done Hippo for that. That said, it is expensive, slow (took 6 days to collect) and the communication is poor, as once you've placed your order there is none until after the collection is done and they want a review (this). Also you're advised there is a weight limit according to bag size but how the average person can ensure compliance and not just guesswork is beyond me.

records.title: Overall positive experience …
records.text: Booked bag a while ago with discount code but due to circumstances did not use until after six month period. When booking a collection I was advised I had to pay difference between the cost at time of purchase and the cost now. I was advised of different costs each time I enquired. The eventual pick up booking went smoothly and the additional cost was much lower than originally quoted.The sales person was lovely on the phone and the colleague went smoothly as planned.

records.title: Not convinced of the benefits
records.text: We had the midi 1 tonne bag which was OK but couldn’t take things like doors etc. Whilst it did what it said on the label, making sure the bag was properly sited and filled properly was a bit of a fuss. The bag was collected but only on the 5th working day after booking.  I have to say in future I will pay a little bit extra (and it’s not that much extra) and get a skip.

records.title: I ordered a mega bag as it was on sale…
records.text: I ordered a mega bag as it was on sale for £180 not a bad size bag but would not buy again at full price as a 4yard skip near me would be the same price and twice the size.But on the plus size delivery of bag direct from hippo was the next day and collection was really quick once I arranged via the Web site

records.title: Absolutely ludicrous that you can't…
records.text: Absolutely ludicrous that you can't book a collection slot.Cannot believe you think it acceptable that I have to pay over £200 pounds to book a collection without knowing when that might be.Also, unacceptable that I am notified Friday late afternoon that collection will be on Monday, and again no time given.Will not use again

records.title: You're website is very confusing and…
records.text: You're website is very confusing and wouldn't let me submit the discount code, so my fiancée ended up paying full price on the phone. We had been clearing out my Mum's house after she moved into a care home with Dementia.

records.title: Drivers have been a bit grumpy and…
records.text: Drivers have been a bit grumpy and unwilling to wait when devon streets have been too narrow for their huge trucks and we have had to move the bag to a suitable pick up spot. Could do with some smaller trucks for difficult collections and be a bit happier.We all work hard but don't have to wear it on our sleeves!

records.title: Not good for heavy items
records.text: Not good for heavy items - the website could be clearer on weight limit when booking. It wasn't until we had received the Hippo bag bag that we realised that we could only fill it a quarter full with soil. A bit more info on this would have been helpful upfront as it wasn't ideal for our needs. Otherwise a great service, as long as you have bulky and lighter items!

records.title: Collection took too long
records.text: Collection took too long! There was no discount when booking a collection if you buy your own bag at a store, which are cheaper than buying them from you, hardly any saving at all.

records.title: It’s a great service, slight drawback with the skip bag
records.text: It’s a great service, especially in locations where a large skip is unsuitable.I liked the book on line feature too.I was a little disappointed when they said the hippo skip ( the largest) could only be filled 1/3rd full and so I needed to get a hippo mega bag and transfer some soil into that.It’s almost doubled the price and it was fairly costly to begin with Pick up was great, early morning and the driver didn’t disturb us, just took it away quickly

records.title: Average/overpriced
records.text: Handy the bag gets delivered flat packed, but that’s it really. I feel there over priced for there size, the customer service was not great when trying to contact about the delay in delivery, the message service they use is not up to date information either. I think your better calling a local skip company better value for money.

records.title: Hippo bags are a useful but expensive
records.text: Hippo bags are a useful way to get rid of small and moderate amounts of waste but Hippo are far too expensive. Unfortunately I live outside the collection area of Rhinobag who operate within the Nottingham area and are significantly cheaper. Also I have two bags and no discount is offered for collection of two bags even though it saves a journey. Took over a week to collect from payment

records.title: Good ethos, but not good for tight deadlines
records.text: I really like the ethos of hippo bags - which emphasises their drive to recycle correctly - but in this instance it was the wrong choice for me. We were on a timeline and hippo bags cannot give a specific collection day , causing significant stress while we tried to get it picked up.  Also we had to remove items that were on the banned list - it was hard to find the complete list and I realised nearly too late that we had to take a lot of items out.  The list should be easier to find on their website.

records.title: Not a great experience - bag not left and not all items taken
records.text: This service is ok, I would have expected the recyclable bag to have been left as it was paid for then it can be used again, but was told it can’t be they have to take it rather than empty it into the skit and more disappointing was the driver did not take all the items so after spending over £200 on the disposal he left stuff and I have no bag to re-use. Poor.

records.title: The bags were picked up ok ( at the…
records.text: The bags were picked up ok ( at the very end of the time period promised) but I bought one bag directly from Hippobag, including the  delivery, and as it wasn’t big enough, purchased another identical Hippobag from B&Q. Phoned up to get them both collected at the same time from same place. Cost me double. No discount at all on the second bag collection. This made it extremely expensive. I won’t use again for collection.

records.title: Booked a collection on 3rd Dec…
records.text: Booked a collection on 3rd Dec (Wednesday) for 6th Dec (Friday) between the hours of 8-5 and took the day at home so I was available for them to arrive.  Funds were taken from my card and I received an email with my order number.  As no one had arrived n the day by 3:45 I called and my order wasn’t put in the routing system and the next available I was told would be the following Wednesday which is unacceptable.  I’ve cancelled and awaiting my refund.  Only reason I gave two stars is the customer service rep was polite and courteous otherwise it would have been a one.  May have just been an unfortunate coincidence but I certainly wouldn’t consider using them again.

records.title: To expensive
records.text: Disappointed. The price has continually gone up and the amount of challenge about what qualifies as household waste is frustrating. At the current price levels I am considering metal skips given they're bigger and now cheaper / similar price.

records.title: Misleading marketing
records.text: When I rang to book collection I was asked what was in the multi skip bag. When I said household clearance stuff including a sofa, I was told that you don’t take upholstery and that the cushions would need to be removed! As we were not local to where the bag was, we had to travel an hour and a half back to the property to struggle (we are in our 70s) to remove the cushions from the bag. The home page of your website clearly says that you take sofas and there is even a picture of pillows as well. Clearly this is misleading marketing which caused us stress and unnecessary hassle.

records.title: Very slow delivery timescale
records.text: Haven’t ordered a collection so far, so can’t comment on that.However I ordered my bag just after midday on Friday, therefore missed the midday cutoff.It’s now Wednesday and the bag has still not arrived.Apparently this is the within the expected timescale.From the website I had expected a quicker delivery, would be good if it made it clear that delivery can take several days.

records.title: Insanely expensive poor service
records.text: Insanely expensive - split costing makes it slightly ambiguous.Not telling you the day of pick up is ridiculous and a 5 day window isn’t appropriate especially when paying this much. They also came and didn’t notify me which was requested. Would not use again. Refuse collection services are cheaper and more convenient

records.title: Disappointed in how small Hippo bag was.
records.text: Purchased the 1.5 ton size bag and was shocked to find how very little it held. Nowhere near big enough for spring cleaning a house. Ended up having to do many additional trips to the tip. Was no bigger than a motorbike in size. £230 was a huge cost for what it was. On a positive it was collected by the driver fine and communication by email was good.

records.title: It cost an absolute fortune
records.text: It cost an absolute fortune!  I nearly choked when they told me the cost for 2 midi bags was £364.00!

records.title: I was waiting for the delivery…
records.text: I was waiting for the delivery of the bag for over a week despite ordering next day service. This unfortunately caused huge problems as the new owner of the property was left with a large pile of rubbish on the driveway which could not be moved. Hippo did compensate me slightly but it was not the efficient experience you want in these situations.

records.title: £200 to clear less than a cubic meter…
records.text: £200 to clear less than a cubic meter of anything? Give over. In reply to the response. I clicked to have my bags collected. Clearly priced 1 at £185 clicked on quantity to 2 (I have 5) no price change or mention of discount only ‘add to basket’. Couldn’t proceed.

records.title: Find a better alternative
records.text: We ordered the mega bag which is described on the website as perfect for a bathroom refit, and goes on to say it will fit everything in, even the bath. Unfortunately this isn't true. We have done a small bathroom renovation 1.5m x 2.5m, keeping the toilet and the waste was no where near fitting. What is more frustrating about this company is that I have emailed customer services regarding this and haven't recieved a reply. I have given two stars because the bag arrived quickly and the pick up was also timely, although happened at 6.30am in a very loud vehicle which I am not sure my neighbours would appreciate. I would not recommend this company.

records.title: Easy to set up account and use.
records.text: Easy to set up account and use.Also very good rates

records.title: For a small building society I felt…New customer feedback

records.title: Call handler was polite and helpful.

records.title: Easy to register and simple…

records.title: CustomersFirst?
records.text: I don't normally reply to "How did we dos" but I will make an exception in this case.I am obviously fully in favour of website security processes but I think MHBS take things too far.1 When I was funding my account I had no confirmation that the funds had arrived. records.title: Unhelpful

records.title: Poor customer experience from start to finish
records.text: Although a small society, MHBS don't seem to want small customers, with minimum opening balance for fixed term offerings now set at £5,000 with no exception for renewal of maturing bonds. I think this is crass. Also finding an alternative account for my maturing funds was not easy. records.title: You asked us to transfer the money

records.title: "Clients of MHBS being taken for a ride.
records.text: * BOE rate reduction was 0.25%, but MHBS rate reduction was 0.35% on 185day notice acc.* "normally" building societies operate a change to the variable interest rate conditions the same notice  period as the their clients have to abide by.  MHBS do not make it clear that they are able to shorten the notice period of their change to only a few days.  This clause is deep within the General T&C.  So it is NOT shown on headline terms. My complaint rejected inboth cases!!!

records.title: Driven by greed and profits, not supporting members
records.text: MHBS like to boast of their "record breaking" sales growth but what they don't tell you is this is at the expense of its members and customers. Despite nearly all lenders having reduced their SVRs since the Bank of England starting cutting the base interest rate on 1 August, MHBS have still yet to do so, not even slightly. They will give the stock answer that they have to "balance the interests of both borrowers and savers", but the truth is they have been quick to reduce the rates on their savings account in response to monetary loosening. Pure greed from a 'Society' which pretends to operate in the interest of its members.

records.title: This company remains in the 20th…
records.text: This company remains in the 20th century. It's impossible to undertake the most simple of tasks without major hassle. And the opening hours are beyond a joke

records.title: Slow to reduce Mortgage rates and quick to reduce savings rates!
records.text: Another record breaking year for MHBS according to their website. Despite this, they are very quick to reduce the rates on their savings accounts and extremely slow to reduce their lending rates (SVR) for the benefit of customers who have mortgages with them. For a Society that is allegedly run for its members, I find in fact that the opposite appears to be true.

description:
Rosebud Nanny Agency is a multi-award winning nanny agency matching nannies and families in Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire, Buckinghamshire and South Cambridgeshire. 
Rosebud Nanny Agency is owned and run by Abigail Plested, a former nanny, and has been operating since early 2013. 

Abigail is passionate about children and dedicated to giving them the best start in life. She believes stability in their home life is the best way to achieve this. 
 
At Rosebud Nanny Agency, we strive to match each family with the nanny who best shares their ideas on bringing up their children. We believe consistency is key, and a harmonious relationship between children, parents and their nanny starts with this. 
 
We offer a professional yet personal service to every family, where you as the parent are in control. 
We aim to make the recruitment process stress-free for you – we are happy to answer general questions and enquiries, with no obligation. 

Nannies, like childminders and most nursery staff, hold childcare qualifications, paediatric first aid certificates and DBS (formally CRB) checks. They also often hold nanny insurance, although it’s not a requirement unless they are Ofsted registered (so you can use the tax free childcare scheme, or childcare vouchers towards the nannys cost) 
They are your employee, they come to your house for their working day, and solely care for your child/children. This means you would employ them through PAYE and have a contract of employment (both things I will guide you with!) 
 
Nannies look after all ages of children – it depends on your family! If you have a child at home and one at school, you have a complete childcare option rather than using nursery for one child, breakfast and after school club for the other, and muddling through school holidays in any fashion possible. 
 
Nannies working days and hours are set by you as the employer, so are often the most flexible form of childcare. You pay for the hours you need. 
 
 
Rosebud Nanny Agency covers Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire, Buckinghamshire and Southern Cambridgeshire – St Albans, Harpenden, Welwyn Garden City, Hitchin, Watford, Rickmansworth, Berkhamsted, Biggleswade, Cambridge, St Neots, Amersham and many more. Please contact us today to discuss your childcare requirements.
